STH_dominion_flavour.3030.d.tooltip: At a cost of 250 £ Influence, we assume direct control over [MemberPlanet4.GetName]. This will cause a large £ -125 impact to our relations with the [From.GetName], due to the loss of the world.
STH_dominion_flavour.3030.desc_01:
For thousands of years the Dominion has been expanding. Surrounding the Great Link is a core under the direct authority of our most loyal slaves, the Vorta and Jem'Hadar. Around that, a layer of Dominion members, misdirection, rumors, and deceit. Even our most loyal citizens do not know the truth about the true leaders of the Dominion.

Yet at times, even this strategy must be re-thought - and a planet that belongs to our members must be brought under our direct and full control. This can not be done easily or cheaply, and there have been cases where a member chooses to rebel, rather than to accept our dictate. That is the way of things - and this is why the Jem'Hadar are always ready to crush any rebellion.
STH_dominion_flavour.3030.e.tooltip: At a cost of 250 £ Influence, we assume direct control over [MemberPlanet5.GetName]. This will cause a large £ -125 impact to our relations with the [From.GetName], due to the loss of the world.
STH_dominion_flavour.3030.f.tooltip: At a cost of 250 £ Influence, we assume direct control over [MemberPlanet6.GetName]. This will cause a large £ -125 impact to our relations with the [From.GetName], due to the loss of the world.
STH_dominion_flavour.3030.g.tooltip: At a cost of 350 £ Influence, we assume direct control over the Capital world of [member_capital.GetName]. This will cause an extremely large £ -175 impact to our relations with the [From.GetName], due to the loss of their world.
STH_dominion_flavour.3030.name: Assuming Direct Control
STH_dominion_flavour.3040.a.tooltip: Invest a relatively small amount of resources, expending 300 £ Minerals and £ Energy to temporarily improve relations by £ +25 with [From.GetName].
STH_dominion_flavour.3040.b.tooltip: Invest a relatively moderate amount of resources, expending 650 £ Minerals and £ Energy to temporarily improve relations by £ +50 with [From.GetName].
STH_dominion_flavour.3040.c.tooltip: Invest a relatively large amount of resources, expending 1000 £ Minerals and £ Energy to temporarily improve relations by £ +75 with [From.GetName].
STH_dominion_flavour.3040.d.tooltip: Invest a significant amount of resources, expending 1500 £ Minerals and £ Energy to temporarily improve relations by £ +100 with [From.GetName].
STH_dominion_flavour.3040.desc_01: The Vorta treasurers purse their lips and frown - they are used to collecting taxes and tributes, exploiting the population of the [From.GetName], not spending valuable assets on subjects. To them, loyalty comes easily, ingrained to their very genes. Still, they do understand the value of targeted propaganda, and the Great Link feels there is a need to improve our relations with the [From.GetName]. Crowd opinion optimization engineers are already laying the foundation to a multi-tier social campaign that will ensure our citizens opinion of the Founders will improve markedly.
STH_dominion_flavour.3040.name: Targeted Propaganda
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.a.failtooltip: You either do not have an available Jem'Hadar Admiral to send, or the [From.GetName] already has a leader assigned to it - and it must be recalled before a new leader may be sent.
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.a.tooltip:
You can assign a Jem'Hadar Admiral as a Provincial Governor to the [From.GetName]. Only one leader of each type may be assigned to this empire at any given time. The Admiral will gain the Naval Attache buff.

Provincial Governor - Naval Attache

Ship Damage: +10%
Shield Health: +10%
Ship Health: +10%
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.b.failtooltip: You either do not have an available Jem'Hadar General to send, or the [From.GetName] already has a leader assigned to it - and it must be recalled before a new leader may be sent.
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.b.tooltip:
You can assign a Jem'Hadar General as a Provincial Governor to the [From.GetName]. Only one leader of each type may be assigned to this empire at any given time. The General will gain the Military Attache buff.

Provincial Governor - Military Attache

Army Damage: +33%
Army Health: +33%
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.c.failtooltip: You either do not have an available Vorta Governor to send, or the [From.GetName] already has a leader assigned to it - and it must be recalled before a new leader may be sent.
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.c.tooltip:
You can assign a Vorta Governor as a Provincial Governor to the [From.GetName]. Only one leader of each type may be assigned to this empire at any given time. The Governor will gain the Chief Administrator buff.

Provincial Governor - Chief Administrator

Minerals: +15%
Energy: +15%
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.d.failtooltip: You either do not have an available Vorta Scientist to send, or the [From.GetName] already has a leader assigned to it - and it must be recalled before a new leader may be sent.
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.d.tooltip:
You can assign a Vorta Scientist as a Provincial Governor to the [From.GetName]. Only one leader of each type may be assigned to this empire at any given time. The Scientist will gain the Proctor buff.

Provincial Governor - Proctor

Global Research: +15%
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.desc_01:
Projections, charts, and figures - the lecture of the Vorta goes on and on, but we do not need their information. We can feel the disturbance and ripples in the Great Link that indicates something is not well. Beyond the figures, we know deep down that there is something fundamentally wrong in the [From.GetName] government.

We do not know if it is sheer incompetence, inefficiency, or graft, but it is clear that actions must be taken. The Great Link has decided - we will appoint a Provincial Governor that we can trust to oversee the [From.GetName] and return them to the fold as functioning cogs in our great Dominion.

Assigning a Provincial Governor to a Dominion member will remove the selected leader from your roster. For as long as it is assigned, the Dominion member will get a significant buff, dependant on the kind of leader you will assign. Only Vorta or Jem'Hadar leaders may be used as Provincial Governors.
STH_dominion_flavour.3050.name: A Solid Cog
STH_dominion_flavour.3051.a.tooltip: Retrieves your Admiral from their position with the [from.GetName].
STH_dominion_flavour.3051.b.tooltip: Retrieves your General from their position with the [from.GetName].
STH_dominion_flavour.3051.c.tooltip: Retrieves your Governor from their position with the [from.GetName].
STH_dominion_flavour.3051.d.tooltip: Retrieves your Scientist from their position with the [from.GetName].
STH_dominion_flavour.3051.desc_01: The time has come to retrieve our valuable Provincial Governor from the [From.GetName]. The disturbances and ripples in the Great Link indicate that the ripples have been smoothed somewhat. There will always be a requirement for our steadying presence amongst the solids.
STH_dominion_flavour.3051.name: Solid Workings
STH_dominion_flavour.3060.a.tooltip:
Order the disbandment of the [From.GetName]'s Frontier Outpost in the [MemberOutpostSystem1.GetName] system.

This will sour our relations with the [From.GetName] and cause -50 £ Opinion with them. However, we will gain +25 £ Influence and £ Unity.
STH_dominion_flavour.3060.b.tooltip:
Order the disbandment of the [From.GetName]'s Frontier Outpost in the [MemberOutpostSystem2.GetName] system.

This will sour our relations with the [From.GetName] and cause -50 £ Opinion with them. However, we will gain +25 £ Influence and £ Unity.
STH_dominion_flavour.3060.c.tooltip:
Order the disbandment of the [From.GetName]'s Frontier Outpost in the [MemberOutpostSystem3.GetName] system.

This will sour our relations with the [From.GetName] and cause -50 £ Opinion with them. However, we will gain +25 £ Influence and £ Unity.
STH_dominion_flavour.3060.d.tooltip:
Order the disbandment of the [From.GetName]'s Frontier Outpost in the [MemberOutpostSystem4.GetName] system.

This will sour our relations with the [From.GetName] and cause -50 £ Opinion with them. However, we will gain +25 £ Influence and £ Unity.
STH_dominion_flavour.3060.desc_01:
The Dominion has not endured for ten thousand years because we have expanded recklessly across the stars. The Jem'Hadar do not understand this - they wish for us to subject all, bring them to heel. In time, they will get their desire - but as always, we must do so carefully.

To keep our borders secure, we must show restraint, and teach our citizens similar restraint. Growth and expansion must be carefully maintained, and when needed, trimmed.
STH_dominion_flavour.3060.name: Solid Frontiers
STH_dominion_flavour.4000.desc: Mighty Founder, we have identified a number of targets who we should attempt to bring into the mighty Dominion family. Our infiltration reports and long range scans suggest that their military prowess is well beneath our own. We should send a Vorta envoy to explain the rewards of joining the Dominion and the penalties for rejecting our benevolent offer.
STH_dominion_flavour.4000.name: Expand the Dominion
STH_dominion_flavour.4001.a.response: Rejecting the gracious offer from the Founders would be very unwise, surely you wouldn't reject our kindness.
STH_dominion_flavour.4001.desc: Hello, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] we greet you from the mighty Dominion with an offer that you would be wise to accept. We are a technologically advanced and millennia old power, founded under the absolute rule of a group of the wise and mighty Founders and we welcome you to share in the glory of our empire.
STH_dominion_flavour.4001.name: Greetings from your neighbours the Dominion
STH_dominion_flavour.4002.desc: The sheer audacity of [dom_member_target_country.GetName], they have rejected our offer to join the Dominion and scorned the welcoming offer from the Founders. This affront to the Founders power cannot be allowed to continue unchallenged. Should we declare war or allow them this one transgression.
STH_dominion_flavour.4002.name: Offer Rejected
STH_dominion_flavour.4003.desc: The leaders of [dom_member_target_country.GetName] have seen the wisdom of joining the mighty Dominion to serve at the whim of the Founders. This is another fabulous day in the history of the Dominion.
STH_dominion_flavour.4003.name: New member joins the Dominion
STH_dominion_flavour.4004.desc: Our diplomatic teams have received notification that [dom_member_target_country.GetName] has rejected the Dominions offer to join them. The Changelings are not accustomed to being rejected and it appears the Dominion are gearing up to take their worlds by force.
STH_dominion_flavour.4004.name: [dom_member_target_country.GetName] have rejected the Dominion
STH_dominion_flavour.4005.desc: Our diplomatic teams have received notification that [dom_member_target_country.GetName] has joined the Dominion in servitude of the Changelings. The inclusion of this new galactic state will only increase the reach of the Dominion.
STH_dominion_flavour.4005.name: [dom_member_target_country.GetName] have joined the Dominion
STH_dominion_flavour.500.desc: A new world, [FROM.GetName] has aligned themselves with the mighty Dominion, due to their status, we can uplift them to a full Dominion Member with all the privileges and responsibilities to the Founders that demands.
STH_dominion_flavour.500.name: New Subject for the Dominion
STH_dominion_flavour.5000.desc: The mighty Dominion has never succeeded by standing still and we have a number of allies within our current alliance who would should welcome the chance to join the Dominion and share in the benefits that all members share. We have identified the targets below with whom we should start to open diplomatic links with and prepare them for the process of signing our treaties and embracing our might. We should be prepared that not all the states may welcome integration, but ultimately only the will of the Great Link matters.
STH_dominion_flavour.5000.name: Expand the Dominion
STH_dominion_flavour.5002.desc: The leaders of [dominionAccessionState.GetName] have seen the wisdom of joining the mighty Dominion to serve the mighty Founders. This is another fabulous day in the history of the Dominion. As the Jem'Hadar would say, Victory is Life.
STH_dominion_flavour.5002.name: New Member of the Dominion
STH_dominion_flavour.5003.a: Very well, you are on your own.
STH_dominion_flavour.5003.b.response: The ethics of the Dominion differ far too much from the core values in which we hold dear. We do not believe in many of the ideals the Dominion hold to.
STH_dominion_flavour.5003.b: May we ask why you have decided this?
STH_dominion_flavour.5003.c.tooltip: If the Dominion is suitably superior to their target, they will be forced to become members of the Dominion.
STH_dominion_flavour.5003.c: Nobody rejects the Dominion, you will join by force.
STH_dominion_flavour.5003.desc: Greetings Founder, I am [dominionAccessionStateRuler.GetName] representing the interests [dominionAccessionState.GetName], we have reviewed the offered membership and we feel that this is not for us. There are too many differences between our cultures and we have concerns about a number of your policies and tactics. Please consider this a formal rejection of your offer.
STH_dominion_flavour.5003.name: Dominion Membership rejected
STH_dominion_flavour.5004.desc: Greetings Founder, on behalf of [dominionAccessionState.GetName], we formally apologise to the benevolent Dominion for any offence created, we were wrong to reject the offer of membership and would like to formally resume the process to join the Dominion.
STH_dominion_flavour.5004.name: Dominion Membership Accepted
STH_dominion_flavour.5005.desc: Founder, on behalf of [dominionAccessionState.GetName], we are a strong and proud people and we will not be bullied into making decisions that to not work in our best interests. No matter how many Jem'Hadar ships we spot at our borders we shall remain independent.
STH_dominion_flavour.5005.name: Dominion Membership rejected
STH_dominion_flavour.5050.desc:
The Founders expect only the best from it's leadership and we have identified the following leaders as falling well below our high standards. By ridding ourselves of this chaff, it shall bring rise to challenge and a better class of scientist. 

The following leaders have been flagged as the weakest in their field 
[dominion_chaff_leader_1.GetName] 
[dominion_chaff_leader_2.GetName] 
[dominion_chaff_leader_3.GetName] 
[dominion_chaff_leader_4.GetName]. 

Removing these leaders wll grant us a smaller pool of better leaders, with a greater incentive to perform.
STH_dominion_flavour.5050.name: We shall find scientists who can...
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.a.tooltip: This choice is only available to the AI.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.b.tooltip: The Dominion will receive 5000 energy credits from our reserves.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.b: Present Energy to run their worlds.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.c.tooltip: The Dominion will receive 5000 minerals, 5000 alloys and 5000 food from our resources.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.c: Gift a sum of materials from our stockpiles.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.d.tooltip: One of our ships will be randomly dismantled in order to provide materials to build the Dominion an additional fleet.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.d: Build them a fleet of warships.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.desc:
Our membership within the mighty Dominion family comes at a price, as loyal servants of the Founders we are required to pay homage to their might and present them with an offering of thanks for their protection and the peace that comes with being part of the mighy Dominion. 

There are a number of items that we could please them and keep the Jem'Hadar from our planets.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.e.tooltip: The starbase within [tribute_system.GetName] will be transfered over to the Dominion along with any planets and resources within it.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.f.tooltip: No tribute will be made to the Dominion and we shall live with the consequences of that decision.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.f: They shall have nothing from us.
STH_dominion_flavour.6001.name: A tribute to the Founders
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.a: This is the order of things.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.desc_01: As should be with the order of things, the solids of [dominion_member_tribute_country1.GetName] have presented us with an offering in praise of all they receive from the Dominion. They have paid tribute to the might and majesty of the Domion with an offering of energy credits to keep the machinery of state moving forward.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.desc_02: As should be with the order of things, the solids of [dominion_member_tribute_country1.GetName] have presented us with an offering in praise of all they receive from the Dominion. They have paid tribute to the might and majesty of the Domion with an offering of valuable resources to keep the machinery of state moving forward.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.desc_03:
As should be with the order of things, the solids of [dominion_member_tribute_country1.GetName] have put their time and effort into delivering us a fleet of warships to supplement our fleets funded and delivered from their own shipyards. 

The new fleet will be presented to us in the coming days.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.desc_04: As should be with the order of things, the solids of [dominion_member_tribute_country1.GetName] have turned over one of their systems, [dominion_member_tribute_system1.GetName] over to our Vorta to administer - along with all the wealth and military installations that come with it.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.desc_05: One of our member worlds, [dominion_member_tribute_country1.GetName] is refusing to pay us the respect and tribute that is owed to us for the protection and safety that comes from being within the Dominion family. As a direct consequence for this act of disrespect our Jem'Hadar troops have destroyed one of their vessels as a reminder of who their masters are.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.desc_06: One of our member worlds, [dominion_member_tribute_country1.GetName] is refusing to pay us the respect and tribute that is owed to us for the protection and safety that comes from being within the Dominion family. As a direct consequence for this act of disrespect our Jem'Hadar ships opened fire on one of their worlds as a reminder of their duty to the Dominion.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.desc_07: One of our member worlds, [dominion_member_tribute_country1.GetName] is refusing to pay us the respect and tribute that is owed to us for the protection and safety that comes from being within the Dominion family. As a direct consequence for this act of disrespect one of our changeling infiltrators has killed their ruler, we shall see if their replacement pays us the respect we are due.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.desc_08: One of our member worlds, [dominion_member_tribute_country1.GetName] is refusing to pay us the respect and tribute that is owed to us for the protection and safety that comes from being within the Dominion family. The Vorta representative to their homeworld has reminded them of their responsibility to the Dominion.
STH_dominion_flavour.6002.name: An offering from one of our Member Worlds
STH_dominion_flavour.6003.desc: Our Vorta administrator relays his thanks for our gracious tribute to the founders and promises the continued protection and support from the benevolant Dominion overlords.
STH_dominion_flavour.6003.name: A tribute to the Founders
STH_dominion_flavour.6004.desc: As we are summoned into the audiance chamber to meet with our Vorta representative, she tells us in no uncertain terms that the punishment we have received at the hands of the Dominion it just a taste of the fury of the Founders and we should be reminded of our obligations to the Dominion family.
STH_dominion_flavour.6004.name: A tribute to the Founders
STH_dominion_flavour.6006.desc: High above the surface of [member_capital_world.GetName], the capital planet of the [dominion_member_tribute_shipbuilder.GetName], the finishing touches are made to the new completed Dominion warships, fashioned from the best resouces from [dominion_member_tribute_shipbuilder.GetName] and presented to the Dominion in thanks for the protection provided.
STH_dominion_flavour.6006.name: A tribute to the Founders
STH_dominion_flavour.6050.a.tooltip: Putting a five year freeze on the production of new Jem'Hadar soldiers should allow us to recuperate and rebuild our stocks of Ketracel White.
STH_dominion_flavour.6050.b.tooltip: Shutting down the combat arenas will prevent the Jem'Hadar burning through their supply of white as fast.
STH_dominion_flavour.6050.c.tooltip: Burn up a natural supply of Sodium to bring a short term bonus of white, but losing the deposit in the process.
STH_dominion_flavour.6050.desc: The Ketracel White shortages befalling The Dominon are becoming increasingly problematic. It is clear that we will have to take decisive action, otherwise the shortages will result in complete loss of control over our Jem'Hadar forces within a matter of months.
STH_dominion_flavour.6050.name: Serious Ketracel White Shortages
STH_dominion_flavour.6050.z: We shall trust in the Founders.
STH_dominion_flavour.6052.desc:
As feared our supply of Ketracel White has now reached critical levels, with Vorta reporting outages across the Dominion. 

Our Jem'Hadar population is rapidly sucomming to the effects of Ketracel White withdrawal in greater numbers, growing increasingly violent before dying a painful, but unfortunate death. 

To ensure the safety of the Founders all remaining Jem'Hadar must be purged.
STH_dominion_flavour.6052.name: Critical Ketracel White Shortage
STH_dominion_flavour.6070.desc:
Being a Dominion Member is the ultimate honour for a solid, to serve the Founders should be the goal of all states. 

Promote one of our vassals to a fully-fledged Dominion Member with all the perks that come with that.
STH_dominion_flavour.6070.name: Promote a Vassal State
STH_dominion_story.1.desc: A thought has spread throughout the Great Link: to understand the Solids we must live as them again. By sending a hundred of our spawn out into the galaxy, they may return in due course with invaluable information on the threats that could affect our people.
STH_dominion_story.1.name: The Hundred
STH_dominion_story.100.desc: The survey of [From.GetName] is complete. Initial indications are confirmed - nothing unusual has been detected.
STH_dominion_story.100.name: Anomalous Substance
STH_dominion_story.101.desc_01:
While surveying [From.GetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName]'s science officer has detected an anomalous morphogenic fluid pooled at the bottom of a natural crevice on the planet's northern hemisphere. 

It appears to exhibit some capacity for independent movement, however full analysis will require the facilities aboard the [Root.GetFleetName]. 

A substantial effort will be required to safely penetrate a naturally shielded layer of rock preventing easier extraction.
STH_dominion_story.101.desc_02:
While surveying [From.GetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName]'s science officer has detected a morphogenic fluid pooled at the bottom of a natural crevice on the planet's eastern hemisphere, displaying properties similar to juvenile changelings encountered elsewhere in the galaxy. 

It appears to exhibit some capacity for independent movement, however full analysis will require the facilities aboard the [Root.GetFleetName]. 

A substantial effort will be required to safely penetrate a naturally shielded layer of rock preventing easier extraction.
STH_dominion_story.101.desc_03:
While surveying [From.GetName], [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName]'s science officer has detected a morphogenic fluid pooled at the bottom of a natural crevice on the planet's western hemisphere, displaying properties similar to the Founders of the Dominion. 

It appears to exhibit some capacity for independent movement, however full analysis will require the facilities aboard the [Root.GetFleetName]. 

A substantial effort will be required to safely penetrate a naturally shielded layer of rock preventing easier extraction.
STH_dominion_story.101.desc_04:
While surveying [From.GetName], the [Root.GetFleetName] has detected a morphogenic fluid pooled at the bottom of a natural crevice on the planet's southern hemisphere, displaying properties similar to honoured Founders. 

It appears to exhibit some capacity for independent movement, however full analysis to determine it's godhood will require the facilities aboard the [Root.GetFleetName]. 

A substantial effort will be required to safely penetrate a naturally shielded layer of rock preventing easier extraction.
STH_dominion_story.101.name: Anomalous Substance
STH_dominion_story.102.d: Return the Founder to the Great Link.
STH_dominion_story.102.desc_01:
The anomalous morphogenic fluid has been safely brought aboard the [Root.GetFleetName]. [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] quickly determines that the substance is incomparable to anything discovered before, seeming to react to the various scanning techniques employed toward it. 

The resources available aboard ship are insufficient to proceed with study.
STH_dominion_story.102.desc_02:
The anomalous morphogenic fluid has been safely brought aboard the [Root.GetFleetName] and is confirmed to be a juvenile changeling. 

The resources available aboard ship are insufficient to proceed with the tutoring the infant would require in order to learn how to interact with non-changelings.
STH_dominion_story.102.desc_03:
The anomalous morphogenic fluid has been safely brought aboard the [Root.GetFleetName] and is confirmed to be a juvenile changeling. 

The resources available aboard ship are insufficient to proceed with the tutoring the infant would require in order to learn how to interact with non-changelings. 

[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] worries about a potential military response should [changeling_empire.GetName] be alerted to the presence of the changeling aboard a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] vessel.
STH_dominion_story.102.desc_04: The loyal servants of the Founders aboard the [Root.GetFleetName] are truly blessed, as the morphogenic fluid is confirmed to be of a kin with the gods.
STH_dominion_story.102.name: Anomalous Substance
STH_dominion_story.105.borg.desc:
While surveying [From.GetName], [Root.GetFleetName] has detected an anomalous morphogenic fluid pooled at the bottom of a natural crevice on the planet's northern hemisphere. 

It appears to exhibit some capacity for independent movement, however full analysis will require the further analysis.
STH_dominion_story.105.desc.borg:
While surveying [From.GetName], [Root.GetFleetName] has detected an anomalous morphogenic fluid pooled at the bottom of a natural crevice on the planet's northern hemisphere. 

It appears to exhibit some capacity for independent movement, however full analysis will require the further analysis.
STH_dominion_story.105.desc:
While surveying [From.GetName], [Root.GetFleetName] has detected an anomalous morphogenic fluid pooled at the bottom of a natural crevice on the planet's northern hemisphere.

It appears to exhibit some capacity for independent movement; however, full analysis will require the further study.
STH_dominion_story.105.name: Anomalous Substance
STH_dominion_story.110.desc_01:
Facilities on [Root.Capital.GetName] have made some progress understanding the properties of the morphogenic fluid. It appears to contain neural-like properties in a highly distributed topology. 

Exposure to various electromagnetic stimuli could be one path to a more fully analysis, however the equipment required is not standard issue.
STH_dominion_story.110.desc_02:
Facilities on [Root.Capital.GetName] have made some progress eliciting a response from the infant changeling. It appears to have developed its neural-like properties to a level sufficient to be aware of its surroundings. 

Exposure to various electromagnetic stimuli could help speed its development, however the equipment required is not standard issue.
STH_dominion_story.110.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.111.desc_01:
Having been exposed to Kappa-band radiation, the morphogenic fluid has demonstrated what appears to be awareness of the stimuli. During the experiment the fluid appeared to create an elongated tendril which pushed the scientist conducting the experiment away from their console. 

With the radiation removed, the fluid returned to its original state. Researchers believe the fluid to be a life form, and recommend bringing in a team of xenobiologists to complete the study.
STH_dominion_story.111.desc_02:
Having been exposed to Kappa-band radiation, the changeling infant has demonstrated its first signs of awareness toward the stimuli. During the experiment the changeling created an elongated tendril which pushed the scientist conducting the experiment away from their console. 

Researchers believe it is now time to bring in a team of xenobiologists to complete the next stage of the changeling's development.
STH_dominion_story.111.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.113.desc_01:
The morphogenic fluid has been confirmed as a lifeform after it appeared to reform itself into an imperfect replica of the lead xenobiologist assigned to the project. 

The being appears to be trying to communicate with the research staff. The project overseer has requested the assignment of a xeno anthropological team.
STH_dominion_story.113.desc_02:
The changeling has progressed well, having form itself into an imperfect replica of the lead xenobiologist assigned to the project. 

The infant appears to be trying to communicate with the research staff. The project overseer has requested the assignment of a xeno anthropological team.
STH_dominion_story.113.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.114.desc_01: The lead xenoanthropologist assigned to the changeling - a term coined by the spouse of the project lead - has successfully taught the being to communicate verbally. Having formed itself into crude representation of a [Root.GetSpeciesName], it has begun to question its position in [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] society.
STH_dominion_story.114.desc_02: The lead xenoanthropologist assigned to the changeling has successfully taught the being to communicate verbally. Having formed itself into crude representation of a [Root.GetSpeciesName], it has begun to question its position in [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] society.
STH_dominion_story.114.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.120.desc: [changeling_empire.GetName] acknowledges and welcomes your actions on this matter.
STH_dominion_story.120.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.121.a: Perhaps some Solids can be trusted.
STH_dominion_story.121.desc: The [From.GetName] has returned an infant Founder to the [Root.GetName]!
STH_dominion_story.121.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.130.a: We ask only to cover our costs.
STH_dominion_story.130.b: Surely a modest reward is in order?
STH_dominion_story.130.c: We know how much you value the changeling!
STH_dominion_story.130.d: You misunderstand, this is our gift...
STH_dominion_story.130.desc: You dare to attempt to blackmail us? What do you expect out of this?
STH_dominion_story.130.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.131.a: It is a price worth paying.
STH_dominion_story.131.desc:
This is [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName]. We have recently recovered what appears to be an infant changeling. 

In order to return it to its people, we would request a small amount of compensation for our efforts - 100 £ and 100 £.
STH_dominion_story.131.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.132.a: It is a price worth paying.
STH_dominion_story.132.desc:
This is [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName]. We have recently recovered what appears to be an infant changeling. 

In order to return it to its people, we would expect a modest reward for our help in the matter - 250 £ and 250 £.
STH_dominion_story.132.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.133.a: It is a price worth paying.
STH_dominion_story.133.desc:
This is [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName]. We have recently recovered what appears to be an infant changeling. 

In order to return it to its people, we would expect a substantial reward for our help in the matter - 500 £ and 500 £. 

We know how much the changeling means to you...
STH_dominion_story.133.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.134.a: Perhaps some Solids can be trusted.
STH_dominion_story.134.desc:
This is [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] of the [From.GetName]. We have recently recovered what appears to be an infant changeling. 

In order to facilitate good relations between our peoples, we will deliver it to a location of your designation.
STH_dominion_story.134.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.135.desc: [changeling_empire.GetName] acknowledges and welcomes your actions on this matter.
STH_dominion_story.135.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.136.desc: [changeling_empire.GetName] agrees to your request but make no mistake, you have our... attention.
STH_dominion_story.136.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.137.desc: [changeling_empire.GetName] rejects your pathetic demands. We will annihilate your fleets ship by ship until you return what is ours.
STH_dominion_story.137.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.138.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.139.desc: With the rejection of the [Root.GetName]'s offer to return the changeling infant, several research times have requested permission to study it as they attempt to teach it to communicate.
STH_dominion_story.139.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.140.desc: The Founder discovered on [From.GetName] has been returned to the Great Link where it belongs.
STH_dominion_story.140.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.150.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], I am [changeling_leader.GetName] - the 'changeling' your scientists have recently guided along to sentience. I am grateful to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people for having raised me and taught me how to master my shapeshifting abilities. 

I would very much wish to serve in any capacity I can.
STH_dominion_story.150.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.151.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], I am [changeling_leader.GetName] - the 'changeling' your scientists have recently prodded along to sentience. I am grateful to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people for having taught me how to master my shapeshifting abilities. 

I am prepared to serve in a capacity that fits my skills.
STH_dominion_story.151.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.152.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], I am [changeling_leader.GetName] - the 'changeling' your scientists have recently prodded along to sentience. While I am grateful to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people for having taught me how to master my shapeshifting abilities, I feel it is now time for me to explore the galaxy on my own. There is much to experience!
STH_dominion_story.152.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.153.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], I am [changeling_leader.GetName] - the 'changeling' your scientists have recently prodded along to sentience. While I am grateful to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people for having taught me how to master my shapeshifting abilities, I feel it is now time for me to return to my own people. The [changeling_empire.GetName] will return me to my home.
STH_dominion_story.153.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.154.desc:
I am [changeling_leader.GetName], and I believe I am a Founder. 

The [FromFrom.GetName] raised me to sentience, but is now time for me to embrace the Great Link!
STH_dominion_story.154.name: The Changeling
STH_dominion_story.160.desc: [From.GetName] has improved [From.GetHerHis] shape shifting skills significantly over [From.GetHerHis] time in the [Root.GetName]. [From.GetName] now feels comfortable enough replicating a typical [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]'s appearance.
STH_dominion_story.160.name: [From.GetName]
STH_dominion_story.2.a: Separate one into a hundred and spread them amongst the stars.
STH_dominion_story.2.desc:
The Hundred have been separated from the Link and sent out into the galaxy. A hundred capsules have been dispersed in every direction. 

The Link yearns now for the day when it will be made whole again - though it recognises the value the project offers.
STH_dominion_story.2.name: The Hundred
STH_dominion_story.201.c: They pose no threat to the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.201.desc: Wise Founder, we have picked up long range sightings of vessels from the Alpha Quadrant coming through the wormhole anomaly in the Idran System. These advances bring them closer to Dominion held territory , it appears they are unaware that we are observing their movements.Our Jem'Hadar forces could launch a number of tactical strikes against these ships and spread the warning that the Gamma Quadrant is out of bounds.
STH_dominion_story.201.name: Incursion into the Gamma Quadrant
STH_dominion_story.202.desc: It is time to review our policy on the continued incursions into the Gamma Quadrant, we can target the vessels using the Idran anomaly or we can invest in other efforts, the decision is yours wise Founder.
STH_dominion_story.202.name: Review Incursion Policy
STH_dominion_story.204.desc: Whilst engaging in operations within the Gamma Quadrant, one of our ships the [dominion_fleet_target_1.GetName] was attacked by unknown assailants, the ship took light damage in the hit and run attack and was unable to get a solid scan of the ships that attacked. One observer described 'bug-shaped' fighters that moved with dazzling speed and coordination.
STH_dominion_story.204.name: Vessel damaged whilst in the Gamma Quadrant
STH_dominion_story.205.desc: Our Jem'Hadar fighters were able to inflict damage against the ships from the [dominion_fleet_target_1.owner.GetName] whilst they were out exploring close to Dominion borders. As per the plan we left the ship intact and with survivors to ensure the message that the Gamma Quadrant is off limits.
STH_dominion_story.205.name: Enemy Ship Ambushed
STH_dominion_story.206.b: We must uncover the source of these attacks.
STH_dominion_story.206.desc: Whilst engaging in operations within the Gamma Quadrant, one of our ships the [dominion_fleet_target_1.GetName] was attacked by unknown assailants, the ship took significant damage in the hit and run attack and was unable to get a solid scan of the ships that attacked. Our sensors were badly damaged in the initial attack but were able to confirm the attackers used Polaran weaponry. The intent of the attack was clear, this was a warning to stay out of the Gamma Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.206.name: Vessel damaged whilst in the Gamma Quadrant
STH_dominion_story.207.desc: Our Jem'Hadar fighters were able to inflict major damage against the ships from the [dominion_fleet_target_2.owner.GetName] as part of a hit and run attack against their fleets bordering our space. As per the plan we left the ship intact and with survivors to ensure the message that the Gamma Quadrant is off limits.
STH_dominion_story.207.name: Enemy Ship Ambushed
STH_dominion_story.208.a: We cannot let these attacks continue.
STH_dominion_story.208.desc: Whilst engaging in operations within the Gamma Quadrant, one of our ships the [dominion_fleet_target_1.GetName] was attacked by unknown assailants, the ship took significant damage in the hit and run attack and was unable to get a solid scan of the ships that attacked. Our sensors were badly damaged in the initial attack but were able to confirm the attackers used Polaran weaponry. The intent of the attack was clear, this was a warning to stay out of the Gamma Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.208.name: Vessel destroyed whilst on patrol in the Gamma Quadrant
STH_dominion_story.209.desc: Our Jem'Hadar fighters have inflicted the ultimate punishment on [dominion_fleet_target_2.owner.GetName] for daring to trespass beyond the wormhole and into the domain of the Dominion, the solids will think twice before continuing their advances into the Gamma Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.209.name: Enemy Ship Destroyed
STH_dominion_story.210.desc_01: Since making our first trip through the wormhole discovered in the Bajoran system we have been attacked numerous times by an unknown foe including the destruction of one of our ships with the loss of all crew onboard. This attacker knows the territory and must be looking to ward us off further exploration within the Gamma Quadrant. We have sufficient evidence from the attacks to begin to piece together the clues and understand who is targeting our ships.
STH_dominion_story.210.desc_02: Since making our first trip through the wormhole discovered in the Bajoran system we have been attacked numerous times by an unknown foe. One that knows the territory and is looking to ward us off further exploration within the Gamma Quadrant. We have sufficient evidence from the attacks to begin to piece together the clues and understand who is targeting our ships.
STH_dominion_story.210.name: Numerous ships missing or damaged in the Gamma Quadrant
STH_dominion_story.211.a: Inform the Dominion these attacks will not be tolerated.
STH_dominion_story.211.b: Make no further gestures towards the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.211.c: Promise to stay out of the Gamma Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.211.desc_01: After analysing the sensor logs and first hand accounts from those involved we have identified the attackers as the Dominion, a powerful interstellar state in the Gamma Quadrant. Technologically advanced and hostile the attacks were clearly meant as a threat to our ongoing exploration and advancement beyond the terminus of the Bajoran Wormhole.
STH_dominion_story.211.desc_02: After analysing the sensor logs and first hand accounts from those involved we have identified the attackers as an interstellar state known locally as the Dominion, reports and feedback from other friendlier species all state that the Dominion are a power to treat with caution. Their attacks are a warning that they will not tolerate further ventures close to their borders.
STH_dominion_story.211.name: The Dominion behind the attacks
STH_dominion_story.212.a: All fleets must travel at alert status.
STH_dominion_story.212.desc: Despite sifting through the logs, sensor readings and accounts from those involved we were unable to identify who has been attacking our fleets, we must continue to maintain extreme caution whilst on the far side of the wormhole.
STH_dominion_story.212.name: Unable to uncover the attackers
STH_dominion_story.213.desc: It looks like the [dominionTarget.owner.GetName] have finally discovered that we have been targeting their ships, making further ambushes against them impossible. We await a formal response from them.
STH_dominion_story.213.name: Our attacks discovered
STH_dominion_story.214.desc: It seems that the invaders have more teeth than expected and they have reacted angrily and with a lack of judgement we have come to expect from the Solids. We can expect further incursions into our surrounding spaces and so we must be prepared to meet this with our own show of strength, for this is the only way they will learn.
STH_dominion_story.214.name: Angry response from Alpha Quadrant
STH_dominion_story.215.desc: As predicted by the Vorta the Alpha Quadrant trespassers have reacted cautiously to the discovery that we have been targeting their ships. It is unlikely that further hit and run attacks will be successful. However relations between our two states remains tense.
STH_dominion_story.215.name: Cautious response from Alpha Quadrant Race
STH_dominion_story.216.a: We will not be bound by such an agreement.
STH_dominion_story.216.desc: Our efforts to keep the Alpha Quadrant races out of our territories and potential expansion sectors of the Dominion has been successful. We have received a message offering a truce, the [dominionTarget.owner.GetName] will no longer travel beyond the anomaly they call the Bajoran Wormhole and we will not venture into the Alpha Quadrant. Breaching this agreement will be seen as an act of hostility.
STH_dominion_story.216.name: Offer for a truce received
STH_dominion_story.217.desc: In a message from a Vorta representative of the Dominion, they have agreed to the truce and restrictions on either side travelling via the wormhole in the Bajoran system. Any further travel whilst the agreement is in place will result in a resumption of hostilities and a worsening of the relationship between both sides.
STH_dominion_story.217.name: Truce accepted
STH_dominion_story.218.desc: The Dominion have rejected our offer and in a statement by the Vorta representative they state that all ships must return to the Alpha Quadrant immediately and remain on that side of the wormhole. However the Dominion will not restrict themselves from further possibilities within the Alpha and Beta Quadrants and we would be wise to consider joining the mighty and benevolent Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.218.name: Truce rejected
STH_dominion_story.219.desc: We have passed notice to the races of the Alpha & Beta Quadrants that we no longer tolerate their presence in the Gamma Quadrant. We must live up to our promise that the might of the Dominion will be maintained.
STH_dominion_story.219.name: Truce rejected
STH_dominion_story.223.desc: Mighty Founder, it is with great regret that we must inform the Great Link that the truce arranged with the Solids from the Alpha Quadrant has been broken, one of their ships has travelled through the wormhole into space bordering the Dominion territory. Our trust in the [dominionTarget.owner.GetName] has been broken and they have made a foolish mistake in believing they can challenge the might of the Dominion and the wisdom of the Founders.
STH_dominion_story.223.name: Truce broken!
STH_dominion_story.224.a: Reach out to the Cardassian Union.
STH_dominion_story.224.desc: Oh wise Founder, our long range scans have picked up vessels from an empire calling themselves the Cardassian Union having recently passed via the anomaly in the Idran system. Our intel confirms what we have suspected, the Cardassians are a proud, yet weak species who would be a prime target to be absorbed into the might of the Dominion giving us a key strategic foothold into the Alpha Quadrant. What do our god's command us to do?
STH_dominion_story.224.name: Contact from the Cardassian Union
STH_dominion_story.225.desc: [Root.GetTitle][Root.GetRulerName] we have been approached by a Vorta from the Dominion on the far side of the Bajoran wormhole, they are offering an opportunity to build further relationships with the Cardassian Union. They appreciate our strength and power and believe we would be worthy allies and invite a further bond which could make both states stronger.
STH_dominion_story.225.name: Contact from The Dominion
STH_dominion_story.226.desc: The Cardassians have responded favourably towards our contact and our suggestions, we should continue to build on this opening and look to further exploit their arrogance and pride. In time we may need their meager offerings as a staging ground for further advances into the Alpha Quadrant to bring the rule of the Dominion over this space.
STH_dominion_story.226.name: Acceptance from the Cardassians
STH_dominion_story.227.desc: It looks like Cardassian pride has prevented them accepting our offer of friendship and support, this is disappointing, but there will be further opportunities to take advantage of their weakness and bring them closer to the rule of the Founders.
STH_dominion_story.227.name: Rejection from the Cardassians
STH_dominion_story.230.a.response: Giving them these cloaking devices will allow us to gain more information on the Founders, and a new target should they fail.
STH_dominion_story.230.desc:
Praetor, our spies monitoring activity in the Gamma Quadrant are growing increasingly concerned about the rising threat of the Dominion and their Founder masters. Their activities and the potential threat they now pose to the Alpha and Beta Quadrants cannot be ignored, we should offer [dominionTarget.GetName] one of our cloaking techs to better allow them to investigate the threat. 

This also serves the purpose of providing the Dominion with a focus outside of the Star Empire...
STH_dominion_story.230.name: Tal Shiar Report
STH_dominion_story.231.b: We do not need your help.
STH_dominion_story.231.desc_01: Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] we bring you an offer from your friends in the Romulan Empire, we are aware of the potential threat from the Dominion that you have been dealing with and we offer you our support and despite the treaty banning your use of cloaking devices we would present you the tech to equip on your warships to confront the Dominion. In return we ask for reseach you may obtain and that one of our officers over sees the operations.
STH_dominion_story.231.desc_02: Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] we bring you an offer from your friends in the Romulan Empire, we are aware of the potential threat from the Dominion that you have been dealing with and we offer you our support and the use of our cloaking devices, to be equipped on your warships to confront the Dominion. In return we ask for research you may obtain and that one of our officers oversees the operations.
STH_dominion_story.231.name: Support from the Romulans
STH_dominion_story.232.desc:
Reports are coming into the Link that there have been more incursions into our space from the solids on the far side of the Idran anomaly. It is now increasingly clear that they do not respect our borders or fear our threats. 

It is time we lured them into a situation they cannot refuse and demonstrate the true power of the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.232.name: Encroaching Threat from the Solids
STH_dominion_story.233.desc:
Greetings I am [research_gamma_leader.GetName] over the last few months we have been sending probes out through the Bajoran Wormhole to investigate what's out there. 

We've had time to analyse the results and have come up with a number of places that we would like to send a small expedition to investigate further.
STH_dominion_story.233.name: New data from the Gamma Quadrant
STH_dominion_story.234.desc: It appears that the Solids in charge of the major Alpha Quadrant races are too cowardly to take our bait, we shall have to try a more direct approach.
STH_dominion_story.234.name: No sign of the Alpha Quadrant
STH_dominion_story.235.desc:
Our listening posts have detected movement from the Idran Anomaly, it appears the solids are too greedy for new chances to encroach on our territory. The Vorta have confirmed that the trap has been set and the Jem'Hadar lay in wait for their prey. 

Soon they will learn to fear the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.235.name: The trap has been sprung
STH_dominion_story.236.a: We've lost comms with the team.
STH_dominion_story.236.desc: Science officer [research_gamma_leader.GetName] reporting from [idran_moon_location.GetName], our small team has deployed to the planet's surface and are investigating the ruins of a long-lost society, the ruins seem to date back thousands of years. The local plant life is extremely dense and we have collected a number of... hold on our motion sensors have just gone off... detecting movement at the edge of camp... <STATIC.... TRANSMISSION ENDED>.
STH_dominion_story.236.name: Inbound Science Report
STH_dominion_story.238.desc: Our failure to complete the mission has wasted a number of key resources dedicated to exploration of the Gamma Quadrant. The Science Council has decided to hold of on any further expeditions for the moment.
STH_dominion_story.238.name: Mission Incomplete
STH_dominion_story.239.desc: It seems the Solids have no desire to challenge us any further and are making no move to rescue their captured companions. Perhaps the message has been delivered.
STH_dominion_story.239.name: Cowards
STH_dominion_story.240.a.response: <Steps through field with ease> Such primative means.
STH_dominion_story.240.b.response: The Gamma Quadrant belongs to the Dominion, be grateful we allow you to keep your own pitiful corner of the galaxy.
STH_dominion_story.240.c.response: They are prisoners of the Dominion and will die as enemies of the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.240.desc:
<Red Alert, intruder detected> 

 I am [jemhadar_gamma_leader.GetName] and I speak for the Dominion. We have captured your science team for the crime of trespassing on our territory, they are now prisoners of the Dominion and will be executed for their crimes. 

Further attempts to travel beyond the anomaly will be seen as an act of hostility and met with a show of force, this will be your only warning.
STH_dominion_story.240.e: Abandon the scientist to their fate.
STH_dominion_story.240.name: The Jem'Hadar
STH_dominion_story.241.a: Move on before the Jem'Hadar Show up.
STH_dominion_story.241.desc:
As our fleet arrives at the last known destination of the Science team a quick scan of the planet reveals no signs of life, the [Root.GetName] camp appears to have been ransacked. 

Further investigations shows signs of an attempted escape that was unsuccessful, the bodies of our officers left where they fell. 

Back in orbit our sensors detect signs of debris, we must presume this is all that remains of the science craft sent to study this planet.
STH_dominion_story.241.name: Science Team Fail to Escape
STH_dominion_story.242.desc: The Vorta in charge of the prisoners from the Alpha Quadrant has reported that they have attempted to escape, and during their attempt, they were shot and killed by the shrouded Jem'Hadar who were guarding our facility.
STH_dominion_story.242.name: Science Team Fail to Escape
STH_dominion_story.243.desc:
This is [research_gamma_rescue_leader] reporting in, we have reached the last known location of the research team and are detecting signs of a struggle on the planet below. It looks like the Science team have escaped their captors. 

We have managed to get them back to their vessel, however my tactical officer has detected warp signatures inbound, the scientists will not survive against the Jem'Hadar for long.
STH_dominion_story.243.name: The Search
STH_dominion_story.244.desc:
Despite an intense battle, our fleet was able to fend off the attack by the Jem'Hadar who fought down to the last ship. We should look to return to safe space and re-group. 

Hold on we are picking up a damaged Jem'Hadar fighter making a direct run for one of our ships.
STH_dominion_story.244.name: Jem'Hadar Ambushed Defeated
STH_dominion_story.245.desc:
We have lost contact with our fleet sent into the Gamma Quadrant, it appears that they were engaged and defeated by an ambush orchestrated by the Dominion. 

We should take stock of the damage and begin plans to fortify our borders.
STH_dominion_story.245.name: The Search
STH_dominion_story.246.desc:
The Jem'Hadar fighter makes a destructive run towards [jemhadar_target_ship.GetName], the vessel's Warp engines are still damaged from the battle, and response time a fraction too slow. 

The Jem'Hadar ship collides with [jemhadar_target_ship.GetName] destroying both ships in a firey explosion. 

Is there no limit to what the Jem'Hadar will do in order to serve the Dominion?
STH_dominion_story.246.name: The Search
STH_dominion_story.247.a: They will come to fear us.
STH_dominion_story.247.desc: Our Jem'Hadar forces successfully engaged the Alpha Quadrant forces inflicting severe casualties on them, they have since retreated back to their side of the galaxy.
STH_dominion_story.247.name: Ambush
STH_dominion_story.248.desc:
The science team engages their warp engines and escapes the ongoing battle, it is clear the tide of the battle is not going our way as the Jem'Hadar forces continue to attack the fleet. 

The Captain orders a full retreat and as the fleet turns to escape, one ship appears to be suffering from damage to their port nacelle, sensing this weakness a Jem'Hadar fighter quickly engages in a suicide run and collides with the ship destroying both vessels in a bright blaze of light.
STH_dominion_story.248.name: The Search
STH_dominion_story.249.desc: Our Jem'Hadar forces successfully engaged the Alpha Quadrant forces inflicting severe casualties on them, they have since retreated back to their side of the galaxy. As they attempted to flee our loyal Jem'Hadar soldiers taught them a lesson they will not soon forget.
STH_dominion_story.249.name: Ambush
STH_dominion_story.301.desc_01:
Our first step in conquering the Alpha Quadrant is capturing and securing the anomaly also known as the Bajoran Wormhole. 

Our spies within the Alpha Quadrant have confirmed that the system is owned by a the [bajor_overlord_owned.GetName] who are the overlords to a primitive race known as the Bajorans. Our Jem'Hadar forces are confident that they could best this race in open combat, however the Vorta advise reaching out in an attempt to negotiate access.
STH_dominion_story.301.desc_02:
Our first step in conquering the Alpha Quadrant is capturing and securing the anomaly also known as the Bajoran Wormhole. 

Our spies within the Alpha Quadrant have confirmed that the system is owned by a primitive race of religious fanatics known as the Bajorans. Their military might is nothing in comparison to the force of our Jem'Hadar warriors. We should contact them and demand access via the wormhole.
STH_dominion_story.301.desc_03:
Our first step in conquering the Alpha Quadrant is capturing and securing the anomaly also known as the Bajoran Wormhole. 

Our Founders within the Alpha Quadrant have confirmed that the system is owned by a government who call themselves the United Federation of Planets an organisation that pride themselves in interfering in affairs that should not concern them. They would make a fine challenge for the Jem'Hadar, but we should open communications to avoid a war on multiple fronts.
STH_dominion_story.301.desc_04: Our envoys to the Cardassian Union confirm that they have already secured the anomaly within the Bajoran system, which will give us access to the Alpha Quadrant and make an important staging ground for our assault.
STH_dominion_story.301.name: Apocalypse Rising
STH_dominion_story.302.a.response: All we ask for is safe passage for a few envoy ships. Our intent is peaceful.
STH_dominion_story.302.a: What do you want from us Vorta?
STH_dominion_story.302.b.response: We mean to only bring peace... these battleships are peacekeeping ships. We promise.
STH_dominion_story.302.c.response: Yes, we need access to aid our poor Cardassian fellows out.
STH_dominion_story.302.d.response: You would be a most welcomed member of the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.302.desc_01: Greetings [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] from your neighbours in the Gamma Quadrant. We offer hearty greetings and respect from the Dominion, as you maybe aware our valued friends the Cardassians have recently been attacked without provocation and have asked us to speak with [cardassian_dom_enemy.GetName] to help resolve any animosity. All we request is access via your territory and should you like an invitation to join our mighty family.
STH_dominion_story.302.desc_02: Greetings [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] from your neighbours in the Gamma Quadrant. We offer hearty greetings and respect from the Dominion, as you maybe aware our valued friends the Cardassians have recently been attacked without provocation and have asked us to speak with [cardassian_dom_enemy.GetName] to help resolve any animosity, we are sure an empire as powerful as yourselves can appreciate the damage done to the Cardassian pride. All we request is free access via your territory and should you like what you see in the Dominion, you are welcome to apply to join our ranks.
STH_dominion_story.302.desc_03:
Greetings [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] from your neighbours in the Gamma Quadrant. We offer hearty greetings and respect from the Dominion and offer a warm hand of friendship to the United Federation of Planets, as you maybe aware our valued friends the Cardassians have recently been attacked without provocation and have asked us to speak with [cardassian_dom_enemy.GetName] to help resolve any animosity, we are sure an empire as powerful as yourselves can appreciate the damage done to the Cardassian pride. 

All we request is free access via your territory and should you like what you see in the Dominion, you are welcome to apply to join our ranks.
STH_dominion_story.302.desc_04: Greetings to our Cardassian members, we are ready to being our offensive against [cardassian_dom_enemy.GetName], we are pleased that you have already secured access via the wormhole in the Bajoran system. Our forces will arrive shortly.
STH_dominion_story.302.e.response: You will not regret this decision.
STH_dominion_story.302.f.response: You will regret this rash action.
STH_dominion_story.302.f: You are not welcome in our space.
STH_dominion_story.302.name: Apocalypse Rising
STH_dominion_story.303.desc: [quadrant_invasion_gatekeeper.GetName] have agreed to become the newest members of the mighty Dominion. We have send teams to help integrate them into the Dominion. This gives us free access via the wormhole into the depths of the Alpha Quadrant. Our root to war is now open.
STH_dominion_story.303.name: [quadrant_invasion_gatekeeper.GetName] joins the Dominion
STH_dominion_story.304.desc: In a shock move [dominion_recruit.GetName] has joined the Dominion, which gives the Founders a key foothold into the Alpha Quadrant and access to reinforcements. Many experts believe this is the first step towards a large incursion into the Alpha and Beta Quadrants.
STH_dominion_story.304.name: [dominion_recruit.GetName] has joined the Dominion
STH_dominion_story.305.desc: Our Vorta diplomats have successfully been able secure us safe passage via the Wormhole in the Bajoran system. This will allow us to move our ships freely back and forth between the Alpha and Gamma Quadrants as the Jem'Hadar say, Victory is life.
STH_dominion_story.305.name: Passage through the wormhole granted
STH_dominion_story.306.b: We shall keep an eye on you.
STH_dominion_story.306.c: We do not believe your lies!
STH_dominion_story.306.desc:
Greeting [Root.GetRulerTitle] you may have heard that our fleets have secured access to the Alpha Quadrant and you maybe concerned given your recent history with our ally Cardassia. We want to assure you our fleets are only here to provide protection and much needed morale support for our friends. 

We mean you no hard and only wish to co-exist peacefully with our neighbours and friends on this side of the wormhole.
STH_dominion_story.306.name: A Time to Stand
STH_dominion_story.307.desc_01:
It is pleasant to see that the Dominion mean no harm and come only with peaceful intentions, this news will provide reassuring comfort to those across our planets and particularly on [Root.capital_scope.GetName] who were concerned about a new major power on this side of the wormhole. 

As a famous Terran once said, there shall be 'Peace for our time'.
STH_dominion_story.307.desc_02:
The Vorta's claims have fooled no one, this build up of troops and ships heading to Cardassia is clearly the preamble to a full scale invasion. Whilst our diplomats parrot back pleasantries to the Dominion we must prepare our forces and gather any allies we can find. 

War will be upon us soon.
STH_dominion_story.307.desc_03:
Our clear calling out of the Dominions intentions have cut through all of the Vorta's lies and deception. We know war is inevitable and so do the Changelings, there is little point in pretending otherwise. We must gather our forces and prepare for battle. 

As the Klingons say 'Today is a good day to die'.
STH_dominion_story.307.desc_04: Our Dominion allies have secured passage through the wormhole and are staging their forces ready to engage and defeat our enemies. The time for our revenge is at hand and Cardassia will be a force to be feared once again.
STH_dominion_story.307.name: A Time to Stand
STH_dominion_story.308.desc:
The time has come, the uneasy truce between the powers of the Alpha Quadrant and the master of the Gamma Quadrant is at an end. It is time to announce our intent and launch a full scale invasion of the Alpha and Beta Quadrants to bring them under the control of the Dominion. All major powers on that side of the wormhole will be put on notice that they should submit to the might of the Founders. 

War has come.
STH_dominion_story.308.name: A Sacrifice of Angels
STH_dominion_story.309.a: Declare war to conquer the Alpha Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.309.desc:
The Alpha Quadrant is rife for invasion and our fleets are ready to attack, we should look to secure the Bajoran wormhole regardless of any previous agreement as this would be key to ensuring that any reinforcements are available to us. We should be prepared that the powers of the Alpha Quadrant may band together to protect themselves, but they are no match to our superior forces. 

We shall declare war on Cardassia's enemies and anyone blocking us from access to the Alpha Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.309.name: A Sacrifice of Angels
STH_dominion_story.310.desc: The standoff between the forces from the Gamma Quadrant and their Cardassian allies has come to an end with a declaration of War. The Dominion want control over all races across the quadrant and will not stop until that goal has been achieved. We must stand firm and hold back the tide, whilst our diplomats work in the background to drum up support from other empires on our side of the wormhole.
STH_dominion_story.310.name: Favour the bold
STH_dominion_story.311.desc: The time many have feared has come, the cold war between the Dominion and a number of key powers in the Alpha Quadrant has reached boiling point and full-scale war has been declared. Time will tell who shall come out on top.
STH_dominion_story.311.name: Favour the bold
STH_dominion_story.312.desc:
The war continues to rage on, with both sides taking heavy losses. We have managed to bring a number of other empires to the negotiating table to join the war on our side. 

We should focus on bringing at least one empire into the war to help defend the Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.312.name: Rocks and Shoals
STH_dominion_story.313.a: Join the war against the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.313.b.response: The battle will come to you soon enough.
STH_dominion_story.313.c: Join the war on the Dominion's side.
STH_dominion_story.313.desc:
Hello, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. 

We reach out to you whilst in the depths of a battle for the future of the Alpha Quadrant against the combined forces of the Cardassian Union and the Dominion. We urgently request any assistance you can provide and remind everyone that the Dominion will not stop until they control the whole quadrant. 

This is our time to stand united.
STH_dominion_story.313.name: A Time to Stand
STH_dominion_story.314.desc: Our recent victory over the Cardassian Union appears to have been short lived. We now appear to be the target of the Cardassians new ally the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.314.name: Cardassian revenge
STH_dominion_story.315.desc: The Dominion War has potentially hit a turning point as [dominion_war_joiner_ally.GetName] has entered The war against the Dominion. This could potentially shift the balance of the war for the quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.315.name: New particpants in the Dominion War
STH_dominion_story.316.desc: The Dominion War has potentially hit a turning point as [dominion_war_joiner_ally.GetName] has declined to join our war against the Dominion, leaving us to stand alone against our foe.
STH_dominion_story.316.name: Dominion War
STH_dominion_story.317.desc: Despite the rallying call to join the Dominion War, it seems that [dominion_war_joiner_ally.GetName] has been talking with the Dominion in the background and has decided to side with the Dominion forces against the Alpha Quadrant alliance.
STH_dominion_story.317.name: Betrayed!
STH_dominion_story.320.desc: Victory is ours! Our victory in the Dominion War will go down in history as a momentous victory for [Root.GetName] and we have brought peace and triumph to our section of space. Now is the time to mourn the losses and to ensure that this can never happen again.
STH_dominion_story.320.name: Dominion War Won
STH_dominion_story.321.desc: We have been defeated, despite the efforts of our forces we have suffered too many losses to continue the war. Our people will need to accept defeat and rebuild what we have lost.
STH_dominion_story.321.name: Dominion War Lost
STH_dominion_story.324.a.response: Self replicaing cloaked mines could hold back and block passage through the Wormhole for a limited period of time.
STH_dominion_story.324.desc: Greetings, I am [selected_leader.GetName] the situation at the wormhole grows more desperate each day as the Dominion sends more and more troops through the wormhole to reinforce Cardassia. Soon we shall have lost any potential war before it even starts. However we have a 3rd option, mine the wormhole and prevent more troops reaching the Alpha Quadrant, it maybe our ownly hope.
STH_dominion_story.324.name: Mine the Wormhole?
STH_dominion_story.325.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetName] allies, great songs will be sung of the upcoming battles that we shall face as friends and the halls of Sto-vo-kor will be ready to celebrate the honoured dead. 

The changelings will wish they never set foot in the Alpha Quadrant! 

To War, for today is a good day to die.
STH_dominion_story.325.name: Message from the Klingons
STH_dominion_story.326.a: Today is a good day to die!
STH_dominion_story.326.desc:
Klingon Friends, your allies in the United Federation of Planets stands ready and able to defend you against the onslaught from the Gamma Quadrant. 

Together we shall push them back and stake a victory for freedom. 

Where you lead Starfleet will follow.
STH_dominion_story.326.name: Message from the Federation
STH_dominion_story.350.desc:
With the clear favouritism being shown to [cardassia_jealous.GetName] over ourselves many within the Cardassian military are starting to chafe at life under the Dominion thumb. 

Our leaders resent the feeling of being second class citizens on our own planets and the promises presented by the Founders have yet to materialise. Is it time to rid ourselves of these overlords.
STH_dominion_story.350.name: Freedom for Cardassia
STH_dominion_story.351.desc: Resist today. Resist tomorrow. Resist until the last Dominion soldier has been driven from our soil. For all our Sons and Daughters.
STH_dominion_story.351.name: Time for a free Cardassia
STH_dominion_story.352.desc: Those arrogant fools on Cardassia have demanded to leave the Dominion. No one has ever had the audacity to demand such a thing and this insult must not be allowed to stand.
STH_dominion_story.352.name: Cardassians demand independence
STH_dominion_story.353.desc: The Cardassian Union has turned its back on its Dominion masters and declared war in a bid to restore their freedom.
STH_dominion_story.353.name: Cardassia Turns on he Dominion
STH_dominion_story.356.desc:
The Dominion's defeat at the hands of the Alpha Quadrant alliance has resulted in the Founders and their Vorta lapdogs retreating back through the Bajoran Wormhole and away from Cardassian soil. 

Our future is once again in our hands.
STH_dominion_story.356.name: A free Cardassia
STH_dominion_story.357.desc:
The conditions involved in our defeat to the solids of the Alpha Quadrant mean that we must abandon our claim to the Cardassian worlds. 

Those fools on Cardassia have already proven themselves unworthy of our continued embrace as part of the Dominion and no doubt contributed to our defeat. 

We abandon them to their fate
STH_dominion_story.357.name: Abandon Cardassia
STH_dominion_story.360.desc:
Our plans to expand our territory into the Alpha and Beta Quadrants have not progressed as the Founders would have liked, with stiffer resistance than expected from the major powers of the Quadrants. 

The Founder's faith in the Cardassian Union is starting to dip and they are now pushing our Dominion forces to take direct control of Cardassian systems and infrastructure in order to better support the war.
STH_dominion_story.360.name: Alpha Quadrant Expansion
STH_dominion_story.361.a: We serve the Founders in all things.
STH_dominion_story.361.desc:
[cardassian_union.GetRutlerTitle], we bring you greetings from your overlords in the Dominion, as no doubt you are aware the war continues, and this lack of victory alarms our glorious Founders. 

As you know all worlds of the Dominion belong to the Founders and they have requested that a number of Cardassian systems and starbases are transferred under the direct control of the Vorta.
STH_dominion_story.361.name: The Dogs of War
STH_dominion_story.362.desc_01: Our efforts to defeat the Alpha Quadrant Alliance has been bolstered by our ability to comandeer the Cardassian facilities and put them to use building Dominion ships, however there is still more we could be doing and more efficiencies that the Cardassian's are costing us. We should look to take more facilities to boost our war time production and foothold into the Alpha Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.362.desc_02:
Those fools within the Cardassian Union have harmed our war efforts further, not only did they reject our request, but their inability to coordinate and manage the war continues to allow the Allies a means to resist our assaults. 

We must take hold of their facilities now.
STH_dominion_story.362.name: The Dogs of War
STH_dominion_story.363.a: We ... we will obey the will of the Founders.
STH_dominion_story.363.desc:
[cardassian_union.ruler.GetName], the Founder's patience for the continued failure to have defeated the Alpha Quadrant Alliance is now grating on their tolerance levels. 

These failures will not be allowed to continue, provide our forces with more access to your territories and shipyards and we will ensure this war ends in victory for the Dominion... and Cardassia.
STH_dominion_story.363.name: The Dogs of War
STH_dominion_story.364.desc_01:
Our Vorta strategists have once again recommended further takeover of Cardassian owned space, we should also look at restricting their access to our military planning sessions in favour of other members. 

We should also look at redistributing their resources towards the Vorta and Jem'Hadar. This is likely to cause some unrest, but they have shown no signs of resisting our control.
STH_dominion_story.364.desc_02: The Cardassians continue to resist our overlordship, had we not been at war these continued acts of insubordination would have been dealt with by our Jem'Hadar forces. Our continued appeasement of these fools will end in their destruction.
STH_dominion_story.364.name: The Dogs of War
STH_dominion_story.365.b.tooltip: The Cardassian quest for independance begins.
STH_dominion_story.365.b: Cardassia will not stand for this.
STH_dominion_story.365.desc: Cardassia! You must understand that in order to win this war your sacrifices are needed. As the Jem'Hadar know, victory is life, and this is a lesson you Cardassians must accept if we are to be victorious. Once more we ask you to show your devotion to the cause and to the Founders will serve in all things.
STH_dominion_story.365.name: The Dogs of War
STH_dominion_story.370.desc:
With the clear favouritism being shown to [cardassia_jealous.GetName] over ourselves many within the Cardassian military are starting to chafe at life under the Dominion thumb. 

Our leaders resent the feeling of being second class citizens on our own planets and the promises presented by the Founders have yet to materialise and now they take more of our worlds as their own. 

This stops here, we must resist and free Cardassia!
STH_dominion_story.370.name: For Cardassia!
STH_dominion_story.372.a: Cardassia must rise up with us.
STH_dominion_story.372.desc:
Many Cardassians have turned their back on their Dominion masters and formed a group called the Cardassian Liberation Front, they have declared this message to all parties. 

Resist today. Resist tomorrow. Resist until the last Dominion soldier has been driven from our soil. For all our Sons and Daughters. 

They have reached out to us for support with the pledge to join us against the Dominion.
STH_dominion_story.372.name: Cardassia Turns on he Dominion
STH_dominion_story.376.desc: The quadrant has been left in ruins following the Dominion War, with millions dead and whole worlds left in ruin. The Liberation Front proved to be a valuable ally, to you during the war, we now ask for your support to take back control of the Cardassian Union and ensure that all vestiges of the Dominion are removed from my homeworld and our quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.376.name: What you leave behind
STH_dominion_story.377.desc: Those arrogant fools on Cardassia have demanded to leave the Dominion. Many Cardassians now stand in open rebellion against the Dominion. No one has ever had the audacity to demand such a thing and this insult must not be allowed to stand.
STH_dominion_story.377.name: Cardassian Rebellion!
STH_dominion_story.378.desc: The Cardassian Legates have rejected our request to take direct control of their facilities, this act of defiance only shows how foolishly prideful these people are. Once this war is over we will remind them of the proper order of things.
STH_dominion_story.378.name: Cardassia Reject our request
STH_dominion_story.381.desc:
It has been said by many that the key to the Alpha Quadrant is Deep Space Nine and the Bajoran System, for whoever controls these controls the Wormhole. 

Our decision to mine the wormhole will keep the Dominion at bay for now, but should they remove the mines their fleets can flood into the Alpha Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.381.name: Defeat at the Battle of Bajor
STH_dominion_story.382.desc: Our victory in the Bajoran System provides us with an opportunity to remove the mines preventing our reinforcements from joining the battle against our enemies! We should make every effort to bring down the minefield as soon as possible.
STH_dominion_story.382.name: Victory at the Battle of Bajor
STH_dominion_story.383.desc:
Our scientists have managed to convert the deflector dish on Terok Nor to act as one giant anti-graviton emitter and disable the self-replicating mines blocking the wormhole. 

The resulting explosion is bright enough for even a Vorta to see.
STH_dominion_story.383.name: Minefield Removed
STH_dominion_story.384.desc: The Dominion and their Cardassian Allies have successfully used an anti-graviton emitter to disable the mines blocking the Bajoran Wormhole, allowing them to once again bring their forces through the wormhole.
STH_dominion_story.384.name: The minefield has fallen
STH_dominion_story.386.desc: Our victory in the Bajoran System allows us to keep the minefield safe and keeps the Dominion's war fleets from adding to their numbers already in the Alpha Quadrant.
STH_dominion_story.386.name: Victory at the Battle of Bajor
STH_dominion_story.387.desc: Losing control of Bajor is a major setback in our bid for control over the Alpha and Beta Quadrants, we must take the system back and remove those mines.
