STH_innerLight_event.26.name: Inner Light
STH_innerLight_event.27.desc:
The [Root.GetFleetName] locks weapons on the probe and fires, however weapons appear to have no effect. The probe's hull is obviously comprised of a material beyond anything the [Root.Owner.GetName] has encountered before. 

The Executive Officer is left with only two choices.
STH_innerLight_event.27.name: Inner Light
STH_innerLight_event.3.desc: The [Root.GetFleetName] locks weapons on the probe as the Executive Officer mulls the risk to the [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] of destroying the probe against disabling it.
STH_innerLight_event.3.name: Inner Light
STH_innerLight_event.4.desc: The [Root.GetFleetName] backs away from the probe, but even at full impulse it manages to keep a steady relative position while continuing to fire the nucleonic beam at [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName].
STH_innerLight_event.4.name: Inner Light
STH_innerLight_event.5.desc:
Raising the ship's shields appears to have cut off the beam. 

For a moment the [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] seems fine, until [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] bursts into a violent fit of screams and spasms. The Medical Officer strongly advises the shields are lowered before [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] suffers permanent injury or death.
STH_innerLight_event.5.name: Inner Light
STH_innerLight_event.7.desc:
Several minutes pass as [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] seems to sleep soundly. 

The crew is uneasy about allowing an alien influence to paralyse [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle], with the Tactical Officer suggesting again that weapons be fired to disable the probe. 

Countering this, the Medical Officer insists that the [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] appears otherwise unharmed, and that it may be prudent to keep the beam in place until it comes to a conclusion.
STH_innerLight_event.7.name: Inner Light
STH_innerLight_event.8.desc:
After several more minutes, the probe finally turns off its nucleonic beam. [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] slowly comes to, surrounded by medical staff. 

The [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] looks around as if seeing the bridge for the first time, reciting the names of crew members as if they were distant memories. 

The crew explain to [Root.Leader.GetHerHim] what happened, and [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] is stunned that [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] was asleep for less than half an hour. 

[Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName] explains that [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] has experienced an entire lifetime of memories, living in a what appears to have been simulation of life on a long dead planet. 

The [Root.Owner.GetCaptainTitle] orders the probe to be locked on with the [Root.Owner.GetTractorBeam] and brought into the cargo bay for further study. 

An examination of the probe finds an age old flute, which seems to have special meaning to [Root.GetLeaderName].
STH_innerLight_event.8.name: Inner Light
STH_investigations.10.desc: [investigating_ship_leader.GetName] has filed their report from [investigating_ship.GetName], they have completed their scans of the Black Hole. A great deal of scientific information was pulled back from the study which we will be able to send back to [Root.capital_scope.GetName].
STH_investigations.10.name: Black Hole Investigation
STH_investigations.11.desc: [investigating_ship.GetName] has completed their detailed scans of their assigned Black Hole. A great deal of scientific information was pulled back from the investigation in addition to a number of rare materials found in proximity to the Black Hole. [investigating_ship_leader.GetName] has requested a transport vessel to follow up and collect the materials.
STH_investigations.11.name: Black Hole Investigation
STH_investigations.12.a: Divert all power to the engines.
STH_investigations.12.desc:
The [investigating_ship.GetName] has been caught in the pull from the Black Hole and is unable to escape, if they get pulled any closer to the event horizon they will be destroyed. 

The Chief engineer recommends diverting full power to the engines.
STH_investigations.12.name: Ship being pulled into Black Hole
STH_investigations.13.desc:
Following weeks of investigations and detailed scans [investigating_ship_leader.GetName] onboard the [investigating_ship.GetName] have completed their investigation into their Black Hole. 

 Sadly their investigations revealed nothing of particular note about this Black Hole, despite the initial promise.
STH_investigations.13.name: Black Hole Investigation
STH_investigations.14.desc: With engines at full power, the [investigating_ship.GetName] is able to break free of the gravity pull from the Black hole and warp to safety.
STH_investigations.14.name: Ship breaks free
STH_investigations.15.desc: Despite the best efforts of the [investigating_ship.GetName] and her crew their efforts were not enough to escape the pull of the black hole without additonal power from the engines. The ship was pulled in and destroyed.
STH_investigations.15.name: Ship Destroyed
STH_investigations.2.desc:
The [Root.GetName] Science Directorate has commissioned a new research mission to [investigation_target_nebula.GetName] which lies within a Nebula that has been marked as having some scientific interest. 

We have been requested to dispatch a ship and crew to investigate and chart the nebula and catalogue the findings.
STH_investigations.2.name: Nebula Investigation
STH_investigations.4.desc:
Following weeks of investigations [investigating_ship_leader.GetName] and the [investigating_ship.GetName] have completed their cataloguing and investigation into their assigned nebula. 

The investigation was uneventful and the research they will bring back to the [Root.GetName] will have the scientists back on [Root.capital_scope.GetName] interested for months on end.
STH_investigations.4.name: Nebula Investigation
STH_investigations.5.desc:
Following weeks of investigations [investigating_ship_leader.GetName] and the [investigating_ship.GetName] have completed their cataloguing and investigation into their assigned nebula. 

The investigation was interesting and wielded a number of rare materials that [investigating_ship_leader.GetName] was able to collect. The research they will bring back to the [Root.GetName] will have the scientists back on [Root.capital_scope.GetName] interested for months on end.
STH_investigations.5.name: Nebula Investigation
STH_investigations.6.desc: Sir! We are detecting pirates coming from deeper within the Nebula, it appears they have set an ambush for unwary vessels. They are heading our way weapons hot, we should bring them to account for their actions.
STH_investigations.6.name: Ambush in the Nebula
STH_investigations.7.desc:
Following weeks of investigations [investigating_ship_leader.GetName] and the [investigating_ship.GetName] have completed their cataloguing and investigation into their assigned nebula. 

 Sadly their investigations revealed nothing of particular note about this Nebula, despite the initial promise.
STH_investigations.7.name: Nebula Investigation
STH_investigations.8.desc:
The [Root.GetName] Science Directorate has commissioned a new research mission to [investigation_target_blackhole.GetName] a black hole of some scientific interest to our researchers back on [Root.capital_scope.GetName]. 

We have been requested to dispatch a ship and crew to investigate spend some time scanning the stellar phenomenon.
STH_investigations.8.name: Black Hole Investigation
STH_kaminar_kelpien_category_desc: We are receiving a communications from the surface of the planet Kaminar, which is the home of the isolationist Ba'ul and the Kelpiens who are kept as slaves, against all odds the message appears to be coming from a Kelpien settlement.
STH_kazon_mechanics.2.desc:
In the face of conflict with the [From.GetName], all Sects must put aside their disputes to unite against their common enemy. 

The ongoing rebellions that have plagued Kazon society have formally ended.
STH_kazon_mechanics.2.name: Sects Apart
STH_kazon_mechanics.3.desc:
The [kazon_rebel_sect.GetName]'s forces have succeeded in storming the Great Chambers on [Root.Capital.GetName] and taking by force the leadership of Kazon society. 

The other Sects have signalled their willingness to accept the legitimacy of the [kazon_rebel_sect.GetName] victory, though much needs to be done to rebuild from the conflict.
STH_kazon_mechanics.3.name: Sects Apart
STH_kazon_story.1.a: We must do all we can to preserve the integrity of Kazon space!
STH_kazon_story.1.b: Now is not the time for Kazon to fight Kazon.
STH_kazon_story.1.desc:
Infighting gnaws away at the heart of the Kazon society, where several of the Sect leaders have begun to openly voice their opposition to [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s government. 

Without an outside enemy to overcome, infighting soon overtakes all else on [Root.Capital.GetName]. 

The Majes await [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s response.
STH_kazon_story.1.name: Sects Apart
STH_kazon_story.10.c: We are not strong enough for freedom.
STH_kazon_story.10.desc:
Too long have the Kazon rotted away under the mastership of the Trabe, they steal what is ours and force us to work the jobs they are too weak to master. 

The great Sects have finally become united in a desire to see a free Kazon race, one which the galaxy should fear.
STH_kazon_story.10.name: Kazon Freedom
STH_kazon_story.11.desc: It seems all is not well within the Trabe Alliance. Their slaves have finally had enough of doing their masters bidding and the Kazon are launching a bid for freedom.
STH_kazon_story.11.name: Kazon Freedom
STH_kazon_story.12.desc:
We have had disturbing reports from our outposts across Kazon space, it appears the Sects have finally united as one in a bid to overthrow and free themselves of our governership. 

 We must crush this rebellion before the galaxy is forced to endure the Kazon.
STH_kazon_story.12.name: Kazon Freedom
STH_kazon_story.2.desc:
After months of debate in the Great Chambers, the [rebelCountry1.GetName] has declared open revolt against the government of [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] from their stronghold on [rebelCountry1.Capital.GetName]. 

While so far no other Sects have pledged themselves to the [rebelCountry1.GetName]'s cause, all Sects eagerly await at the opportunity to further their agendas in the coming conflict.
STH_kazon_story.2.name: Sects Apart
STH_kazon_story.3.desc:
After months of debate in the Great Chambers, the [rebelCountry1.GetName] has declared open revolt against the government of [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] from their stronghold on [rebelCountry1.Capital.GetName]. 

Barely had the news arrived on [Root.Capital.GetName] before another blow was dealt to the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s leadership with a similar declaration from the [rebelCountry2.GetName] on [rebelCountry2.Capital.GetName]. 

While so far no other Sects have pledged themselves to the rebels, all Sects eagerly await at the opportunity to further their agendas in the coming conflict.
STH_kazon_story.3.name: Sects Apart
STH_kazon_story.4.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s masterful political maneuvering in the Great Chambers has successfully isolated those Sects which appeared to oppose the current administration. The Sects are united now to face the enemy without, not within.
STH_kazon_story.4.name: Sects Apart
STH_kelpien_flavour.10.desc: It is unclear right now whether our efforts were enough to make a significant impact on the ongoing battle between the two sides, we should wait for further communications from the planet.
STH_kelpien_flavour.10.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.100.desc: We have troubling news from the Kelai system, it looks like the Ba'ul have launched a fleet of ships from the planet's surface and they are heading towards our ships in the system with their weapons systems charged.
STH_kelpien_flavour.100.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.101.desc: We have defeated the Ba'ul attack ships and have secured the system.
STH_kelpien_flavour.101.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.15.a: Send in a specialist science team.
STH_kelpien_flavour.15.b: Send the Kelpiens some additional research.
STH_kelpien_flavour.15.c: The Kelpiens must fend for themselves.
STH_kelpien_flavour.15.desc: We have received an urgent message from the Kelpien Tribes, the Ba'ul have modified a broadcast signal using alien technology which has triggered the Vahar'ai in all Kelpiens on Kaminar. However it looks like the signal has been modified to an intensity which will kill the vast majority of the Kelpien species. This could be a decisive blow in the war and hand victory to the Ba'ul. Should we intervene?
STH_kelpien_flavour.15.name: The Vahar'ai
STH_kelpien_flavour.19.desc: Our teams have done all they could to prevent the artificially triggered Vahar'ai from killing the Kelpiens, but it is too early to know whether we have been successful. What is clear is that this conflict will soon come to a conclusion, but who comes out on top is still to be decided.
STH_kelpien_flavour.19.name: The Vahar'ai
STH_kelpien_flavour.2.b: We have no time for this.
STH_kelpien_flavour.2.desc: Our observation post orbiting the planet Kaminar have picked up a transmission from the planets surface. It appears the local species are trying to reach out to us. Our tactical reports inform us that the long standing conflict between the technologically more advanced Ba'ul and the seemingly gentle Kelpiens has increased in intensity and frequency over the last few weeks.
STH_kelpien_flavour.2.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.20.b: Open a channel to the planet.
STH_kelpien_flavour.20.desc: Our observation team monitoring the planet Kaminar has contacted us, it looks like the decisive battle for the planet has concluded, our interventions could prove to have been crucial in either saving lives or condemning one side to victory or defeat. We should contact the planet to see which side has come out victorious.
STH_kelpien_flavour.20.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.a.response: We hope that he is safe and well with you.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.b.response: The Ba'ul have us locked into the Great Balance for the good of the ecosystem, when our time comes we are called forth and ritually killed. This has dominated our way of life for too long now.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.b: Please tell us your version of events.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.c.response: We know the Ba'ul have far greater weapons than we do, all we wish for is a fair chance to gain our freedom without getting irradicated by the advanced weapons they own. We have obtained some Ba'ul technology, so all we ask for is a level playing field.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.c: What would you have us do?
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.d.response: We know the Ba'ul have far greater weapons than we do, all we wish for is a fair chance to gain our freedom without getting irradicated by the advanced weapons they own. We have obtained some Ba'ul technology so we do not require much from your Empire.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.d: What is it you want, Veruul?
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.desc_01: Greetings and thank you for taking the time to listen to our plea for help, we, the Kelpien Tribes have spent too long living in a state of perpetual fear under the Watchful eye of the Ba'ul. My people are ritually sacrificed as part of the 'Great Balance', but this appears to be just another ruse by the Ba'ul to enslave and kill our people. We know that one of our brothers, a Kelpien named Saru escaped with you some years ago, so we know that you are aware of our plight. We only ask for a chance to free ourselves.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.desc_02: Greetings and thank you for taking the time to listen to our plea for help, we, the Kelpien Tribes have spent too long living in a state of perpetual fear under the Watchful eye of the Ba'ul. My people are ritually sacrificed as part of the 'Great Balance', but this appears to be just another ruse by the Ba'ul to enslave and kill our people. We hope this message reaches you and that you can sympathise with our plight, all we ask for a chance to free ourselves.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.e.response: The Ba'ul have greater weaponary than us, and could easily wipe us out on mass, all we wish for is a fair chance to gain our freedom without getting irradicated by the advanced weapons they own. We have obtained some Ba'ul technology, all we need is a chance.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.e: What do you want from us?
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.f: We should hear from the Ba'ul High Council.
STH_kelpien_flavour.3.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.30.desc: The Kelpien Tribes have responded to our messages, it looks like after a defining battle with the Ba'ul they have come out as winners. A council of elders have reached out to us and are extremely grateful for our assistance, the Kelpiens now stand as a fully fledged government in charge of their own affairs. Thanks to our actions during their conflict they seem open to building a further bond with [Root.GetName]. The Ba'ul appear to have fled the planet and we have been unable to detect them on any of our scans. The future now seems open to the Kelpiens.
STH_kelpien_flavour.30.name: The Kelpien Tribes
STH_kelpien_flavour.31.desc: The Kelpien Tribes have responded to our messages, it looks like after a defining battle with the Ba'ul they have come out as winners. A council of elders have reached out to us and are extremely grateful for our assistance, the Kelpiens now stand as a fully fledged government in charge of their own affairs.They have indicated that they need time to recover and reflect on their situation before engaging in any further interaction with the quadrant. The Ba'ul appear to have fled the planet and we have been unable to detect them on any of our scans. The future now seems open to the Kelpiens.
STH_kelpien_flavour.31.name: The winner is...
STH_kelpien_flavour.32.a: We must watch the Kelpien Tribes.
STH_kelpien_flavour.32.desc: The Kelpien Tribes have responded to our messages, it looks like after a defining battle with the Ba'ul they have come out as winners. The council of Elders which appear to be governing the planet until a full government can be formed do not seem to be responding to our messages and it's clear that our choices during the revolution have not gone unnoticed by the authorities on the planet. It appears that all Ba'ul presence on the planet is now gone leaving the future of Kaminar in the hands of the Kelpiens.
STH_kelpien_flavour.32.name: Greetings Kelpien Tribes
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.a.response: The Kelpien lies, they are dangerous and cannot be trusted, return him to us and we will be grateful.
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.a: We have heard much of this conflict already.
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.b.response: To ensure that we would never again be threatened, we forced the Kelpiens into subservience and put in place the belief system called the Great Balance, this is all to prevent any Kelpien from evolving into their post-Vahar'ai predatory form for they would surely destroy us all.
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.b: Tell us why we should side with you?
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.c.response: Help us destroy the Kelpiens as we should have done so many years ago, they will threaten all life on this planet and maybe even your own if they are allowed to live. Your federation must value all life, don't we deserve to live?
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.c: What are you asking of us?
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.d.response: Destroy the Kepliens with us and we will be your allies.
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.d: What do you need from us?
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.desc_01: We are the Ba'ul High Council, and we know that you watch our affairs, we know you have one of our Kelpiens and we do not forget acts against us. The Kelpiens cannot be allowed to take this planet and we will not let them. Join with us.
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.desc_02: We are the Ba'ul High Council, and we know that you watch our affairs, we see your observation station and we are prepared to act if our safety is threatened and the Kelpiens cannot be allowed to take this planet and we will not let them. Join with us and benefit.
STH_kelpien_flavour.4.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.40.a: The Ba'ul High Council rule Kaminar.
STH_kelpien_flavour.40.desc: The superior technology and firepower at the disposal of the Ba'ul have allowed them to come out of this civil war on top, and our actions prevented any potential chance the Kelpiens had of taking control of the planet. It is unclear what type of neighbours the Ba'ul will make, but it is clear they do not hide their intentions. Our scans can see that what remains of the Kelpien population have been enslaved. The Ba'ul have removed all our equipment and foothold in the system and have extended their borders to the edge of their home system.
STH_kelpien_flavour.40.name: The Ba'ul High Council joins the galactic Stage
STH_kelpien_flavour.41.a: The Ba'ul High Council rule Kaminar.
STH_kelpien_flavour.41.desc: The superior technology and firepower at the disposal of the Ba'ul have allowed them to come out of this civil war on top, and our actions prevented any potential chance the Kelpiens had of taking control of the planet. The Ba'ul seem uneasy with our presence so close to their homeworld and our orbital station and outpost have gone silent, it seems our actions during the civil war has not warmed them to our empire. The remaining Kelpien population have now been enslaved and defeated. We shall see what becomes of this new power in the quadrant.
STH_kelpien_flavour.41.name: The Ba'ul High Council
STH_kelpien_flavour.42.a: The Ba'ul High Council rule Kaminar.
STH_kelpien_flavour.42.desc: The Ba'ul have emerged as victors over the Kelpiens, whose population has been decimated by the relentless attacks from the Ba'ul weaponry, the remaining population have been enslaved. The Ba'ul High Council has acted swiftly to remove all our equipment and outputs from their territory and appear to be openly hostile to our approaches. It looks like we have not made a friend in the new outright rulers of the planet Kaminar.
STH_kelpien_flavour.42.name: The Ba'ul High Council
STH_kelpien_flavour.5.desc: We have been asked for aid by both sides in this conflict, it is clear that the Kelpiens are at a disadvantage, but outnumber the Ba'ul significantly, any victory without our assistance will be extremely devastating to both sides. We must pick wisely as our decision will change the balance of the planet Kaminar.
STH_kelpien_flavour.5.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.50.a: Send in a team led by a hero.
STH_kelpien_flavour.50.b: Send in a Tal Shiar specialist.
STH_kelpien_flavour.50.desc: [root.GetLeaderName], we have been contacted by the Ba'ul, it looks like the Kelpien's have managed to commandeer a number of attack fighters and heavy weaponry and are now using it against a key Ba'ul stronghold. If it should fall the Kelpiens will have a foothold into Ba'ul space and could neutralise the technological advantage that the Ba'ul have over them. A tactical strike by our best teams could swiftly turn the tide back.
STH_kelpien_flavour.50.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_kelpien_flavour.54.a: Send in a specialist science team.
STH_kelpien_flavour.54.b: Send the Ba'ul some additional research.
STH_kelpien_flavour.54.c: The Ba'ul must fend for themselves.
STH_kelpien_flavour.54.desc: Our contacts in the Ba'ul military have asked for urgent help, the Kelpiens have gained access to technology which will trigger the Vahar'ai. Which would evolve the Kelpiens into the predator like state the Ba'ul feared. Given the number of Kelpiens on the planet this would give them a real advantage and realise the concerns that the Ba'ul described.
STH_kelpien_flavour.54.name: The Vahar'ai
STH_kelpien_flavour.6.a: Send in a team led by a heroic admiral.
STH_kelpien_flavour.6.desc: [root.GetLeaderName], we have been contacted by our allies the Kelpiens, the Ba'ul are unleashing weapons of mass destruction upon the Kelpien villages, targeting women and children. The Kelpiens are asking for our help to protect the innocent. Our military advisors have suggested a number of approaches to deal with the situation, but recommend sending in our best teams to get the best outcome.
STH_kelpien_flavour.6.e: We will not aid them right now.
STH_kelpien_flavour.6.name: The Sound of Thunder
STH_klingon_flavour.1.desc:
Discontent has been growing among the crew of the [Root.GetFleetName], unhappy with Captain [Root.GetLeaderName]'s lack of thirst for combat. The Executive Officer, [challengingOfficer.GetName] begins to hear rumours of a mutiny led by the Chief Engineer. 

A confrontation occurs in Main Engineering between them but after a brief fight the Chief convinces [challengingOfficer.GetHerHim] that Captain [Root.GetLeaderName] is unfit to command. Storming the bridge, [challengingOfficer.GetName] declares this to the Captain and challenges [officer.GetHerHim] to a fight to the death for command of the ship.
STH_klingon_flavour.1.name: Leadership Challenge
STH_klingon_flavour.10.desc_01:
The famed songwright L'rOu won the commission to score the epic celebration of [officer.GetName]'s victories. 

The [Root.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetHerHim]self demanded the first performance be in the Grand Opera Chambers on [Root.Capital.GetName], with the entire Council in attendance. 

The performance was widely judged to have been a success, and the recording of the two hour epic has found a place in many Houses on [Root.Capital.GetName].
STH_klingon_flavour.10.name: Deeds Worthy of Song
STH_klingon_flavour.100.desc:
qaStaHvIS vIja' HeH 'etlh, SuS pegh pe''egh, chIm'e' 'e'. 

Hagh be'Hom. Hurgh jIb pemHov bot. 

rur lam yav juS poH. 

K'Ratak's epic novel 'qul naj' has inspired billions across the [Root.GetName]. The story describes a young warrior's pilgrimage to the fire mountains, with the text praised for its elegance and harsh beauty.
STH_klingon_flavour.100.name: 'qul naj'
STH_klingon_flavour.11.desc_01:
The songwright Be'BaH, a close friend of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], secured the commission to score the epic celebration of [officer.GetName]'s victories. 

Demanding the first performance be in the Grand Opera Chambers on [Root.Capital.GetName] with the entire Council in attendance, few expected much from the performance. 

The scepticism was well founded, as most in attendance found the work to be an inferior derivative of a number of turn-of-the-millennium classics.
STH_klingon_flavour.11.name: Deeds Worthy of Song
STH_klingon_flavour.2.desc:
Captain [Root.GetLeaderName] draws a Mek'leth and charges at [challengingOfficer.GetName], who deflects the blow with savage strength. Slash after slash connects Mek'leth to Mek'leth and the bridge is lit with the sparks from each clash. 

The Captain feigns left and sweeps the feet out from under [officer.GetHerHis] opponent. Falling backward, the [challengingOfficer.GetName]'s skull impacts the edge of the tactical console and the crack of shattering bone is heard. Blood pools around the base of the console as the bridge crew chant '[Root.GetLeaderName]! [Root.GetLeaderName]!'.
STH_klingon_flavour.2.name: Leadership Challenge
STH_klingon_flavour.3.desc:
Captain [Root.GetLeaderName] draws a Mek'leth and charges at [challengingOfficer.GetName], who deflects the blow with savage strength. Slash after slash connects Mek'leth to Mek'leth and the bridge is lit with the sparks from each clash. 

[challengingOfficer.GetName] lunges at the Captain and powering through the parry, embeds a blade into the arm of the Captain, who kicks [challengingOfficer.GetHerHim] back. 

The Captain, wounded, feigns left and sweeps the feet out from under the returning opponent. Falling backward, the [challengingOfficer.GetName]'s skull impacts the edge of the tactical console and the crack of shattering bone is heard. Blood pools around the base of the console as the bridge crew chant '[Root.GetLeaderName]! [Root.GetLeaderName]!'.
STH_klingon_flavour.3.name: Leadership Challenge
STH_klingon_flavour.4.desc: Captain [Root.GetLeaderName] draws a disruptor pistol and an instant later [challengingOfficer.GetName]'s tortured writhing form is vaporised in a cascade of disintegrating molecules. The bridge crew stand in silence until, at last, the Captain orders them to their stations, a fanged grin forming on [officer.GetHerHis] face.
STH_klingon_flavour.4.name: Leadership Challenge
STH_klingon_flavour.5.desc:
Captain [Root.GetLeaderName] draws a Mek'leth and charges at [challengingOfficer.GetName], who deflects the blow with savage strength. Slash after slash connects Mek'leth to Mek'leth and the bridge is lit with the sparks from each clash. 

[challengingOfficer.GetName] lunges at the Captain and powering through the parry embeds a blade into [officer.GetHerHis] arm. [officer.GetName] kicks [challengingOfficer.GetName] back. 

The Captain, wounded, attempts to feign left and sweeps the feet out from under the returning opponent but [challengingOfficer.GetSheHe]'s too slow and is caught off guard. Falling backward, the Captain's skull impacts the edge of the tactical console and the crack of shattering bone is heard. Blood pools around the base of the console as the bridge crew chant '[challengingOfficer.GetName]! [challengingOfficer.GetName]!'.
STH_klingon_flavour.5.name: Leadership Challenge
STH_klingon_flavour.6.desc:
The representatives of the Imperial Mining Guild gather in the Great Hall, waiting for [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] to enter. They exchange excited whispers until at last the Imperial herald announces the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s arrival. 

'Your guild requested this hearing with great urgency,' [Root.GetRulerName] says to the group. 'Tell me what is so important.' 

The guildsmen look to the leader of their delegation, an ancient white haired Klingon with arms thick from years of labour. 

'We believe we may have found an opportunity to bolster our war capacity. Praxis has vast, untapped mineral and energy potential. Our proposal is here on this datapad, but we think you'll agree that this can give the Empire a clear advantage.' 

[Root.GetRulerName] takes the datapad and begins to read.
STH_klingon_flavour.6.name: Praxis Mining Operations
STH_klingon_flavour.7.desc:
Disaster! 

Praxis has exploded. Years of overmining had left the moon's core unstable until at last an accident in an industrial fusion reactor caused a cascade reaction, destroying all facilities on the surface. 

Praxis is broken, and debris rains down on Qo'nos. The damage from this cataclysm could take generations to undo...
STH_klingon_flavour.7.name: Praxis Mining Operations
STH_klingon_flavour.8.b: Now is not the time for song.
STH_klingon_flavour.8.desc:
Having defeated the [From.GetName] bIHnuch in glorious battle, Captain [officer.GetName] has earned [officer.GetHerHim]self the respect of many in the [This.GetName]. 

Songwrights across [This.Capital.GetName] compete for the honour of putting [officer.GetName]'s deeds to song.
STH_klingon_flavour.8.name: Deeds Worthy of Song
STH_klingon_flavour.9.desc_01:
The renowned songwrights L'narD and CoH'n put aside their bitter house rivalries to collaborate on their epic celebration of [officer.GetName]'s victories. 

The [Root.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetHerHim]self demanded the first performance be in the Grand Opera Chambers on [Root.Capital.GetName], with the entire Council in attendance. 

The performance was widely judged to have been both L'narD and CoH'n's best work yet, and the recording of the three hour epic has found a place in almost every House on [Root.Capital.GetName].
STH_klingon_flavour.9.name: Deeds Worthy of Song
STH_klingon_houses.300.a: Rule [klingon_house_target_planet.GetName] on behalf of the Empire.
STH_klingon_houses.300.b: These planets remain with the Empire.
STH_klingon_houses.300.c: There are no suitable worlds to govern right now.
STH_klingon_houses.300.desc.disloyal: The [new_klingon_great_house.GetName] stands before you [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] ready to demonstrate what real leadership looks like, grant us a world within the Empire and we shall make it prosper, failure to do so will only further heighten our distaste for your leadership.
STH_klingon_houses.300.desc.loyal: My Chancellor, [new_klingon_great_house.GetName] stands ready to support the Empire. Give us the opportunity to rule a world on behalf of the Empire, we shall rule with honour and bring glory to the Empire and [new_klingon_great_house.GetName].
STH_klingon_houses.300.desc.same_house: Chancellor, whilst you lead our mighty Empire, [new_klingon_great_house.GetName] grows strong and powerful, let us rule one of the worlds within the Empire and make it prosper in your name.
STH_klingon_houses.300.name: High Stewardship within the Empire
STH_klingon_houses.3010.a: We shall negotiate a suitable outcome.
STH_klingon_houses.3010.c: You will let this matter end now.
STH_klingon_houses.3010.desc_01:
My Chancellor, I come before you representing [great_house_defender.GetName], our house was dishonoured by those foul rogues of [great_house_accuser.GetName] ! During a visit to our noble lands one of their warriors attacked one of our prize hunting Targs causing the beast some distress. 

We ask that you handle the matter.
STH_klingon_houses.3010.desc_02:
My Chancellor, I come before you representing [great_house_defender.GetName], our house was dishonoured by those foul petaQ of [great_house_accuser.GetName] ! Their inability to control the warriors under their control resulted in a brawl which caused considerable damage to our property. 

We demand justice for our house.
STH_klingon_houses.3010.desc_03:
My Chancellor, I come before you representing [great_house_defender.GetName], our house honur has been besmirched by [great_house_accuser.GetName] ! Whilst in our presence they insulted our beloved house matriarch, referring to her as 'looking like the behind of a Targ'. 

They are lucky we did not slay them on the spot, instead we seek the council's judgement.
STH_klingon_houses.3010.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3011.desc: The conflict between the feuding Great Houses has been resolved amicably, whilst a warrior never relishes the role of peacemaker... sometimes the hourable actions is to put the good of the Empire above personal glory.
STH_klingon_houses.3011.name: House Conflict Resolved
STH_klingon_houses.3012.desc: Our efforts to bring peace to the quarreling Houses has unfortunately not been successful. Both parties remain at odds with one another, a position that ultimately weakens the Empire as this will likely evolve into a full-blown feud between the Houses.
STH_klingon_houses.3012.name: House Conflict Remains
STH_klingon_houses.3015.a: Real warriors settle such feuds with bloodwine.
STH_klingon_houses.3015.d: This is not worthy of our time.
STH_klingon_houses.3015.desc_01:
Honorable Chancellor [Root.GetRulerName], my House, the noble [great_house_defender.GetName] stands falsely accused of behaving with complete dishonour whilst attending a gathering hosted by [great_house_accuser.GetName]. They accuse one of our second sons of getting drunk and in an inebriated state causing a fire and significant property damage. 

This blatant falsehood cannot go un-answered.
STH_klingon_houses.3015.desc_02:
Honorable Chancellor [Root.GetRulerName], my House, the noble [great_house_defender.GetName] stands falsely accused of behaving with complete dishonour whilst attending a gathering hosted by [great_house_accuser.GetName]. They accuse one of our cousins of insulting one of their children's honour. 

Whilst this Klingon is no beauty, they are not worthy of our contempt.
STH_klingon_houses.3015.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3016.a: We shall attempt a discussion with both sides.
STH_klingon_houses.3016.desc_01: Honorable Chancellor [Root.GetRulerName], my House, the noble [great_house_accuser.GetName] accuses the foul [great_house_defender.GetName] of causing us insult, during the last banquet in the Great Hall of Kahless one of their warriors was overheard by many Nobles referring to our great and noble house as weak and pathetic. Had we heard this insult at the time the fool would no longer be breathing, however we demand our honour satisfied.
STH_klingon_houses.3016.desc_02: Honorable Chancellor [Root.GetRulerName], my House, the honourable [great_house_accuser.GetName] wishes to make you aware that [great_house_defender.GetName] stands accused of stealing from us. We caught one of their servants stealing from our weapons store. That servant no longer lives to tell the tale of their foolishness, but their house must pay.
STH_klingon_houses.3016.desc_03: My Lord it was agreed under sworn oath that [great_house_defender.GetName] would stand by us in a battle against pirates attacking our trading lanes. However, they left my House [great_house_accuser.GetName] to tackle these pirates without the aid of their fleets. My Lord [great_house_accuser.GetName] was victorious in glorious combat, but we wish revenge on these cowards.
STH_klingon_houses.3016.desc_04: Lord Chancellor, it is with deep regret that I must report a daughter of [great_house_accuser.GetName] has married a miserable petaQ son of [great_house_defender.GetName], this union was carried out without our blessing and whilst a Klingon woman may marry as she pleases, our daughter would surely not act in such a manner, unless some foul trickery was in play.
STH_klingon_houses.3016.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3020.a: This will be settled via combat.
STH_klingon_houses.3020.desc_01: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] I [great_house_accuser.ruler] of [great_house_accuser.GetName] stand before the High Council today accusing the insulant [great_house_defender.GetName] of doing us a great insult during the last council session. Their false accusations against us have insulted our name and the honour of our house. We demand that justice is served.
STH_klingon_houses.3020.desc_02:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] I [great_house_accuser.ruler] of [great_house_accuser.GetName] stand before you all today accusing the fools in [great_house_defender.GetName] they have broken off the marriage ceremony from a member of their house to one of ours. Their claims that we are not worthy of uniting the houses deeply wounds us. 

We ask the council for justice.
STH_klingon_houses.3020.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3021.b: A fine warrior gave their life today.
STH_klingon_houses.3021.desc_01:
Following a fierce battle between the champions from both houses, the winner is announced as [great_house_accuser.GetName] emerges victorious from the fight. Their leader suffering life-changing wounds, but the clear victor. 

With the win, this matter should be considered closed.
STH_klingon_houses.3021.desc_02:
Following a fierce battle between the champions from both houses, the winner is announced as [great_house_accuser.GetName] emerges victorious from the fight. However this victory has come at a high cost with the death of the House champion.

As this was ritual combat any injury or death is to be embraced as the warriors have earnt their place in Sto-Vo-Kor, the Empire considers this matter finished.
STH_klingon_houses.3021.desc_03: Following a fierce battle between the champions from both houses, the winner is announced as [great_house_accuser.GetName] emerges victorious from the fight. Both champions emerge bloody and full of the glory of battle. [great_house_accuser.GetName] champion walks away from the battle as the victor for both their personal honour and that of their house.
STH_klingon_houses.3021.desc_04: Following a fierce battle between the champions from both houses, the winner is announced as [great_house_accuser.GetName] his opponent lying dead on the floor, felled by a swing of a mighty Bat'leth. There can be no finer death for a Klingon warrior than one in combat.
STH_klingon_houses.3021.name: Ritual Combat
STH_klingon_houses.3022.b: A fine warrior gave their life today.
STH_klingon_houses.3022.desc_01:
Following a fierce battle between the champions from both houses, the winner is announced as [great_house_defender.GetName] emerges victorious from the fight. Their leader suffering life-changing wounds, but the clear victor. 

With the win, this matter should be considered closed.
STH_klingon_houses.3022.desc_02:
Following a fierce battle between the champions from both houses, the winner is announced as [great_house_defender.GetName] emerges victorious from the fight. However this victory has come at a high cost with the death of the House champion, 

As this was ritual combat any injury or death is to be embraced as the warriors have earnt their place in Sto-Vo-Kor, the Empire considers this matter finished.
STH_klingon_houses.3022.desc_03: Following a fierce battle between the champions from both houses, the winner is announced as [great_house_defender.GetName] emerges victorious from the fight. Both champions emerge bloody and full of the glory of battle. [great_house_defender.GetName] champion walks away from the battle as the victor for both their personal honour and that of their house.
STH_klingon_houses.3022.desc_04: Following a fierce battle between the champions from both houses, the winner is announced as [great_house_defender.GetName] his opponent lying dead on the floor, felled by a swing of a mighty Bat'leth. There can be no finer death for a Klingon warrior than one in combat.
STH_klingon_houses.3022.name: Ritual Combat
STH_klingon_houses.3023.desc: Following fierce combat, with both warriors giving their all there was no clear winner in the battle between both Houses. As such the Empire rules that neither House can stand victorious and the matter between both Houses should be considered resolved. Victory can only go to the victor!
STH_klingon_houses.3023.name: Combat ends in statemate
STH_klingon_houses.3025.a.response: We will not let you down my Lord.
STH_klingon_houses.3025.a: You are correct and shall rule this planet.
STH_klingon_houses.3025.b.response: You may well regret this decision... my lord.
STH_klingon_houses.3025.c: Perhaps they should give you something else.
STH_klingon_houses.3025.desc:
For too long [great_house_defender.GetName] have held on to planet [accuser_target_planet.GetName] a world that should be ours by rights. They have squandered the opportunity they have been given and wasted the potential of the world for the Empire. 

You must act now and transfer governorship of this world over to our House.
STH_klingon_houses.3025.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3026.a.response: The battle was a ritual combat, but I do not believe this should be taken into account.
STH_klingon_houses.3026.b.response: We will not forgive this act.
STH_klingon_houses.3026.b: Your warrior should have fought harder.
STH_klingon_houses.3026.c: The warrior will be executed for this act.
STH_klingon_houses.3026.desc: Chancellor, I come before this High Council to report the death of one of our House warriors in combat with another soldier from [great_house_defender.GetName]. The leadership of [great_house_accuser.GetName] consider this an act of murder and we demand that [great_house_defender.GetName] are suitably punished by the Empire.
STH_klingon_houses.3026.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3027.a.response: No my Lord, our warrior was slain when he was unable to fight back, this was a dishonourable act.
STH_klingon_houses.3027.b: This matter should be solved in battle.
STH_klingon_houses.3027.c: Their House leader shall die for this dishonour!
STH_klingon_houses.3027.desc:
My Chancellor, it is with great regret that [great_house_defender.GetName] must inform you that [great_house_accuser.GetName] harbours a murderer within their ranks. One of their cowards killed a member of our noble family whilst his back was turned and they were defenseless. This act is best suited to that of a Romulan and has no place being conducted by a Klingon. 

This must not go unpunished and we demand justice.
STH_klingon_houses.3027.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3030.a: We raise a glass to the couple!
STH_klingon_houses.3030.desc:
My Chancellor, it is with great joy that we announce that a son of the [great_house_defender.GetName] and a daughter of the [great_house_accuser.GetName] have wed in a glorious ceremony worthy of Kahless and the Lady Lukara. 

We hope this is the start of a new era of harmony between the houses.
STH_klingon_houses.3030.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3031.desc:
Chancellor, we must report an act of honour from one of your Great Houses, one of our transports was attacked by pirates, and whilst they fought like true Klingons worthy of [great_house_defender.GetName] they would have been defeated had they not been saved by honourable warriors from [great_house_accuser.GetName]. 

An act of honour which goes some way to building a better relationship between our houses.
STH_klingon_houses.3031.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.3032.desc:
Chancellor, we must report an act of bravery from one of your Great Houses, an act which will go down in story.. Our flagship suffered a critical warp core breach whilst on patrol, a crew from [great_house_accuser.GetName] risked their lives to save our family leadership. 

This act has strengthened the bond between [great_house_accuser.GetName] and [great_house_defender.GetName].
STH_klingon_houses.3032.name: Klingon House Politics
STH_klingon_houses.351.desc: A new system has been claimed for the Empire by one of our Great Houses, as is our right we have claimed the planet for the High Council. Starbase [greatHouseStarbase.GetName] now belongs to us.
STH_klingon_houses.351.name: New World Claimed for the Empire
STH_klingon_houses.370.a: This world belongs to the Empire.
STH_klingon_houses.370.desc:
A new world has been colonised for the Empire and now the Great Houses crowd around us, braying for the rights to become overlords of our new world and govern it on behalf of the Empire. 

Selecting one of the Great Houses to take ownership of the new world will allow the Great House to grow in power and loyalty, whilst causing the other Houses to resent the choice we made. 

We should pick carefully.
STH_klingon_houses.370.name: A new world for the Empire
STH_klingon_houses.381.desc: The dishonourable petaQ of [rogue_klingon_house.GetName] have betrayed the Empire and declared themselves a rogue faction. This act of dishonour just as the Empire goes to war will not be tolerated.
STH_klingon_houses.381.name: [rogue_klingon_house.GetName] has betrayed the Empire
STH_klingon_mechanics.100.desc.disloyal: nuqneH', [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]. I am Epetai [houseLeader.GetName] of the [Root.GetName]. Do not waste my time with idle conversation.
STH_klingon_mechanics.100.desc.loyal: Qapla', [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]! I am Epetai [houseLeader.GetName] of the [Root.GetName]. My house stands ready to serve.
STH_klingon_mechanics.100.desc.same_hous: qaleghqa'neS, Epetai [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]. It is I [houseLeader.GetName], Gin'tak of our house while you lead the Empire to glory. How may I serve today?
STH_klingon_mechanics.100.name: The [Root.GetName]
STH_klingon_mechanics.101.desc.disloyal: Perhaps your reputation is undeserved. Very well, which system do you wish the [Root.GetName] to administer? I've prepared a list.
STH_klingon_mechanics.101.desc.loyal: You honour us. Which system do you wish the [Root.GetName] to administer? I've prepared a list.
STH_klingon_mechanics.101.desc.same_hous:
Of course, Epetai. Though I must point out that the other Houses may see the granting of Imperial lands to our house while you are [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] as... suspect. 

If you insist, here is a list of unassigned systems.
STH_klingon_mechanics.101.name: Grant [Root.GetName] Lands
STH_klingon_mechanics.1010.desc:
Qapla', [Root.GetRulerTitle]. I am gin'tak'tIn [gin_tak_tIn.GetName], overseer of the day to day bureaucracy that would be beneath the attention of a great leader such as yourself. 

As you know, the High Council is comprised of the representatives of the most powerful houses and headed by yourself, the [Root.GetRulerTitle]. 

The Council is charged with overseeing the welfare of the [Root.GetName] and its citizens, meeting here in the Great Hall on [Root.Capital.GetName]. 

What matters do you wish addressed in this session of the High Council?
STH_klingon_mechanics.1010.f.response: Promote one of the Noble Houses to a Great House, but at the risk of alienating the old guard.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1010.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1011.a.response: I will make the necessary preparations. The succession ceremony will take place in a month.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1011.b.response: I will make the necessary preparations. The succession ceremony will take place in a month.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1011.c.response: I will make the necessary preparations. The succession ceremony will take place in a month.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1011.d.response: I will make the necessary preparations. The succession ceremony will take place in a month.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1011.desc:
The [Root.GetName] is not governed by tyrants, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. There is honour in allowing for an orderly succession from one house to another. 

If you wish, you may nominate a successor should any command enough support.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1011.e.response: I will make the necessary preparations. The succession ceremony will take place in a month.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1011.f.response: I will make the necessary preparations. The succession ceremony will take place in a month.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1011.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1012.desc: The [Root.GetName] is strengthened by our houses working together. You have my gratitude for naming me as your successor, [Root.GetRulerName].
STH_klingon_mechanics.1012.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.102.desc.disloyal: You dishonour yourself as much as you dishonour the [Root.GetName].
STH_klingon_mechanics.102.desc.loyal: What cause could you have to dishonour the [Root.GetName] so?
STH_klingon_mechanics.102.desc.same_hous: Are you sure, Epetai? While the other Houses may see this in a positive light, is it wise to weaken the [Root.GetName]?
STH_klingon_mechanics.102.name: Reclaim [Root.GetName] Lands
STH_klingon_mechanics.1020.desc:
Many great warriors start and end their careers in the service of their house's militia rather than the Imperial fleet. 

If properly compensated, these warriors would gladly earn honour for both their house and the [Root.GetName] itself.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1020.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1021.desc.01: I am [houseLeader.GetName] of the [From.GetName]. Which of my warriors do you wish to honour with a commission in the Imperial Fleet?
STH_klingon_mechanics.1021.desc.02: Qapla', [Root.GetRulerTitle]. I am [houseLeader.GetName], gin'tak of your house. Which of your warriors do you wish to honour with a commission in the Imperial Fleet?
STH_klingon_mechanics.1021.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1022.desc: Qapla', [Root.GetRulerTitle]. I am [FromFrom.GetName] of the [From.GetName] and I pledge my life in service of the [Root.GetName].
STH_klingon_mechanics.1022.name: [FromFrom.GetName]'s Commission
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.a.disable: Reclaim the Torch of G'boj relic.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.a: Bestow the Torch of G'boj relic.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.b.disable: Reclaim the Hand of Kull relic.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.b: Bestow the Hand of Kull relic.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.c.disable: Reclaim the Armour of Sabak relic.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.c: Bestow the Armour of Sabak relic.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.desc.disloyal: So you wish to honour the [Root.GetName]? Very well, what will it be?
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.desc.loyal: As loyal servants of the [Root.Owner.GetName], the [Root.GetName] stands ready to accept any responsibility for upholding the honour of any order, or the defence of any you see fit.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.desc.same_hous: Epetai, this may not be wise. While I have no doubt that the [Root.GetName] deserves these honours, the other Great Houses may not be so willing to agree.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.e.disable: Reclaim oversight of the Order of the Bat'leth.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.e: Bestow oversight of the Order of the Bat'leth.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.f.disable: Reclaim oversight of the Order of Basai.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.f: Bestow oversight of the Order of Basai.
STH_klingon_mechanics.103.name: Award Titles and Honours
STH_klingon_mechanics.1030.desc:
The Great Houses are known to feud with each other over matters of honour. In the normal course of events this is healthy, however there are times when it may be prudent to promote unity, especially if an outside threat looms. 

The Houses below are currently engaged in such a feud.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1030.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1031.desc: The [From.GetName] has currently declared feuds against the following Great Houses.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1031.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1032.desc:
There are a number of ways we may appeal to [fromFaction.Leader.GetName] of the [From.GetName] and [fromfromFaction.Leader.GetName] of the [FromFrom.GetName] to end their feud. 

Influence and honours can be granted to both, or else resources can be promised. Alternatively, a public appeal to their duty to the [Root.GetName] may be enough.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1032.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1033.desc: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have been unable to negotiate an end to their feud, despite the intervention of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].
STH_klingon_mechanics.1033.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1034.desc: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have negotiated an end to their feud, following the intervention of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].
STH_klingon_mechanics.1034.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.104.desc.disloyal: You reveal your true intentions then? Ever the politician, [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName].
STH_klingon_mechanics.104.desc.loyal: This is surely joke? The [Root.GetName] has done nothing to warrant such... dishonour!
STH_klingon_mechanics.104.desc.same_hous: Very droll, Epetai. I almost thought you were serious for a moment there.
STH_klingon_mechanics.104.name: Dispense Discommendation
STH_klingon_mechanics.1040.b: Withdraw resources for the Imperial Fleet.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1040.desc:
The strength of the [Root.GetName] is divided between the Imperial Fleet and the Great House's militias. 

While it may look advantageous to bring the resources of the Houses under the direct control of the High Council, it is often the case that each House can operate their own fleets more efficiently. 

As [Root.GetRulerTitle] you may contribute resources to the militias to construct and operate their own fleets. Alternatively, resources can be withdrawn and used to construct ships under the control of the Imperial Fleet. 

As you may expect, the Great Houses themselves will react accordingly depending on your choice...

Each level of contribution will increase the amount of vessels that the Houses are able to construct themselves for their militias, which in turn is based upon the amount of planets and systems they own themselves.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1040.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1041.a.tooltip: Contribute a small amount of £ Minerals to the House in order to bolster future ship construction.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1041.b.tooltip: Contribute a moderate amount of £ Minerals to the House in order to bolster future ship construction.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1041.c.tooltip: Contribute a large amount of £ Minerals to the House in order to bolster future ship construction.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1041.desc: What size contribution do you wish to make to the militias?
STH_klingon_mechanics.1041.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1042.desc: On what scale do you wish to seize control of the House's war material?
STH_klingon_mechanics.1042.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.105.desc: You've seen sense then? The [Root.GetName]'s honour and integrity should never have been questioned, but if you truly wish to restore our place, then let us move forward for the good of the [Root.Owner.GetName].
STH_klingon_mechanics.105.name: Restore House Honour
STH_klingon_mechanics.1050.desc: nuqneH my [Root.GetRulerTitle]! I am [house_leader.GetRulerName] of the [great_house_name.GetName]. What is it that the High Council wants from us?
STH_klingon_mechanics.1050.name: Manage House Levies
STH_klingon_mechanics.120.desc: Following our attempt to seize control of a world that rightly belongs to us [factionCountryTemp.GetName] has acted with complete dishonour and rebelled against the Empire. All fleets, planets and individuals of [factionCountryTemp.GetName] should now be considered traitors.
STH_klingon_mechanics.120.name: [factionCountryTemp.GetName] has rebelled
STH_klingon_mechanics.1500.desc: The Klingon Empire has always been led by powerful houses, but every so often a new house reaches the level of greatness and worthy of a position at the top of Klingon society. The [great_house_target.GetName] has battled their way to the top and are ready to make their mark within the Klingon Empire.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1500.name: The Klingon Great Houses
STH_klingon_mechanics.1503.a: Dismantle the House of M'Rek HQ station.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1503.b: Restore the House of M'Rek HQ station.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1503.c: Dismantle the House of Mogh HQ station.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1503.d: Restore the House of Mogh HQ station.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1503.desc: A headquaters belonging to one of Empire's Great Houses has fallen into our possession. It's former owner was unable to keep hold of the property and the shipyard that comes with it. This building comes with a small overhead, we can either keep it or dismantle it for resources.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1503.e: Dismantle the House of Antaak HQ station.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1503.f: Restore the House of Antaak HQ station.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1503.g: Dismantle the House of Duras HQ station.

STH_klingon_mechanics.1504.desc:
Chancellor, our data from our Great Houses report that the following Houses do not currently own their own shipbuilding complex. This will severely limit their ability to support and defend the empire. 

We should look to rectify this situation as soon as possible.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1504.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1505.desc:
The Noble Houses are powerful and wealthy familys, but they lack the historical tradition and ancestory of the Great Houses. 

Promoting a Noble House will elevate their status to one of the Great Houses of the Empire and secure their loyalty and service , however it may cause friction with the old established Great Houses.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1505.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.1506.desc: The arrangements are in place to raise the status of [FROM.GetName] from Noble House to one of the ruling Great Houses, despite many of within the High Council voicing their objections to the plans.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1506.name: Promote to Great House
STH_klingon_mechanics.1507.desc:
[klingon_house_missing_shipyards.GetName] stands ready to receive its new Shipyards Chancellor! 

 Which world require our protection.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1507.name: Commision a new House Shipyard
STH_klingon_mechanics.1510.desc: Feuds between the Empire and the Great Houses rob all involved of a chance for glory and honour, we should look to end the discord between the High Council and one of our Great Houses.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1510.name: Klingon High Council
STH_klingon_mechanics.158.a: Of course this Council respects the [From.GetName]...
STH_klingon_mechanics.158.desc:
The [From.GetName] has expressed dissatisfaction with the direction of the [Root.Owner.GetName] for several years now. 

After a particularly heated debate in the Great Hall on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], Epetai [From.Leader.GetName] has threatened to declare Qutlh lajQo' and formally withdraw support for the High Council, except in matters of the Empire's defense.
STH_klingon_mechanics.158.name: [From.GetName] Withdraws Support
STH_klingon_mechanics.159.desc: Epetai [From.Leader.GetName] has expressed a willingness to withdraw [From.Leader.GetHerHis] declaration of Qutlh lajQo', and return full support to the High Council.
STH_klingon_mechanics.159.name: [From.GetName] Returns Support
STH_klingon_mechanics.160.desc: Following the death of the leader of the [popFaction.GetName], [factionLeader.GetName] has been confirmed as the new house Epetai.
STH_klingon_mechanics.160.name: [popFaction.GetName] Leadership
STH_klingon_mechanics.1600.desc: Only the High Council has the power and influence to select a new High Chancellor, the members of the council can decide that the current Chancellor is not acting honourably and revoke his position, but be aware doing so is a grave dishonour to the House stripped of its power and they will not take it lightly.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1600.name: The Rite of Succession
STH_klingon_mechanics.1601.desc: The bellow has been given and the warning has been served to the honored dead in Sto-vo-kor, for beware, a Klingon warrior is about to arrive. [From.GetName] has served the Empire until their dying breath and now it is time to select a new High Chancellor to leader the Empire to new glorious battles.
STH_klingon_mechanics.1601.name: The Rite of Succession
STH_klingon_mechanics.164.a.tooltip: The Council will spend influence to stop the feud between [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] before it intensifies into war.
STH_klingon_mechanics.164.a: Attempt to intervene to stop the feud.
STH_klingon_mechanics.164.b.tooltip: [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] are now feuding. This may break out into war between the Houses.
STH_klingon_mechanics.164.b: Houses can defend their own honour.
STH_klingon_mechanics.164.desc.01:
Tensions between the [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have escalated following a perceived insult toward Epetai [FromFrom.Leader.GetName] by the [From.GetName]'s resident war poet. 

Declaring a formal feud, many believe hostilities to be inevitable.
STH_klingon_mechanics.164.desc.02:
Tensions between the [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have escalated following an accusation that a Sutai in the service of the [FromFrom.GetName] has used the threat of rent increases to intimidate a number of shipyard workers pledged to the [From.GetName] in an area of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] where the $great_house_scientist$ owned several buildings. 

The insinuation of underhandedness has infuriated Epetai [FromFrom.Leader.GetName] and the entire [FromFrom.GetName]. Declaring a formal feud, many believe hostilities to be inevitable.
STH_klingon_mechanics.164.desc.03:
Tensions between the [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have escalated following a perceived insult toward the eldest cousin of [From.Leader.GetName] by the niece of [FromFrom.Leader.GetName], with embarrassing details of a failed courtship being circulated across [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]. 

With both houses declaring a formal feud, many believe hostilities to be inevitable.
STH_klingon_mechanics.164.name: Feuding Houses
STH_klingon_mechanics.166.a.tooltip: [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] are now friends, and will aid one another.
STH_klingon_mechanics.166.desc.01: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have turned a grudging respect into an enduring friendship. Furthermore, several marriages among junior members of both houses have solidified the relationship into an all but formal alliance.
STH_klingon_mechanics.166.desc.02: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have turned a grudging respect into an enduring friendship. The defence of a [FromFrom.GetName] militia officer by a [From.GetName] swordsmith against a gang of thugs on the streets of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] has solidified the relationship into an all but formal alliance.
STH_klingon_mechanics.166.desc.03: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have turned a grudging respect into an enduring friendship. A well received performance of the opera 'Aktuh and Maylota' performed by famed singers from both houses seems to signify the relationship has solidified into an all but formal alliance.
STH_klingon_mechanics.166.name: Allied Houses
STH_klingon_mechanics.168.a.tooltip: The [From.GetName] declares war on the [FromFrom.GetName], using the House Feud casus belli.
STH_klingon_mechanics.168.b: Enough! This is a waste of resources.
STH_klingon_mechanics.168.c: The [FromFrom.GetName] will prevail without the Imperial fleet.
STH_klingon_mechanics.168.d: The [FromFrom.GetName] will use all its might...
STH_klingon_mechanics.168.desc.01:
The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have declared a formal tlhaS as both sides seek to reclaim their honour following a number of grievances against the other. 

Both houses have appealed to their allies within the [Root.Owner.GetName] to bolster their ranks.
STH_klingon_mechanics.168.desc.02:
The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have declared a formal tlhaS as both sides seek to reclaim their honour following a number of grievances against the other. 

Both houses have appealed to their allies within the [Root.Owner.GetName] to bolster their ranks. Rumours circulate that [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] may use [Root.Owner.Leader.GetHerHis] position to give unfair advantage to the [FromFrom.GetName], a move sure to draw condemnation from unaffiliated houses.
STH_klingon_mechanics.168.e: This is a waste of resources.
STH_klingon_mechanics.168.name: Warring Houses
STH_klingon_mechanics.170.a.tooltip: The feud between [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] has ended.
STH_klingon_mechanics.170.desc.01: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have put aside their former grievances and proclaimed an end to the feud that had consumed much of their combined resources.
STH_klingon_mechanics.170.desc.02: The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have put aside their former grievances and proclaimed an end to the feud that had consumed much of their combined resources.
STH_klingon_mechanics.170.name: House Feud Ended
STH_klingon_mechanics.171.desc:
After initially showing signs of cooling down tensions between the [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have escalated back up following a perceived insult toward Epetai [FromFrom.Leader.GetName] by the [From.GetName]'s resident war poet. 

Declaring a formal feud, many believe hostilities to be inevitable.

STH_klingon_mechanics.172.name: [newCouncilLeader.GetName] Becomes [Root.GetRulerTitle]

The [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have seen relations grow cold, to the point that the alliance between the Houses has been dissolved. 

While no one single incident can be identified as root cause, a perceived insult directed at a [From.GetName] pilot by the [FromFrom.GetName]'s gin'tak seems to have been the catalyst.
STH_klingon_mechanics.175.desc.02:

In the face of conflict with the [From.GetName], all true Klingon warriors must put aside their disputes to unite against their common enemy. 

The ongoing rebellions that have plagued the Empire have formally ended.
STH_klingon_mechanics.2.name: House Divided

The House of [Root.GetRulerName]'s rebellion has succeeded with [Root.GetRulerName]'s troops storming the High Council chambers on [Root.Capital.GetName] and executing the leaders of the previous administration. 

The other Great Houses have signalled their willingness to accept the legitimacy of the House of [Root.GetRulerName]'s victory, though much needs to be done to rebuild the Empire from the conflict.

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.103.desc.loyal: As loyal servants of the [Root.Owner.GetName], the [factionCountryTemp.GetName] stands ready to accept any responsibility for upholding the honour of any order, or the defence of any you see fit.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.103.desc.same_: Epetai, this may not be wise. While I have no doubt that the [factionCountryTemp.GetName] deserves these honours, the other Great Houses may not be so willing to agree.

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.106.desc: The Empire is in need of the services of all loyal ships and crew. We demand a fleet is placed under the control of the Imperial Navy command. Failure to comply will be seen as most dishonourable.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.106.name: Commandeer a Fleet
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.107.desc: Consider this a gift from your Chancellor, the Imperial Navy hearby transfers an agreed fleet to your House as a sign of great faith.

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.109.desc: Having transfered the planet of [factionCountryTempNewPlanet.GetName] to our loyal [factionCountryTemp.GetName] we now have the option to transfer the whole system to their control.

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.110.desc.dislo: This is another foolish and dishonorable decision by a Chancellor who knows no honour and has no understanding of success.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.110.desc.loyal: If this is the will of our House Leader than it shall be done.

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.120.desc:

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.171.desc: Following a last minuite intervention by the High Council [From.GetName] and [FromFrom.GetName] have agreed to put aside their house feud and make peace over a barrel of Blood Wine.

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.172.name: House Feud Continues

As a result our relations with them has decreased.

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.303.desc:
It appears that a foreign power is attempting to forge a closer relationship with [factionCountryTempBribe.GetName]. 

The dishonourable fools of [klingon_houses_bribe_country.GetName] underestimated the loyalty of [factionCountryTempBribe.GetName] and the unity of the Klingon Empire!

STH_klingon_mechanics_new.304.desc:
Lord Chancellor, our spies have confirmed that one of our Great Houses, [factionCountryTempBribe.GetName], has accepted a bribe from [klingon_houses_bribe_country.GetName] in a bid to form a closer bond. 

As they did not openly disclose this contact we can only assume that they are colluding against the Empire!
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.304.name: A Great House has accepted a bribe
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.305.desc: Our noble House gladly accepted any spare ships that you have to offer to ensure that we continue to grow strong!
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.305.name: Fleet Transfer
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.306.desc: Our attempts to turn [factionCountryBetrayal.GetName] against the Klingon Empire has been successful, and the relationship between the Great House and its master has been considerably damaged, we must now wait to see if the House is brave enough to openly rebel against the High Command.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.306.name: House Turns on the Empire
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.307.desc:
Our efforts to turn [factionCountryBetrayal.GetName] against the Klingon Empire have failed, the fabled Klingon Honour was too strong to break and they have rejected our attempts. 

Time will tell if they notify the Klingon Empire of our attempts to undermine their unity, and it is unlikely the Empire will react kindly to this.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.307.name: House Remains loyal
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.308.desc:
[factionCountryBetrayal.GetName] has approached us to inform us that a 3rd party has attempted to buy their loyalty and turn them against their Empire. 

Like all good Klingons they placed loyalty to their chancellor above all else, a truly honourable action.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.308.name: Great House remains loyal
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.309.desc:
Our Klingon Intelligence agency has uncovered evidence that [factionCountryBetrayal.GetName] has coluded with a faction within [klingon_houses_betray_country.GetName] in a bid to turn the House against it's Empire. 

Relations with the House have considerably worsened as a result of this honourless action.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.309.name: Great House willing to betray us
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.310.desc:
With war declared against us, we can bring in our allies who have pledged to support us in our defensive wars. 

Should they agree to uphold their commitment they will join us in our battles.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.310.name: Call for assistance
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.311.desc:
We have been called upon to fullfil our defensive pledge towards [great_house_war_country.GetName] as they go to war. 

Should we fullfil our commitment we will join them in their defensive war.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.311.name: A call for help
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.312.desc: Our so called allies [great_house_war_country.GetName] have failed to honour their pledge and come to our aid, we must win our wars without them.
STH_klingon_mechanics_new.312.name: Betrayed!
STH_klingon_story.1.b: No more than the rambling of a drunk.
STH_klingon_story.1.desc:
A thick pungent smoke fills the air of the Pujbe' Targh tavern as the walls echo the sound of song and laughter from the gathered warriors. [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] found the Pujbe' Targh better suited to relieving the stresses of office; fewer Council Members and other nobles found their way to this side of the First City where common soldiers, weaponsmiths and poets dwelt. Those of high birth would drink in the QeylIs Qul where the Gagh was always fresh but the songs rang hollow. 

Standing by the vat of Blood Wine [Root.GetRulerName] sank a cup into the crimson liquid and drank deep from it.

'I tell you, I can find the sword!', an old woman nearby hisses to a companion who mutters back and walks away. The old woman moves to a table by the wall and hunches over her drink. 

'What sword do you seek?' [Root.GetRulerName] asks, intrigued. The old woman turns and her face soon twists in recognition. 

'You're [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]! Here!? You honour us...', she raises her cup in salute. Leaning in she says, 'My name is Le'tor and I'll tell you what I seek. Nothing less than the Sword of Kahless.' 

'You know where it is?' [Root.GetRulerName]'s eyes went wide at the name. 

'No, but I know where to start looking. All we need is a ship and I think you have a few of those.' The woman reached into her tunic and pulled forth an ancient looking datapad. 

'This is Hur'q, I'm sure it shows the route the petaQ's followed home after we drove them from Qo'nos. This is the key!' she says as she offers the pad to [Root.GetRulerName].
STH_klingon_story.1.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.10.desc: The Hur'q evacuation documentation is extensive, listing the routes back to Hur'q space that each transport ship was to take, apparently by way of a wormhole. One item stands out: a cargo ship with a manifest labelled 'alien artefacts', its destination listed as a storage facility on an uninhabitable world far from here.
STH_klingon_story.10.name: The Sword of Kahless
STH_klingon_story.1000.a.response: The trials will begin shortly. Qapla'!
STH_klingon_story.1000.b.response:
While I admit the battlefield of science is a pale substitute to true combat between warriors, should we really risk the empire by neglecting it? 

The threat these genetically engineered aliens pose is real!
STH_klingon_story.1000.b: This does not sound like an honourable venture.
STH_klingon_story.1000.c.response: The risks are substantial, though with your permission I would limit my trials to dishonoured criminals. Let them earn their honour back by serving the empire.
STH_klingon_story.1000.d: No, this is not the Klingon way.
STH_klingon_story.1000.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], my name is [antaak.GetName], a doctor attached to the Imperial Fleet. I would not wish to dishonour you with trivial matters, but I believe I have discovered an opportunity of enormous potential for the Klingon people. 

Recently we have received news of genetically engineered Humans demonstrating strength and guile that surpass even the mightiest of Klingon warriors. We can NOT allow these aliens to hold an advantage over us. 

With your permission I would like to conduct a series of experiments to reverse engineer their genetic enhancements, with the objective of applying them to our finest soldiers.
STH_klingon_story.1000.name: Incoming Transmission - Doctor Antaak

STH_klingon_story.1001.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], I'm aware you rejected my proposal to perform trials on genetically engineered Human DNA, but I must request you reconsider. I truly believe I have discovered an opportunity of enormous potential for the Klingon people. 

With your permission I would like to conduct a series of experiments to reverse engineer their genetic enhancements, with the objective of applying them to our finest soldiers.
STH_klingon_story.1001.name: Incoming Transmission - Doctor Antaak
