Leveraging the markets of the [primitive_civ.GetName], the Liquidators now have ownership over much of the governing body and world markets, which in their infinite wisdom have decided that joining the [Root.GetName] is preferable to economic ruin. Traders are flocking to [From.GetName] to take advantage of the new opportunities.
STH_observation.300.name: Monopolising Civilization
STH_observation.400.desc:
After infiltrating every facet of the ruling body on [FromFromFrom.GetName] and destroying some selective infrastructure, the operatives of the Obsidian Order have successfully convinced the provisional government of [primitive_civ.GetName] that allowing our troops to land to restore order and submitting themselves to the [Root.GetName] is in their best interests for a safe and stable future.

With our troops in position at every key juncture they will be now subject to our rule.
STH_observation.400.name: Occupation Complete
STH_observation.600.desc:
Our diplomats on [From.GetName] have spent years extolling the virtues of the Federation, and preparing the insular [primitive_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] people for Federation Membership, and today is the day of the signing ceremony. After the ceremony they will become a fully fledged member of the [Root.GetName], a momentous occasion.

Whilst being a full member of the [Root.GetName], they will handle their own worldly affairs.
STH_observation.600.name: Federation Membership
STH_observation.700.desc: Our Generals confirm that the planet [From.GetName] is now under our control, their primitive armies stood no chance against the forces of [Root.GetName]. The primitive [From.Owner.GetName] is no more!
STH_observation.700.name: Planet now under our control
STH_observation.701.desc: Our attempts to integrate this world into our Empire has failed, and we must now wait until we can re-attempt the process.
STH_observation.701.name: Integration Ended
STH_occupation_situation.1.a: We must look outside Cardassia for resources.
STH_occupation_situation.1.desc:
Years of neglect and over taxation of the skant resources of Cardassia Prime have finally caught up with the people of the Cardassian Union and now a period of harsh stellar activity from the Cardassian sun has ruined the crop growth for this season and put a strain on the already over worked food replication power grids. 

Environmentalists have been warning about this day from behind the scenes for many years, but have been ignored by those in power. 

Experts are predicting unless more drastic action is taken Cardassia Prime will struggle for a number of years.
STH_occupation_situation.1.name: Starvation strikes Cardassia Prime
STH_occupation_situation.10.desc: The Cardassian Union has made its intentions clear, they convert the resources from the planet Bajor and they are prepared to take them by force.
STH_occupation_situation.10.name: Cardassia wishes to annex Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.101.desc: Praise the Prophets! After declaring war many felt that the power of Cardassia would be too much for our meager forces to defend against, but the spirit of the Bajoran people will not be defeated and our long oppression is finally over. The retreating Cardassian forces implemented a scorched earth policy and it will take some years to recover, but our future is back in our own hands.
STH_occupation_situation.101.name: The Occupation of Bajor is over
STH_occupation_situation.102.desc:
The people of the planet Bajor have long been oppressed under a brutal occupation of their homeworld, it appears they no longer wish to live under these conditions and a number of resistance cells have started to rise up against their overlords. Our intelligence reports indicated there has been a wave of bombings and attacks against foreign targets on the planet. 

The Bajoran resistance has formally demanded the withdrawal of all foreign forces from the planet within 48 hours.
STH_occupation_situation.102.name: The Bajoran Occupation
STH_occupation_situation.103.desc:
The War between Bajor and Cardassia is over and despite their superior firepower the Cardassian Union has formally declared their withdrawal from Bajor. The guerilla tactics deployed by the resistance seems to have ground the Cardassian forces down and it seems the Central Command no longer deem the planet worth the effort of keeping. 

The people of Bajor may rejoice today, but it appears there is a lot of work to do if the planet is to recover.
STH_occupation_situation.103.name: The Occupation of Bajor is over
STH_occupation_situation.104.desc: The time has come to rid our home of the Cardassians, the resistance cells have made significant inroads into their defenses and we have secured an additional number of small ships to supplement our raiders. The Prophets guide us on this path and the path to a free Bajor. Our home will be ours once again.
STH_occupation_situation.104.name: Bajor demands its freedom
STH_occupation_situation.105.desc: The time has come to rid our home of the [bajoran_overlords.GetName], the resistance cells have made significant inroads into their defences and we have secured an additional number of small ships to supplement our raiders. The Prophets guide us on this path and the path to a free Bajor. Our home will be ours once again.
STH_occupation_situation.105.name: The Occupation must end
STH_occupation_situation.106.a.response: Don't make us laugh Cardassian! You murder our people, you pillidge our world. This ends now.
STH_occupation_situation.106.a: Cardassia has always been a friend to the Bajoran people...
STH_occupation_situation.106.b: Bajor is no longer worth the effort.
STH_occupation_situation.106.desc: Cardassians, this is your final chance to withdraw your forces from Bajor, your illegal occupation and plunder of our world ends here and now.
STH_occupation_situation.106.name: Bajoran Freedom
STH_occupation_situation.107.desc: The Cardassians have rejected our demand on them to leave, this leaves us with no choice. If we are to be free then it must be war.
STH_occupation_situation.107.name: Cardassia Denies us Liberation
STH_occupation_situation.108.desc: In a shock decision we have been notified by the Cardassian civilian government that their 'assistance' and 'friendship 'will no longer be offered to the Bajoran people. Their forces have begun to evacuate, destroying any and all equipment that they can get their hands on, including vast the vast fields of the Dahkur Province and the slaughter at Gallitep. The former ore-processing station Terok Nor now belongs to us despite the massive damage done to it as the Cardassians left.
STH_occupation_situation.108.name: Cardassia withdraws from Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.109.desc: After years of occupation, the Cardassians have withdrawn from Bajor. The exact cause of the withdrawal is largely a matter of opinion; while the Bajorans attributed it to the efforts of the Bajoran Resistance, the Cardassians regarded it as an entirely political decision. In the days leading up to the withdraw, the Cardassians diverted warships away from Bajor in an attempt to shore up their border territories.
STH_occupation_situation.109.name: Cardassia withdraws from Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.11.desc:
The people of Bajor are in dire need of the firm supportive hands that we can offer and their backwater beliefs and outlook cries out for the appointment of a Prefect. 

A number of standout candidates have put themselves forward for the role, which we may now appoint to secure our interests on Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.11.name: A Prefect for Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.110.desc: The last of our transports has arrived back into Cardassian space following our decision to abandon the peasant Bajorans to their backwater planet. They will soon learn the meaning of crossing the Cardassian people and no doubt they will come crawling back to us begging for our help.
STH_occupation_situation.110.name: Cardassia withdraws from Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.112.desc: Today is a humiliating day to be a Cardassian, the civilian government has signed the withdrawal agreement forcing us to leave the planet and its precious resources behind. This is a humiliating blow for the Union and one that we must see avenged. The Bajorans have not seen the last of us.
STH_occupation_situation.112.name: Cardassian Forces defeated
STH_occupation_situation.113.desc: After years of living under the rule of the Cardassian Union, it appears the Bajoran people have had enough and led by their resistance movement have declared war on Cardassia in a bid to create a free Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.113.name: Bajor Breaks from Cardassia
STH_occupation_situation.115.b: Attempt to root out the terrorists.
STH_occupation_situation.115.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] those treacherous Bajoran fools have betrayed the gracious offer of peace and reconciliation we have offered them. 

An explosive planted on the [assassinated_ship.GetName] destroyed the ship and our delegate [assassinated_cardassian.GetName]. There are strong calls from Cardassia that we have been too lenient and must react with Cardassian vengeance.
STH_occupation_situation.115.name: Peace conference sabotaged
STH_occupation_situation.116.a.tooltip: Release Bajor from the occupation and allow them to become full subjects of the Union, but lose the benefits of being an occupational force.
STH_occupation_situation.116.b.tooltip: The Bajorans are only good for slaves, now is our chance to make slaves of all Bajorans on the planet.
STH_occupation_situation.116.desc:
The peace talks with the Bajoran leadership has been successful and in return for a greater standing within our great Union the Bajoran ministers and Vedeks have agreed to give up the location of the various resistance cells located across the planet. 

Obtaining the loyalty of the Bajoran leadership is truly a triumph of Cardassian might. 

We may now uphold our word and allow Bajor to become a true subject of Cardassia or follow the advice of many of our older Legates and betray the Bajorans and turn them into slaves.
STH_occupation_situation.116.name: Peace reached on Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.117.desc: After years of occupation the Cardassians and Bajorans have come to an understanding and Bajor has formally submitted to Cardassian rule. The occupation is over and the resistance has been defeated.
STH_occupation_situation.117.name: Bajor and Cardassia unite
STH_occupation_situation.118.desc: Despite years of resistance the Bajoran freedom movement has been ended in an act of betrayal from the Cardassian military which has left the Bajorans as little more than slaves to the will of the Cardassian machine.
STH_occupation_situation.118.name: Cardassians enslave the Bajorans
STH_occupation_situation.12.desc:
Our acquisition of the Bajoran world has opened up new possibilities and new opportunities for us, but I put it to you that we cannot achieve these goals unless we fully occupy the planet with a fully armed military presence. 

This occupation will help ensure that the Bajorans continue to serve the needs of our people, and of course our troops will play their part in aiding our Bajoran friends.
STH_occupation_situation.12.name: The Occupation
STH_occupation_situation.121.desc: One of our ships has suffered an unexpected malfunction resulting in a reactor breach that destroyed the ship. Whilst we have no evidence to prove it senior members of the Obsidian Order believe that it was no coincidence that the ship had recently received cargo that originated from Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.121.name: Ship Sabotaged
STH_occupation_situation.122.desc: One of our leaders [killed_leader.GetName] has been found dead whilst on shore leave, it looks like they were murdered by the terrorist group calling themselves the Bajoran Resistance. They are nothing but criminals and will pay for their actions.
STH_occupation_situation.122.name: Cardassian Citizens Killed
STH_occupation_situation.123.desc: A high ranking member of the civilian council has gone missing whilst travelling back from the Bajoran system, she was inspected the Ore processing facilities on the Nor-Class station orbiting Bajor and has not reported back to their superior officer.
STH_occupation_situation.123.name: Ship Sabotaged
STH_occupation_situation.124.desc: One of our transports carrying valuable cargo has disappeared whilst travelling through the badlands. We have now lost the transport and the crucial cargo being carried to Cardassia from Bajor. We suspect this is the work of the Bajoran Resistance.
STH_occupation_situation.124.name: Transport Vanishes
STH_occupation_situation.13.desc:
Greetings citizens of Bajor, my name is [bajoran_occupation_prefect.GetName] and I will be your new Prefect and we want to welcome in a new era of peace and prosperity between our two worlds. 

Do not be afraid of the troops landing across the planet, they are here to help rebuild Bajor and ensure our interests are met. 

May this be the start of a long and prosperous future for our worlds.
STH_occupation_situation.13.name: Cardassian Occupation Begins
STH_occupation_situation.130.desc: Following months of work by Cardassian negotiators, diplomats and select interventions by the Obsidian Order, the Bajoran people have been pacified and their leadership has been persuaded to follow Cardassian rule. We can now truly consider Bajor a loyal servant of the [Root.GetName].
STH_occupation_situation.130.name: Bajoran population pacified
STH_occupation_situation.14.desc:
The time has come to assign a new Prefect to oversee the Bajoran Occupation. 

A list of candidates has been put forward and one mus be selected to continue our interests on Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.14.name: A New Bajoran Prefect
STH_occupation_situation.15.c: The situation appears to be getting dangerously out of control!
STH_occupation_situation.15.desc_01: Greetings [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName], I bring you the latest progress report from our operations on Bajor and I am pleased to say that all is going well, production targets are being met and the locals are providing little resistance. Bajor continues to be a rich source of resource for Cardassia.
STH_occupation_situation.15.desc_02: Greetings [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName], I bring you the latest progress report from our operations on Bajor and we continue to see a rich production of minerals and food from our mining operations across the planet, with our production targets being consistently met. Our contacts within the Obsidian Order have started to report signs of malconent from the locals, but they remain unfocused and mostly just noise.
STH_occupation_situation.15.desc_03: Time for another report [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName], whilst operations continue with typical Cardassian efficiency the ungrateful locals continue to cause some... minor concerns, nothing that our local troops cannot handle, but it has hampered some of our production targets.
STH_occupation_situation.15.desc_04: I have little time for this [Root.GetLeaderTitle] [Root.GetLeaderName], but as requested the local insurgents continue to make a nuisance of themselves, nothing that we cannot handle, but had I been given the funding required I would have quite easily dispatched these Bajoran pesks. The complete pacification of the native population maybe our most effective solution...
STH_occupation_situation.15.name: Report from Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.16.desc: A list of replacement candidates for the role of the Bajoran Prefect has been made available to Central Command for their approval.
STH_occupation_situation.16.name: A New Bajoran Prefect
STH_occupation_situation.17.desc: Our mines and labour camps are now ready to turn over the resources that we have collected from Bajor, we shall approach the Bajoran government to arrange for the transportation of these resources to our orbital facilities.
STH_occupation_situation.17.name: Harvest Resources
STH_occupation_situation.18.desc:
Attention Bajoran Workers! It is once again time to lay down your tools and allow your Cardassian overseers the chance to collect the efforts of your labours. 

Any attempt to prevent us from completing this activity will be met with severe force and punishment for you and your families.
STH_occupation_situation.18.name: Resource Collection
STH_occupation_situation.19.desc_01: As promised we provide you with all that Bajor has to offer as we continue to look to work with our Cardassian friends.
STH_occupation_situation.19.desc_02: Your payment will be made ready for you to collect Cardassian, I believe there is nothing more for us to speak on today.
STH_occupation_situation.19.desc_03: Take what you must and let us be done with this conversation.
STH_occupation_situation.19.desc_04: You Cardassians take and take with no regard for the consequences, mark our words the Prophets will see better times for the Bajoran people.
STH_occupation_situation.19.name: Resource Collection
STH_occupation_situation.2.desc:
Through careful management of the remaining resources and the hard work by planetary environmentalists and leading agricultural experts we have made a significant dent in the impact in the global starvation that has been plaguing Cardassia Prime.

The government has officially declared the crisis on the homeworld as over.
STH_occupation_situation.2.name: Cardassia Starvation Over
STH_occupation_situation.20.desc_01: As promised we provide you with all that Bajor has to offer as we continue to look to work with our Cardassian friends.
STH_occupation_situation.20.desc_02: Your payment will be made ready for you to collect Cardassian, I believe there is nothing more for us to speak on today.
STH_occupation_situation.20.desc_03: Take what you must and if you feel the need to punish us then so be it, we can do no more.
STH_occupation_situation.20.desc_04: This is all we can provide, mark our words the Prophets will see better times for the Bajoran people.
STH_occupation_situation.21.a: Get out of our sights Bajoran.
STH_occupation_situation.21.desc_01: Please forgive us, the harvests have been poor this year and we have so little to give you, we will work harder to ensure future loads meet the quota.
STH_occupation_situation.21.desc_02: This is all we have to give at this stage, we will continue to slave away to produce more for next time.
STH_occupation_situation.21.desc_03: Our people slave and suffer and we can produce no more, do what must be done.
STH_occupation_situation.21.desc_04: This is all you shall receive from Bajorans and be thankful that the resistance doesn't make you pay for your crimes against our people.
STH_occupation_situation.22.a: Our lives will never be the same.
STH_occupation_situation.22.desc: The first wave of Cardassian Troops have landed on our soil bringing with them their weapons and prowess. A sense of fear and concern washes over our population centres, but our Cardassian contacts continue to assure us that these forces are here to protect us and help build our infrastructure. For now we must trust this is true, but there is little we could do either way.
STH_occupation_situation.22.name: Foreign Troops on our soil
STH_occupation_situation.24.desc:
As we continue to progress our plans for Bajor, our military and expansion advisors recommend installing a new more agreeable regime that is more supportive of our goals for the planet. 

The 'Bajoran Occupational Government' will continue to serve the interests of all parties and legitimise our occupation of the planet in the eyes of our galactic neighbours.
STH_occupation_situation.24.name: A puppet state
STH_occupation_situation.25.desc:
Greetings Bajorans and greetings from your friends on Cardassia, as part of our continued friendship we have decided that it would be in your best interests if we helped provide you with a new stable government and leadership. 

From this moment onwards the Bajoran Republic will be run by the newly created 'Bajoran Occupational Government' and together we will build a better future for our people.
STH_occupation_situation.25.name: A new Regime
STH_occupation_situation.26.a: For the good of both worlds.
STH_occupation_situation.26.desc: Greetings [Root.GetRulerTitle] I bring you greetings and blessings from your loyal subjects on Bajor, the new governing body is now in place and ready to serve you in all things, just as the Prophets would desire.
STH_occupation_situation.26.name: Greetings from Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.27.desc:
Children of the Prophets, I speak for the downtrodden and voiceless, for we are all loved by the Prophets... this partnership with the Cardassians is a shame, we live under occupation as our freedoms are eroded and our way of life is slowly taken from us. 

I urge all of us to stand united and in a single voice ask the Cardassians to leave our world.
STH_occupation_situation.27.name: Religious Leader Speaks Out
STH_occupation_situation.28.c: Make an example of their followers.
STH_occupation_situation.28.d: This is not worth our time.
STH_occupation_situation.28.desc:
It appears that a notable Bajoran religious leader has started actively speaking out against our presence on Bajor, this would not normally be a cause for concern, but those spiritualistic fools have started listening to these words risking unrest amongst those working the fields and mines. 

We should instruct our planetary forces to act.
STH_occupation_situation.28.name: Bajoran Dissent
STH_occupation_situation.29.desc: Bajorans! Our forces have today arrested [BajoranReligiousLeader.GetName] for causing civic unrest, now is a time for unity among our people and the type of rhetoric being spouted will no longer be tolerated, let this be a lesson to all who wish to cause trouble, it will not be allowed!
STH_occupation_situation.29.name: Vedek Arrested
STH_occupation_situation.3.desc: Citizens from across the Union grow eager for Central Command to put our newest acquisition to good use, the fertile lands and rich mineral deposits of Bajor are ripe for use by the hardworking Cardassian's in need of the bounty.
STH_occupation_situation.3.name: Time to put the Bajoran's to Work
STH_occupation_situation.30.desc:
Bajorans! You will no doubt now be aware that Cardassian forces moved in to arrest and detain Bajoran dissidents causing unrest and sowing ill will between our governments, they mean to harm our special relationship and they will face Cardassian justice. 

Let this be a lesson to anyone who wishes to speak out against us.
STH_occupation_situation.30.name: Population Arrested
STH_occupation_situation.31.desc:
Bajorans! Today Cardassian troops moved in and executed known troublemaker [BajoranReligiousLeader.GetName] for crimes against Cardassia and Bajor. Troublemakers will not be tolerated and it will not stand. 

I hope this is the last I must speak to you on this subject.
STH_occupation_situation.31.name: [BajoranReligiousLeader.GetName] Executed
STH_occupation_situation.32.desc:
Bajoran Citizens we know that there are those amongst you speaking out against our partnership, we offer this as a one-time warning, we will not tolerate this type of behaviour from this point forward religious gatherings will no longer be permitted. 

Consider yourself lucky that we were feeling benevolent.
STH_occupation_situation.32.name: A message from Cardassia
STH_occupation_situation.33.desc:
Reports are coming in from the Kendra Province that a group of unarmed protesters were rounded up and arrested by Cardassian troops following a peaceful protest. 

There has been no official word from our Cardassian Prefect on why they were arrested or where the protesters were taken following their arrest.
STH_occupation_situation.33.name: Pacifists Voice their Concern
STH_occupation_situation.34.desc: News coming in from Rakantha Province that there have been explosions at one of the Cardassian Military bases, the Cardassians are claiming that the matter was purely an internal incident and that there was no breach in security, however this has not stopped rumours circulating that a band of Bajoran youths manages to sneak into the base and ignite an ammunitions cache.
STH_occupation_situation.34.name: Explosions Heard
STH_occupation_situation.35.desc: Rumors are circulating that a group of Vedeks were able to successfully convince a local merchant guild to call off a protest against the trade restrictions imposed by Cardassian officials in the Kendra Valley, fearing that the Cardassian Military would intervene the Vedeks were able to persuade the merchants to take their goods and complaints elsewhere.
STH_occupation_situation.35.name: Riots Averted
STH_occupation_situation.4.desc: For too long now our people have looked out across the stars to the blue world of Bajor and the rich resources that in unfairly holds, the recent poor harvests on Cardassia Prime have led to a number of food shortages and discontent amongst the population. Military command believe the solution to our problems can be resolved with the help of the abundances of riches that Bajor holds. Annexing Bajor and bringing them into the Cardassian Union will provide us with the raw materials we need to sustain our way of life and provide the backwater Bajorans with a more evolved means of existence.
STH_occupation_situation.4.name: Resources low on Cardassia
STH_occupation_situation.40.desc: Legates and honourable members of Central Command, I bring to you a suggestion on how we can boost our dwindling gains from Bajor, our industrialists propose the construction of a new Nor-Class starbase in Orbit of the planet, with state-of-the-art ore processing facilities. What better way of constructing the station than using the most expendable resources in the system... the Bajorans themselves!
STH_occupation_situation.40.name: Terok Nor
STH_occupation_situation.41.desc: People of Bajor, as of this morning the Cardassian Union has granted permission to construct our newest orbital facility, which we have named 'Terok Nor' We will be rounding up and selecting those we need to help construct the starbase and work within its state of the art ore processing bays to ensure that your world continues to remain useful to the Cardassian Union.
STH_occupation_situation.41.name: Terok Nor
STH_occupation_situation.42.desc: Cardassia has proudly announced the construction of its latest orbital ore processing facility above the annexed world of Bajor, boosting an ability to process resources at an ever-increasing rate and proclaiming the station to be the pinnacle of Cardassian engineering and mastery.
STH_occupation_situation.42.name: Terok Nor
STH_occupation_situation.43.desc:
In horrifying news reports are coming in across Bajor that the Cardassians have opened up several Labor Camps across the planet, pulling in Bajoran's as slaves from local farms and population centres far and wide. 

We are now little more than slaves on our planet forced to work in the most terrible of conditions.
STH_occupation_situation.43.name: Labor Camps Open
STH_occupation_situation.44.desc: Exciting news from Bajor, the 1st of our new labor camps has now opened across the surface of Bajor the output from the planet's enslaved population will be increased as a result.
STH_occupation_situation.44.name: Labor Camps Open
STH_occupation_situation.45.desc: Our latest labor camp, Gallitep is ready to open its doors to a Bajoran workforce for the first time, this marks a new and exciting period in our occupation of Bajor as both a reminder to the natives that we are their better in every way and that there are fates worse than death when it comes to disobeying our commands.
STH_occupation_situation.45.name: Gallitep labor camp
STH_occupation_situation.46.desc: A terrifying new horror has been inflicted upon us by the Cardassians, at Gallitep close to the Dakhur Hills, a new forced labor camp has been opened up. Conditions in the camp are considered to be brutal and hostile and a death sentence to many sent there.
STH_occupation_situation.46.name: Gallitep labor camp
STH_occupation_situation.47.desc_01: With each passing update, we receive further horrific details of the atrocities occurring within the Gallitep Labor Camp, news reaches us that the new director of the camp, a Cardassian Gul named Darhe'el has taken to executing Bajoran workers for his amusement and to keep the up the moral of his own troops.
STH_occupation_situation.47.desc_02: A sizeable explosion was detected at the Camp in Gallitep today as a reported mining accident released waves of toxic fumes over Bajorans and Cardassians, the camp leader Darhe'el was reportedly off-world during the incident but his punishment is likely to be severe.
STH_occupation_situation.47.desc_03: We have received more horrifying news from Gallitep as yet more Bajoran workers are killed following an attempted escape from the facility, the Cardassian overseers responded by executing an entire work party as a message to those tempted to try and escape.
STH_occupation_situation.47.desc_04: Reports coming in from camp insiders suggest that Gul Darhe'el has been recognized as one of the most brutal overseers of any labor camp on Bajor. Innocent Bajorans were executed regularly, but not before they were tortured and humiliated.
STH_occupation_situation.47.desc_05: The Butcher of Gallitep has struck again as the latest death toll from the labor camp continues to rise.
STH_occupation_situation.47.name: News from Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.48.desc: My fellow members of the [resistance_cell.GetName], we cannot stand and allow the atrocities at Gallitep to remain unchallenged, the time has come to make a stand, to fight back against the Cardassians. I propose that we liberate Gallitep and burn the camp to the ground as a symbol that Bajor will no longer be oppressed.
STH_occupation_situation.48.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.49.desc:
Events at Gallitep can be told in many ways, for the Bajorans it was an act of Freedom, for the Cardassians an act of terrorism... But what is known is that a small Resistance Cell was able to infiltrate and tear down one of the most brutal camps on the planet. 

A clear message that the Bajoran people will no longer taking the occupation lying down.
STH_occupation_situation.49.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.5.a.response: We would strongly recommend that you do not reject out very generous offer.
STH_occupation_situation.5.b.response: Welcome to the great Cardassian Union.
STH_occupation_situation.5.b: Bajor will never submit to Cardassia.
STH_occupation_situation.5.desc: The audacity of the Bajoran government! They have reject our gracious offer. For their own good we have no choice but to provide our protection we must take what is ours by force.
STH_occupation_situation.5.name: Invitation to join Cardassia
STH_occupation_situation.50.desc: Despite the best efforts of the Resistance Cell the camp guards can fend off the attack, with many members of the cell captured or killed in the assault, a new attack will need to be arranged, but it will take some time for Resistance to regain it's strength in this region.
STH_occupation_situation.50.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.51.desc: Reports from Bajor have come in, with the most concerning news, it appears that a rag-tag group of Bajoran extremists have targeted our camp at Gallitep killing hundreds of Cardassians and inflicting countless amounts of damage to our interests.
STH_occupation_situation.51.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.52.desc: Reports from Bajor have come in, with the most concerning news, it appears that a rag-tag group of Bajoran extremists attempted to target our camp at Gallitep however our brave troops were able to repel the attack and inflict considerable damage to the Resistance.
STH_occupation_situation.52.name: Liberation of Gallitep
STH_occupation_situation.6.a: Declare War on the Bajoran Republic.
STH_occupation_situation.6.desc: The audacity of the Bajoran government! They have reject our gracious offer. For their own good we have no choice but to provide our protection we must take what is ours by force.
STH_occupation_situation.6.name: Declare War on the Bajoran Republic
STH_occupation_situation.60.desc: My fellow Bajorans! It is time that we stood up and rid ourselves of the oppressing force that is the Cardassian Union, for too long they have stolen our lands, our culture, and our lives, I say no more! We must resist, for a free Bajor for every Bajoran!
STH_occupation_situation.60.name: The Bajoran Resistance
STH_occupation_situation.61.desc:
The Bajoran peasants and farmers have taken up arms against us and banded together to form an organised Resistance movement! 

These terrorists are now capable of harming our interests on Bajor and inflicting serious harm to our operations there.
STH_occupation_situation.61.name: Bajor Rises Up
STH_occupation_situation.62.desc:
The Bajoran people have taken up arms against the Cardassians in the form of a planetary resistance movement. 

We shall soon see whether they have the strength of will and character to repel their oppressors.
STH_occupation_situation.62.name: Bajor Rises Up
STH_occupation_situation.63.desc:
It appears the Bajorans attempted to form a resistance movement, however it looks like their resolve faltered as they ran scared of the power of Cardassia. 

Any hit of an organised resistance is over.
STH_occupation_situation.63.name: Bajor is ours
STH_occupation_situation.7.desc: The Bajorans never stood a chance against our fleets and we have crushed them, our troops now walk on across their open fields and our generals lay claim to their property. However they have one last untapped resource which we should put to use, their people are excellent workers and will serve our us well in the labor camps and in the new ore processing centre built in orbit. We shall treat them well and they shall be grateful for all the benefits we will provide them.
STH_occupation_situation.7.name: Bajor belongs to us
STH_occupation_situation.70.desc: My fellow Bajorans! It is time that we stood up and rid ourselves of the oppressing force that is the Cardassian Union, for too long they have stolen our lands, our culture, and our lives, I say no more! We must resist, for a free Bajor for every Bajoran!
STH_occupation_situation.70.name: Bajoran Freedom
STH_occupation_situation.71.b: Rejected, steal an Orb as punishment.
STH_occupation_situation.71.desc:
[This.GetName] Occupiers, the people of Bajor demand our freedom and the end to your wrongful occupation of our world, you have misunderstood the nature of the Bajoran people if you believe that we will continue to take this imprisonment of our world lying down! 

Free Bajor in the name of the Prophets!
STH_occupation_situation.71.name: Bajoran Freedom
STH_occupation_situation.72.desc: Bajor's bid to ask for its freedom has been granted, only time will tell what this means for the Bajoran people and their occupiers.
STH_occupation_situation.72.name: Bajoran Freedom Granted
STH_occupation_situation.73.desc: Bajor's bid to ask for its freedom has been rejected, only time will tell what this means for the Bajoran people and their occupiers.
STH_occupation_situation.73.name: Bajoran Freedom Rejected
STH_occupation_situation.78.desc: One of our cells has uncovered the schematics for a newly installed Cardassian subspace relay station outside the capital city, this gives us a unique opportunity to infiltrate the base and cause a significant setback to Cardassian operations on Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.78.name: Communications Sabotage
STH_occupation_situation.79.desc: Our resistance team has picked up an additional opportunity, upon reaching the subspace station, the team located an outbound transport to an orbital communications station, with enough explosives to reduce the station to debris the team took the chance to set a trap for the inbound Cardassian team.
STH_occupation_situation.79.name: A further oppertunity
STH_occupation_situation.8.desc: The Cardassian Union have declared war on Bajor, it looks like the barren world seeks to harvest the riches and make them its own.
STH_occupation_situation.8.name: Cardassia claims Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.80.b: This is not worthy of attention.
STH_occupation_situation.80.desc:
Strange subspace readings have been detected in the capital city of our acquired Bajoran colony. These irregular interferences block a substantial part of our subspace communication channels and thus reduce our ability to engage in trade with the world. 

We must find out where the jamming devices are located on the surface to restore channels to central command on Cardassia Prime.
STH_occupation_situation.80.name: Subspace Interferences
STH_occupation_situation.81.desc:
After months of investigating the Bajoran underground resistance cells, we have finally tracked down the local militia's base of operation in the outskirts of Rakhanta province. 

Upon further questioning the leader of the resistance our away team has acquired intelligence suggesting another sabotage operation targeting [Root.Solar_System.Starbase.GetName].
STH_occupation_situation.81.name: Bajoran Resistance
STH_occupation_situation.82.c: Every Bajoran must suffer for this.
STH_occupation_situation.82.d: Open peace talks with the ministers.
STH_occupation_situation.82.desc:
Upon arrival at [bajoran_starbase.GetName] the troop transport barely manages to evade the huge pylons and structural debris floating around Bajor's sun. Glowing bright from the massive explosion, they indicate the complete loss of the station. 

After relaying the disturbing news to central command on Cardassia Prime, a construction ship has been dispatched for immediate reconstruction of [bajoran_starbase.GetName].
STH_occupation_situation.82.name: Subspace Interferences
STH_occupation_situation.83.a: Bajor will be free once again.
STH_occupation_situation.83.desc: The Bajoran people have suffered for too long at the hands of [bajoran_overlords.GetName], they plunder our world, enslave our people forcing them into concentration camps or into mining camps stealing our natural resources and committing genocide in the name of enlightening our people. The resistance movement has gathered enough support an with galactic opinion now swinging against the forced occupation of Bajor, now is our time to strike back and push [bajoran_overlords.GetName] from our home and with the Prophets on our side to guide our way we shall be victorious.
STH_occupation_situation.83.name: The Occupation must end
STH_occupation_situation.83_desc.01: We have had a concerning report in from the Prefect of Bajor, an annexed backwater resource colony outside of the badlands, the 'Bajoran Resistance', once considered to be a ragtag group of peasants and farmers has managed to unite the planet behind their movement to drive our forces from the planet, but what is more concerning is that the plight of the Bajorans is starting to reach the ears of our galactic neighbours. The Bajorans now shout with a singular message...
STH_occupation_situation.84.desc: The explosion could be seen from the majority of population locations across Bajor and sparked quiet celebrations from our downtrodden people, a clear signal of intent, that Bajor is free!
STH_occupation_situation.84.name: Cardassian Forces Destroyed
STH_occupation_situation.85.desc: Our long-range scans have picked up evidence of fighting on the remote world of Bajor, our intelligence reports suggest that the local Bajorans are fighting back against the occupying Cardassian forces that have beset their homeworld for many years.
STH_occupation_situation.85.name: Trouble brewing on Bajor
STH_occupation_situation.86.a: What business is this of theirs?
STH_occupation_situation.86.desc: Our embassy on [prev.capital_scope.GetName] has received an official message of condemnation from [prev.GetName] against our occupation of Bajor.
STH_occupation_situation.86.name: Galactic Condemnation
STH_occupation_situation.9.desc: The Cardassian Union has annexed Bajor in an audacious attempt to bolster their own resources. The galactic community has largely condemned the act, but so far no action has been taken by any of the major empires
STH_occupation_situation.9.name: Cardassia annexes Bajor
STH_onaction.1020.desc: Our new vassal [This.GetName] has a long-renowned tradition of space exploration, which has resulted in them collecting and recording star maps from their earliest ventures into space, they are now offering us those maps as a sign of respect.
STH_onaction.1020.name: Ancient Starmap
STH_onaction.7030.desc: Citizens of [Root.GetName] are going to the polls to elect a new [Root.GetRulerTitle].
STH_onaction.7030.name: Elections Open
STH_onaction.7031.desc: Polls are now closed in [Root.GetName] elections to vote in a new [Root.GetRulerTitle].
STH_onaction.7031.name: Elections Closed
STH_onaction.900.desc:
The recent death of the noted leader [leaderTarget.GetName] has been felt across the [Root.GetName]. 

Many in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] community feel that [leaderTarget.GetName]'s accomplishments were so great that renaming a starship in memory is an appropriate sign of respect.
STH_onaction.900.name: Death of [From.GetName]
STH_onaction.900.z: There are other ways to honour [leaderTarget.GetName].
STH_onaction.901.desc:
Captain [oldLeader.GetName] has passed away leaving the question of the captaincy of the [USS_Defiant.GetName] open. 

After much infighting among [oldLeader.GetHerHis] crew, [oldLeader.GetName]'s favoured officer, [defiant_leader.GetName] has taken command.
STH_onaction.901.name: Death of [oldLeader.GetName]
STH_operation.1400.desc_01:
Our espionage team working [spynetwork.leader.GetName] have obtained the fleet deployments for [Target.Owner.GetName] and the location of a number of vulnerable targets.

 Our teams will report back a list of ships we should look to target.
STH_operation.1400.desc_dominion:
Founders, we have had reports in from our field operatives on [Target.Owner.Capital.GetName], [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has gained access to fleet deployments and will determine which targets are available.

[spynetwork.leader.GetName] will report back a list of ships we should look to target.
STH_operation.1400.desc_obsidianOrder:
Report in from the Obsidian Order Operative in the field on [Target.Owner.Capital.GetName], [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has gained access to fleet deployments and will determine which targets are available.

[spynetwork.leader.GetName] will report back a list of ships we should look to target.
STH_operation.1400.desc_starfleet:
Our agent has obtained the fleet deployments for [Target.Owner.GetName] and the location of a number of vulnerable targets.

[spynetwork.leader.GetName] will report back a list of ships we should look to target.
STH_operation.1400.desc_talShiar: Report in from Tal Shiar Operative in the field on [Target.Owner.Capital.GetName], Operative [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has gained access to fleet deployments and will determine which targets are available.
STH_operation.1400.name: Operation Report, Ship Surveillance
STH_operation.1401.desc: [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been observing the potential targets and has identified several opportunities to begin the sabotage mission.
STH_operation.1401.name: Operation Report. Targets Observed
STH_operation.1405.a.tooltip: Our espionage policy should be at least level 2.
STH_operation.1405.c.tooltip: Our espionage policy should be at least level 3.
STH_operation.1405.desc_dominion: Mighty Founders, our operative [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has filed a report with Dominion Security. There are three choices of ships that we could begin the mission against, a construction ship would be the easiest target, followed by a science ship and then a military ship would be the hardest challenge.
STH_operation.1405.desc_obsidianOrder: [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has reported back into their contacts within the Order. There are three choices of ships that we could begin the mission against, a construction ship would be the easiest target, followed by a science ship and then a military ship would be the hardest challenge.
STH_operation.1405.desc_starfleet: [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has filed a report with Starfleet Intelligence. There are three choices of ships that we could begin the mission against, a construction ship would be the easiest target, followed by a science ship and then a military ship would be the hardest challenge.
STH_operation.1405.desc_talShiar: [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has reported back into their Tal Shiar handlers. There are three choices of ships that we could begin the mission against, a construction ship would be the easiest target, followed by a science ship and then a military ship would be the hardest challenge.
STH_operation.1405.name: Operation Report. Select Target
STH_operation.1406.desc_01: Our operation is ready to begin, our agents have identified the [target_construction_ship1.GetName] as being vulnerable for an attack. Applying additional resources will increase the chances of success.
STH_operation.1406.desc_02: Our operation is ready to begin, our agents have identified the [target_science_ship1.GetName] as being vulnerable for an attack. Applying additional resources will increase the chances of success.
STH_operation.1406.desc_03: Our operation is ready to begin, our agents have identified the [target_military_ship1.GetName] as being vulnerable for an attack. Applying additional resources will increase the chances of success.
STH_operation.1406.name: Operation Report. Prepare Operation
STH_operation.1407.desc_01: Our infiltration team have successfully loaded the explosive materials aboard [target_construction_ship1.GetName] they await our instructions to begin the plan.
STH_operation.1407.desc_02: Our teams have prepared the computer virus to upload into the core of [target_science_ship1.GetName], this will cause a warp core breach and appear as an accident as planned. Ready to begin the operation on your command.
STH_operation.1407.desc_03: Our teams have sabotaged a number of key systems onboard [target_military_ship1.GetName], this will appear as a systems failure and deal them a critical blow.
STH_operation.1407.name: Operation Report. Begin Operation
STH_operation.1408.desc: Our attempts to sabotage and destroy our target was unsuccessful and the ship continues to function with minimal damage. Our operatives are working to ensure that this cannot be traced back to us.
STH_operation.1408.name: Operation Failure
STH_operation.1409.desc: Our agents have confirmed the destruction of our target, which was destroyed with the loss of all hands. Our enemy is none the wiser that we were responsible for the vessels loss, a fine victory for our espionage agency.
STH_operation.1409.name: Operation Success
STH_operation.1410.desc: Our operatives were unable to identify a suitable target that we could destroy without compromising our own security.
STH_operation.1410.name: Unable to find a target
STH_operation.1411.desc: Our military services have reported the sad loss of the [target_ship.GetName] with the unfortunate loss of all hands. It appears that a major system failure occured and cascaded through the ship, our internal services are investigating but it appears there is very little evidence remaining.
STH_operation.1411.name: Ship Destroyed!
STH_operation.1412.desc: We have received a report from [target_ship.GetName] it appears the ship had a narrow escape, the chief engineer identifed a potential ship threatening issue, that left unchecked could have resulted in the destruction of the ship.
STH_operation.1412.name: Disaster averted
STH_operation.1500.desc: Our operative reports that they have safely set up a base of operations on [Target.Capital.GetName]. [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has the oppertunity to review a list of candiates in positions of power that could be replaced by a Founder.
STH_operation.1500.name: Dominion Security Surveillance Report
STH_operation.1501.desc: Mighty Founders, our operative within [Target.GetName] has identified a list of targets that we can send in a Founder to replace them with. Should we wish to target higher profile targets we may need to increase our efforts with a change of policy.
STH_operation.1501.name: Dominion Security. Targets Observed
STH_operation.1502.desc: Our agent within [Target.GetName] on [Target.Capital.GetName]. [Root.GetSpyTitle] [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been observing the marked target and has identified several opportunities to replace them with a Founder. Continued observation will grant us a window of opportunity.
STH_operation.1502.name: Dominion Security. Targets Observed
STH_operation.1510.desc_01: Mighty Founders, our Security services operating on [Target.Capital.GetName] report that the next stage of the operation can begin. The Founder should make their way to [Target.GetName] space whilst we neutralise the target. Our chief agent reminds us that additional assets will aid in the success of the mission.
STH_operation.1510.desc_02: Mighty Founders, our Security services operating on within the government on [Target.Capital.GetName] report that the next stage of the operation can begin now that we are close to their [Target.GetRulerTitle]. Our chief agent reminds us that additional assets will aid in the success of the mission.
STH_operation.1510.name: Dominion Security - Neutralise Target
STH_operation.1520.desc: Report in from [spynetwork.leader.GetName], all assets are in place and we are ready to infiltrate [Target.GetName]'s organisation and replace their leader.
STH_operation.1520.name: Dominion Security - Operation Ready
STH_operation.1521.desc_01: Mission Report - We have successfully replaced [targeted_leader.GetName] a high ranking [From.GetCaptainTitle] from [Target.GetName] with one of our Founders from the Great Link. We now have multiple possibilities to benefit the mighty Dominion.
STH_operation.1521.desc_02: Mission Report - We have successfully replaced [targeted_leader.GetName] a high ranking [From.GetCaptainTitle] from [Target.GetName] with one of our Founders from the Great Link. We now have multiple possibilities to benefit the mighty Dominion.
STH_operation.1521.desc_03: Mission Report - We have successfully replaced [targeted_leader.GetName] a high ranking General within the armies of [Target.GetName] with one of our Founders from the Great Link. We now have multiple possibilities to benefit the mighty Dominion.
STH_operation.1521.desc_04: Mission Report - We have successfully replaced [targeted_leader.GetName] the [From.GetRulerTitle] of [Target.GetName] with one of our wise Founders from the Great Link. We now have multiple possibilities to benefit the mighty Dominion.
STH_operation.1521.name: Dominion Security - Operation Success
STH_operation.1700.desc: Our operative [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has delivered a report from [Target.Capital.GetName]. By carefully redirecting resources and forging communications we should be able to sabotage the relationships between rival powers.
STH_operation.1700.name: Operations Surveillance Report
STH_operation.1701.desc:
Keeping [Root.Capital.GetName]'s neighbours disunited is a time-tested method of ensuring [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] superiority over local space. 

By leaking falsified diplomatic messages, staging attacks on enemy vessels using disguised assets and other disruptive actions, we are able to sour our target's relations.
STH_operation.1701.name: Operations Surveillance Report
STH_operation.1800.desc: Our operative [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has delivered a report from [Target.Capital.GetName]. The oppertunity to sabotage key parts of [Target.GetName]'s infrastructure has presented itself. Once the mission has approval our operatives will begin preparations.
STH_operation.1800.name: Operations Surveillance Report
STH_operation.1801.desc: All resources are now in place to begin the operation.
STH_operation.1801.name: Operations. Begin Mission
STH_operation.1900.desc: Our operative [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has delivered a report from [Target.Capital.GetName]. Opposition leaders are protected with great care, but [spynetwork.leader.GetName] believes their team are capable of carrying out an assassination on a top ranking official. Once the mission has approval our operatives will begin preparations.
STH_operation.1900.name: Operations Surveillance Report
STH_operation.1901.desc: A list of candidates for assassination have been included in this report from our operative on [Target.Capital.GetName]. Our teams are standing by on our orders to begin.
STH_operation.1901.name: Operations. Begin Mission
STH_operation.2011.desc_01: A batch of operatives has left for the [target.owner.GetName]. Their cover involves piloting a nondescript cargo vessel, they will infiltrate the starbase and target any devices that impact our ability to perform cloaking operations in this region.
STH_operation.2011.desc_02: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer has anti-cloaking equipment installed.
STH_operation.2011.name: Approaching Target in [target.solar_system.GetName]
STH_operation.2012.desc_01: Our operatives have successfully boarded [target.GetName] and have managed to disguise themselves as civilian maintenance workers, with close access to the critical anti-cloaking systems onboard the Starbase.
STH_operation.2012.desc_02: Our operatives have successfully infiltrated [target.GetName] and are remaining out of sight, armed with explosives and a clear goal.
STH_operation.2012.desc_03: The operation has been canceled as our operatives have confirmed that the anti-cloaking installations have now been removed.
STH_operation.2012.name: Undercover Operatives in Place
STH_operation.2013.desc_01: A message from our handlers has arrived from within the [target.owner.GetName], indicating that our operatives now stand ready to strike.
STH_operation.2013.desc_02: A coded signal has arrived from within the [target.owner.GetName], indicating that our operatives now stand ready.
STH_operation.2013.desc_03: The operation has been canceled as our operatives have confirmed that the anti-cloaking installations have now been removed.
STH_operation.2013.name: Operatives in Place
STH_operation.2014.b: Cause as much damage as possible.
STH_operation.2014.c: Strike at the Light Defense Satellite as well.
STH_operation.2014.desc: Our operatives have successfully struck a blow against the ability of [fromfrom.GetName] to detect our cloak operations in [target.solar_system.GetName]. [spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s team has been successful and has done a significant service for our Empire.
STH_operation.2014.name: [fromfrom.GetName] Starbase Cloak Detection Sabotaged
STH_operation.2015.desc: [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] team of operatives must abandon their efforts to sabotage [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Drastic changes to the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] interior have made our efforts so far redundant. We would be wise to choose a different target.
STH_operation.2015.name: Anti-Cloak Sabotage Aborted
STH_operation.2016.desc_01: Foreign intruders have violated our borders in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system, destroying the anti-cloak defenses of the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. These saboteurs appear to have been acting on behalf of a foreign power; our counter-espionage forces are on red alert to try and capture these operatives.
STH_operation.2016.desc_02:
Unknown forces have struck at the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system, wrecking the ability for [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] to detect cloaked vessels.

Our security forces suggests this is likely the work of foreign actors, rather than any home-grown threat. We have increased security around the affected region of space in the hopes of capturing these operatives.
STH_operation.2016.desc_03: A foreign entity has breached our borders in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system and has wantonly disrupted the anti-cloaking defences of [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. We cannot yet ascertain how these saboteurs gained entry so effectively, however we have increased our internal security in direct response.
STH_operation.2016.name: Anti-Cloak Equipment Sabotaged at [target.GetName]
STH_operation.2500.desc: Our infiltrators have now embedded themselves on [Target.Capital.GetName]. [spynetwork.leader.GetName] are looking to clear the way to implant one of our 'Caretaker' operatives in place of an enemy leader.
STH_operation.2500.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2501.desc: Our infiltrator within [Target.GetName] has identified a list of targets that we can replace. The higher profile the target the greater the risk and higher the reward.
STH_operation.2501.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2501.tooltip: We require a scientist who we can target who is not overly protected and has not already been replaced.
STH_operation.2502.desc: Our agent within [Target.GetName] on [Target.Capital.GetName]. [Root.GetSpyTitle] [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been observing the marked target and has identified several opportunities to replace them with a Caretaker. Continued observation will grant us a window of opportunity.
STH_operation.2502.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2510.desc_01: Our Infiltrators operating on [Target.Capital.GetName] report that the next stage of the operation can begin. The Caretaker agent should now make their way to [Target.GetName] space whilst end the life of the target. Additional assets will aid in the success of this mission.
STH_operation.2510.desc_02: Our Infiltrators operating on within the government on [Target.Capital.GetName] report that the next stage of the operation can begin now that we are close to their [Target.GetRulerTitle]. Our chief agent reminds us that additional assets will aid in the success of the mission.
STH_operation.2510.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2520.desc: The operation is now ready to strike out and replace the targetted leader, the operation will begin on your agreement.
STH_operation.2520.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2521.desc_01: Mission Report We have successfully replaced [targeted_leader.GetName] a high ranking [From.GetCaptainTitle] from [Target.GetName] with one of specially bred infiltrator warriors. We now have multiple routes to sabotage this empire.
STH_operation.2521.desc_02: Mission Report We have successfully replaced [targeted_leader.GetName] a high ranking [From.GetCaptainTitle] from [Target.GetName] with one of specially bred infiltrator warriors. We now have multiple routes to sabotage this empire.
STH_operation.2521.desc_03: Mission Report We have successfully replaced [targeted_leader.GetName] a high ranking General within the armies of [Target.GetName] with one of specially bred infiltrator warriors. We now have multiple routes to sabotage this empire.
STH_operation.2521.desc_04: Mission Report We have successfully replaced [targeted_leader.GetName] the ruler of [Target.GetName] with one of specially bred infiltrator warriors. We now have multiple routes to sabotage this empire.
STH_operation.2521.name: Undine Infiltration
STH_operation.2550.desc_01: After our agents have successfully hacked [Root.Target.GetName]'s diplomatic communications, our operatives discovered that they are in regular contact with another spacefaring empire that we ourselves have no contact with. By tracing this message to its source, we have been able to establish our own line of communications with this previously unknown actor on the galactic stage.
STH_operation.2550.desc_02: Our operatives were unable to identify any [root.target.GetAdj] contacts that we ourselves are not in communication with. Mistrz szpiegów [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has shut down our operation, and has reassigned our agents elsewhere.
STH_operation.2550.name: Hack Communications
STH_operation.2570.a.tooltip: The difficulty of this operation will be modified according to our Relative Encryption:
STH_operation.2570.desc: Mistrz szpiegów [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has begun an intense undercover operation across the [root.owner.GetName], in a mission to uncover any [root.target.GetAdj] spies that might be hiding within our ranks.
STH_operation.2570.name: Counter-Intelligence
STH_operation.2571.desc_01: Agent [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has detected encrypted communications believed to have originated from a cell of [root.target.GetAdj] operatives on [operating_planet.GetName]. Our Mistrz szpiegów has ordered a thorough investigation of this unusual activity.
STH_operation.2571.desc_02: Our counter-intelligence operatives have detected an attempted infiltration of a secure data network node on [operating_planet.GetName], believed to have originated from a cell of [root.target.GetAdj] operatives. Our Mistrz szpiegów has ordered a thorough investigation of this unusual activity in a bid to understand what has occurred and what data could be at risk.
STH_operation.2571.desc_03: Our counter-intelligence operatives have not turned up any direct evidence of [root.target.GetAdj] agents, however throughout the course of the investigation, several notable vulnerabilities in our security services have been uncovered. [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has ordered a thorough investigation.
STH_operation.2571.name: Counter-Intelligence
STH_operation.2572.desc:
After conducting a thorough sweep of the [Root.GetName] security network, Mistrz szpiegów [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having found no evidence of any widespread [from.target.GetAdj] spy network operating within our borders.

With no foreign operations detected, our operative was able to focus on boosting our internal security practices, with several notable improvements being made.
STH_operation.2572.name: Counter-Intelligence
STH_operation.2573.a.tooltip: This will decrease their infiltration level and increase the difficulty of their operations against us.
STH_operation.2573.c.tooltip: This will lower their infiltration speed and may increase the difficulty of their operations against us.
STH_operation.2573.c2.tooltip: The [root.target.GetName] does not have an asset that we can flip.
STH_operation.2573.desc:
The operation has now been completed and has identified a significant breach of our internal security with a sizeable [root.target.GetAdj] operation working within our borders. 

With the threats now detected, [spynetwork.leader.GetName] will begin a wider crackdown and removal of these threats to our security.
STH_operation.2573.name: Counter-Intelligence
STH_operation.2575.b1.tooltip: We must wait at least 6 years before attempting another operation against the [target_country.GetName].
STH_operation.2575.b2.tooltip: Our agents have discovered an operation in progress.
STH_operation.2575.b3.tooltip: Our operatives have discovered [target_country.GetAdj] sleeper agents.
STH_operation.2575.b4.tooltip: We have discovered that the [target_country.GetName] have hacked into our secure systems. We have changed our encryption accordingly.
STH_operation.2575.desc_01: Our counter-intelligence operation against the [target_country.GetName] was a huge success! Mistrz szpiegów [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] was able to arrest many of the identified agents in a series of coordinated operations across the [Root.GetName]. Their operations have been significantly disrupted as a result of our efforts.
STH_operation.2575.desc_02: Mistrz szpiegów [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] was able to arrest many of the identified agents in a series of staged operations, disrupting the [target_country.GetAdj] spy network within our borders. Unfortunately, despite the efforts of our intelligence agents, a number of [target_country.GetAdj] spies managed to evade our capture and have fled our reach.
STH_operation.2575.desc_03: Our operation against the [target_country.GetName] was a huge success! Mistrz szpiegów [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] was able to identify a key asset and was able to flip it to our purposes, compromising a key portion of the [target_country.GetAdj] spy network.
STH_operation.2575.desc_04:
Mistrz szpiegów [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] was able to identify a key asset in the [target_country.GetAdj] spy network. Unfortunately the [target_country.GetName] detected our plans and the asset vanished before we could acquire it for ourselves.

While the operation did not go as planned, the loss of this asset will still result in a major setback in their efforts against us.
STH_operation.2575.desc_05: Our operation against the [target_country.GetName] was a huge success! Our agents have begun feeding the [target_country.GetAdj] spy network false information, allowing our operatives to manipulate their network and disrupt their operations against us, setting them back years.
STH_operation.2575.desc_06: Our agents have begun feeding the [target_country.GetAdj] spy network false information, allowing our operatives to manipulate their network. Unfortunately, the [target_country.GetName] have begun to suspect that some of their informants have been compromised.
STH_operation.2575.name: [target_country.GetAdj] Operations Disrupted
STH_operation.2576.desc_01: Our operations against the [From.GetName] has become the victim of active counter-espionage activity. Our Mistrz szpiegów was able to prevent most of our spy network from becoming compromised, but we have still suffered a significant setback. Some of our agents have been arrested or turned against us, and our remaining operatives have gone to ground.
STH_operation.2576.desc_02: Our operations against the [From.GetName] has become the victim of active counter-espionage activity. Our Mistrz szpiegów attempted to prevent our spy network from becoming compromised but was unsuccessful. Our local operations have been exposed, and our remaining agents have been forced to flee back to the [Root.GetName].
STH_operation.2576.name: Operations Disrupted
STH_operation.3000.desc_01: Our operatives are reviewing the defenses of [root.target.GetAdj] military installations looking for any weaknesses and looking to imbed themselves within the local operations.
STH_operation.3000.desc_02: Our deep-cover operatives have stepped-up their surveillance on [root.target.GetAdj] military installations, probing their security for potential weaknesses.
STH_operation.3000.name: Defence Review
STH_operation.3001.desc_01: Our undercover operatives have successfully managed to obtain the planetary defense codes from an unsecured terminal, giving us access to their planetary defense network, until they notice the missing code and reset their security grid.
STH_operation.3001.desc_02: Our operatives met with a disgruntled member of local security who was willing to supply us with schematics detailing their local planetary defense plans. This will give us access until they notice the missing individual and reset their codes.
STH_operation.3001.desc_03: Our operatives in the [root.target.GetName] have acquired a unique pheromone emitter used by [root.target.GetAdj] warrior drones to identify one another. Our agents should be able to use it to gain access to a local military installation, giving us a close look at the [root.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]' planetary defenses.
STH_operation.3001.desc_04: Our operatives in the [root.target.GetName] have acquired a warrior drone from a local military installation. The machine unit's security clearances are still active - the [root.target.GetName] having not yet realized that the drone is missing - giving our agents an opportunity to get a closer look at their planetary defenses.
STH_operation.3001.desc_05: Our operatives in the [root.target.GetName] have tapped into the secure communications of local military installation. By studying their messages, our agents have pieced together a preliminary study of their planetary defenses, and have acquired several access codes that will allow us to get a closer look.
STH_operation.3001.desc_06: Our operative in the [root.target.GetName] has identified a secure military server on [root.target.capital.GetName], believed to contain detailed schematics of [root.target.GetAdj] defenses. If our agents can gain access to the server, we will have everything we need to hack their servers and obtain details on their defensive military infrastructure.
STH_operation.3001.desc_07: Infiltration algorithms engaged, an isolated target has been assimilated.. access codes obtained from the new drone's neural net. Codes downloaded access to local defense infrastructure has been granted.
STH_operation.3001.name: Defense Infiltration
STH_operation.3002.desc_01: [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has reported back on their information-gathering operation into [root.target.GetName] planetary defenses, and have sent a dossier detailing their findings.
STH_operation.3002.desc_02: Unfortunately the reports back from [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] suggests that [root.target.GetName] have detected our activity and have made efforts to improve their security.
STH_operation.3002.name: Intel Secured
STH_operation.3002.tooltip: The [root.target.GetName] will be weaker to invasion and orbital bombardment for the next 6 years.
STH_operation.3020.desc_01: Our security services have identified a number of criminal branches that have been set up on our worlds, this information has been passed onto our security services to take action.
STH_operation.3020.desc_02: Our security services have discovered several promising leads regarding sources of [root.target.GetAdj] criminal activity. They have passed on this information to our local enforcers, who are drawing up plans to remove this blight from our planets.
STH_operation.3020.name: Remove Criminal Organsation
STH_operation.3021.desc_01: Our security services have completed a report on which [root.target.GetAdj] corporate offices that we can quickly and with minimal fuss. We have done all we can to identify and counter any objections and legal loopholes the [root.target.GetName] might use to stop us.
STH_operation.3021.desc_02: Our enforcers have discovered a major [root.target.GetAdj] criminal headquarters, and are preparing to raid the compound. We have done all we can to ensure the criminals will be taken by surprise.
STH_operation.3021.name: Operation Ready
STH_operation.3023.a.tooltip: A branch office on [corp_planet_target.GetName] will be removed.
STH_operation.3023.desc_01: We have successfully expelled a [from.from.target.GetAdj] branch office on [corp_planet_target.GetName]! The [from.from.target.GetName] of course objected, but we were prepared for their legal arguments and were able to conclude our operation with minimal resistance. It may take years for the matter to be fully resolved in the courts, but in the mean time, we have the results we wanted.
STH_operation.3023.desc_02: We have conducted a successful raid on a [from.from.target.GetAdj] criminal headquarters on [corp_planet_target.GetName]! Several high ranking crime bosses have been arrested, and the rest of their network has fled the [corp_planet_target.GetPlanetMoon].
STH_operation.3023.desc_03: The [from.from.target.GetAdj] branch office on [corp_planet_target.GetName] has proven far more entrenched than expected. Although the [from.from.target.GetName] have no legitimate authority to operate within our territories, they have constructed a compelling legal fiction that will take some time for the courts to unravel. We will need to seek alternative methods to root them out.
STH_operation.3023.desc_04: The [from.from.target.GetAdj] criminals on [corp_planet_target.GetName] have proven far more entrenched than expected. The [from.from.target.GetName] were prepared for our raid, and most of the high ranking crime bosses were able to escape. We will need a new plan of action if we are to root them out.
STH_operation.3023.name: Remove Criminal Organsation
STH_operation.3024.desc_01: The [from.GetName] has shut down our corporate offices on [corp_planet_target.GetName]. Without a binding commercial treaty, our activities have few legal protections in the [from.GetAdj] territories, leaving us with little recourse to prevent the expulsion of our employees.
STH_operation.3024.desc_02: The [from.GetName] have conducted a surprise raid on our branch office on [corp_planet_target.GetName], arresting many of our local mob bosses and scattering the rest of the network. Our influence on the [corp_planet_target.GetPlanetMoon] has been broken.
STH_operation.3024.name: Branch Office Removed!
STH_operation.3025.desc: Due to the changing situation in the [fromfrom.target.GetName], our agents are unable to complete their objective. Mistrz szpiegów [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has shut down our operation, and has reassigned our agents elsewhere.
STH_operation.3025.name: Operation Canceled
STH_operations_fail.100.desc: We have concerning news from our field operatives involved in the mission to replace a hostile leader. We have lost contact with the team and the Founder they were protecting. It is possible that counter-intelligence forces are behind the loss of contact.
STH_operations_fail.100.name: Contact lost with infiltration team
STH_operations_fail.100.toolip: Attempt to recover the asset at the cost of energy. The bigger the difference in encryption levels between the powers the better the chance of success.
STH_operations_fail.110.desc: Our special forces teams have managed to recover the Founder and our espionage team from underneath the eyes of our enermy forces. Allowing to resume our operations in this sector.
STH_operations_fail.110.name: Contact Reestablished
STH_operations_fail.111.desc: Despite our efforts we have failed to reestablish contact with our teams and should consider them lost.
STH_operations_fail.111.name: Failed to recover our team
STH_operations_fail.112.desc: Our security teams have uncovered a potential changeling infiltration plot against one of our high ranking officials. We were unable to detain the team, but we were able to stop their plot against us.
STH_operations_fail.112.name: Changeling infiltrator uncovered
STH_operations_fail.120.desc: Our Internal Security forces have detected some suspicious activity on one of our planets. Our Mistrz szpiegów believes that the [from.target.GetAdj] agents have become aware of our counter-intelligence investigation and are attempting to secure their security network.
STH_operations_fail.120.name: Suspicious Activity Detected
STH_operations_fail.121.desc: Our operatives have discovered a significant security leak during a routine inspection of one of our encrypted networks. Our agents have drawn up plans to close this particular security gap; however, our Mistrz szpiegów has also suggested using the leak to draw in unsuspecting foreign agents.
STH_operations_fail.121.name: Security Leak Identified
STH_operations_fail.122.desc:
After conducting a thorough sweep of the [Root.GetName], Mistrz szpiegów [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having found no evidence of a widespread [from.target.GetAdj] spy network operating within our borders.

With no foreign operations to thwart, our $role_spymaster$ turned [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHerHis] attention inward, meticulously assessing the state of our internal security. Several suggested improvements have been included in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHerHis] report.
STH_operations_fail.122.name: Internal Security Operations Completed
STH_orbital_signal_source_1_category_des: Sensors have detected an object of indeterminate size in orbit of [From.GetName].
STH_pahvo_music_category_desc: A mysterious signal sounding almost like an alien melody has been detected from a planet in the Pahvo system.
STH_pirate.2.desc:
We have received an SOS call from [gorn_target_ship.GetName], the last transmission we received was the following. 

We are under attac... from an unidentified shi..p. They did not respond to our hails.. hissing... snarling... please send help immediately.
STH_pirate.2.name: SOS call received
STH_pirate.21.a.response: We commission a group of privateers to attack another empires planet, should they make it to the planet's surface they will obtain resources from that world.
STH_pirate.21.b.response: There is always the risk that our target will discover that we targetted them and strike back at us.
STH_pirate.21.desc_01: Our Marauders grow eager to obtain profit and salvage via a raid on an unsuspecting foe, remember if we need justification, Rule 202: The justification for profit is profit! We have drawn up a list of potential targets for review.
STH_pirate.21.desc_02: The Orion Syndicate grows restless to extend its reach across the criminal underworld with a raid against an unsuspecting world, seeking plunder and potential slaves to sell onwards.
STH_pirate.21.desc_03: Our young grow restless for fresh meatsss and a chance to spread the limbsss with a raid against a target that is ripe for an attack. Who should we targetsss?
STH_pirate.21.desc_04: It is time for a new hunt as our hunters grow bored of our current targets, we have provided a list of worthy prey. Select a worthwhile target and let a hunt begin.
STH_pirate.21.desc_05: Our raiders are eager to stretch their claws and dig them into a new target, there is plunder and prizes to be won. We should select a target and let the raiding begin.
STH_pirate.21.desc_06: Our fighters grow tired of fighting amongst themselves and when Nausicaan's grow bored, our foes should grow scared. Let us raid and pillage and be grateful that we sought permission.
STH_pirate.21.desc_07: The Majes tire of fighting amongst themselves and demand the chance to seek a target to raid and increase their own wealth and prestige. Select a suitable target and let the raid begin.
STH_pirate.21.desc_08: Our mercenary's hunger for a taste of plunder. Commission a raid against a neighboring world to seize its wealth for our own.
STH_pirate.21.desc_09: It is time to let our raiders lose and attack an unsuspecting target, bringing us loot and plunder. Select a target to begin the raid.
STH_pirate.21.name: Our raiders grow restless
STH_pirate.22.a.response: We come to raid your planet, you can surrender it peacefully or we can take it by force.
STH_pirate.22.a: What do you want from us?
STH_pirate.22.d: You win, take what you want.
STH_pirate.22.desc_01: We come to seize your profits, so hand over your Latinum and we may just leave your world able to continue trading!
STH_pirate.22.desc_02: Greetings [Root.GetName] you face the mighty Orion Syndicate, we offer you two choices, hand over the wealth of this system or we shall take them by force.
STH_pirate.22.desc_03: Thisss is the Gorn, we offer you a simple choice handover your wealthhh or we shall take it for ourselvesss. Our hatchlingsss are eager for you to reject our offer.
STH_pirate.22.desc_04: You have the honour of being marked out as worthy prey for one of our hunting parties, you have the chance to handover the wealth of this system or let the hunt begin.
STH_pirate.22.desc_05: You are the unlucky target of [raiding_leader.GetName] and we come for what is ours by conquest! So handover your treasures or be prepared for us to take them by force.
STH_pirate.22.desc_06: This is [raiding_leader.GetName], we come here to take your treasures, you can give them to us, or we take them from you!
