The Cravic turned like rabid warbots on their creators. Where we faced the task with equanimity, they relished in the mayhem. For cycles, our navies clashed again and again. With the organics or not, victory is not in sight... and now our command units are whispering about unreplicated energy matrix.

When we killed our Builders we have killed ourselves. All we have left now is the war.

'The automated units were not created naturally. We were built.' - Automated Unit 3947
START_SCREEN_RIGEL:
Even millennia ago when our species first came out its shell onto land to form the first communities, our many sexes have often traded and bargained amongst themselves to find optimum solutions for all parties. Our early warfare mistakes resulted in the creation of the first regulations that became our laws, to ensure a fair and balanced trading standard for all.

With the advent of our warp drive, we can now spread to the stars and seek out new species to join our ever growing trading network.
START_SCREEN_RKR:
Rising like a Nehelik Phoenix after each interregnum, the Rakhari Imperium is everlasting. While some may complain about our methods, none can question their efficacy.

Our nation is strong, our people, loyal, free of alien influence and insidious shape-shifters. The imperium will prevail. None shall stand in our way. Soon, we shall take to the stars, to the Chamra Vortex, and beyond. We shall spread across the galaxy, and claim it as our own. May the Imperium last for three thousand years!
START_SCREEN_ROM:
It has been more than 1,500 years since our ancestors left Vulcan, our original homeworld, to escape the poisonous ideology of Surak and his followers.

After a long journey, we found a perfect system to settle. We were no longer Vulcans, we were Romulans, prouder than ever before. We have founded our Star Empire to protect our values. And we eventually did prove Surak wrong.

Our Empire has grown far more powerful and far more secure than Surak's Vulcan could ever hope to be.

But we must not underestimate our enemies. We must remain vigilant. Our Senate and our Praetor must always choose the best course of action to protect all Romulans. Romulan mantra: 

Misdirection is the key to survival. Never attack what your enemy defends. Never behave as your enemy expects and never reveal your true strength. If knowledge is power, then to be unknown is to be unconquerable. 

'Romulans.So predictably treacherous!' - Weyoun
START_SCREEN_SAU:
Our evolution on Sauria has depended on one thing - an almost religious devotion to strength and durability. Our first buildings taught us vital construction techniques, and our first farms taught us the importance of selecting the right strains. 

As our species grew and our cities flourished, trade began. The harsh nature of the planet forced us to work together, forming stronger bonds based on equality and fairness. 

Since the early days of astronomy, we have spotted many more inhospitable worlds than our own, as well as perfect worlds with no geological activity or solar storms. With the invention of warp drive, we can now reach these worlds and establish new communities that will benefit the entire League.
START_SCREEN_SEL:
Our clutches are attacked constantly by the ravenous Anticans! They hunt us and devour our bodies! But we have learned to strike back and grow stronger. We must expand quickly, before those fanged beasts do. They will not win, or we shall all be devoured.

The problem is, is that one of the cooks has just been asked to broil reptile for the Anticans - and it looks like the Selay delegate. - Lt. Tasha Yar
START_SCREEN_SHE:
Section 1, paragraph 77. There will now commence the required greetings and words of introduction. Subject to Paragraph 52, clause B, of this section, these words will be short, and to the point. The Corporate does not condone idleness. We do not sink into legalese. Do not mistake the length of this volume, and its 1203 sections, 42,314 paragraphs and precisely 12,445 footnotes. It is not done out of a love of bureaucracy, but the need for precision. Precision guide every member of our great society. It guides every crystal in our body, our structure of our great cities, and every particulate of sand in our gardens.

Thank you for reading paragraph 77. You may now contemplate the mandala in your nearest garden for 52 seconds, before turning to paragraph 78, where we will discuss organics extermination - advantages and disadvantages.
START_SCREEN_SKR:
Our society has never been as peaceful and as prosperous as it is now. With the control of the government firmly in the hands of the Circle of Matrons, the matriarchy steers and controls our people with a stable hand. No longer are we slaves to the emotional and warring males, they are but second class citizens under the new laws, only fit to work in the fields.

With the advent of our warp drive we shall seek out our destined homeworld that was lost millenia ago. Kentanna, located just beyond the Eye of the Universe, will be ours once again.

We have left the complacent Ba'ku behind seeking new life for new adventure and glory for ourselves! Let us raid - we shall take the resources and slaves we need and women we want. One day we will return home and retake the planet of the Ba'ku, and with it's rings we shall conquer this quadrant and later perhaps the entire galaxy!
START_SCREEN_SUL:
They cling to their precious planets and call us terrorists. Us, who have nothing, who have done nothing, who had everything taken from us.

Do you think of these enhancements as a gift? Do you think they belong to you? Then you are a fool. What the benefactor grants is no gift, no boon, and can easily be taken away. It does not belong to you.

Instead, know these enhancements are a sacrifice, sacrifice we have made, for our people and the future.

We have nothing, not even our bodies, not even our DNA. We have given it in service. But in time, through our loss, we can regain all we have. This, the Cabal promises you.

'We don't share your patience with natural selection.' - Silik, of the Suliban
START_SCREEN_TAL:
'Omara s'alas!' Oh dear me let me turn the translator on. 'Good news has no clothes!'. Our jovial nature led us to the stars hundreds of years ago, and whilst there might have been a few minor setbacks along the way due to a few of our people who were a bit vaadwaur, we are once again ready to greet the galaxy!

Our spiritual nature keeps us in touch with our ancestors who have gone before, and our good mannered nature seems to provoke good relations in those we meet, leading to very favorable trade deals indeed.

'When the road before you splits in two, take the third path.' - Talaxian proverb
START_SCREEN_TAM:
We are the Children of Tama. Since time immemorial, our myths and legends made us who were are, not only in our actions but also in our language, which consists almost entirely of methaphors from our mythology.

We are also people of tradition. Various rituals guide our daily life. Even though we have developed far more effective weapons, all officers of our military still carry knives to remember our humble beginnings and the sacrifices of our ancestors. We honour our monarchs and respect them.

Now that we have developed faster than light travel, let us also be explorers. While communicating with other sentient life, if there is any, may be difficult, we should not be discouraged.

Darmok and Jalad at Tanagra!
START_SCREEN_TCOE:
All of Earth watched and waited for the success of the Europa mission of 2024, but when it failed to deliver, one man stood up and brought humankind out of the mire of the 21st Century. That man was Doctor Adam Soong and his visionary view masterminded a new future, one where the strongest not only survive but thrive. Earth took to the stars knowing that the only way to keep Earth safe was to ensure that humanity was leading the way and that all other life understood its place behind their human masters.

A safe galaxy is a Human galaxy! - Adam Soong
START_SCREEN_TEL:
The Vulcans think they have a monopoly on logic, but anyone who stood on the grand steps to the central debate forum in Tellar City knows the truth of the matter. Logic is unbiased and objective but it is not soulless. Think of how logic came to us - born to settle disputes and legal battles. Battles, reader, battles. Logic is a weapon, to be used to fight when mere particle weapons are insufficient. It is not meant to be kind. It is not meant to be quiet. Those that are in the right shout it until the very forum shakes, until every speaker's corner reverts with the rightful fury of the truth.

There are those that will find your truth offensive. They will slip away, muttering about the abruptness and rudeness of the Tellarites. Some may even seek other trading partners. Let them. We bring the truth, and to a Tellarite of truth, their word is bond.

'Tellarites do not argue for a reason, they simply argue.' - Sarek
START_SCREEN_TEM2:
The Empire has fallen and the changes that Emperor Spock made only served to provoke challenges from our enemies, resulting in our defeat at the hands of the Alliance. 

However, Terrans can never be truly defeated and the spark of rebellion has traveled across the quadrant to reignite the flame that was the Terran Empire... 

'From the shards of the shattered mirror, the Empire will rise.' 

'Long live the Empire!' - the war cry of every loyal terran.
START_SCREEN_TEM:
Greetings, Legatus Augusti. 

Since time immemorial, Terra has been ours. Not only its soil, but also its blood and flesh. And now, even the stars that shine down on our hallowed Earth are ours. Luna is ours. Mars is ours too. The vermin that scurry in the dark and used to plot the conquest of our home are ours too. Their bodies, their planets, their technology and their very souls are ours to do with as we please. For daring to land their vanguard on Earth, we took their ship and their empire. They shall now suffer for ten thousand years more. 

For too long, we have striven to quench one rebellion after another while bickering amongst ourselves and diminishing the glory of the Empire. It was heresy, nothing short of heresy. But now there is a non-human slave at every manor and food on every table. Now is the time to be alive, to be truly human. Everyone will see what we can do and feel the might of the Terran Empire.
START_SCREEN_THO:
The Lattice quivers. Across Tholia, thousands of forums cry out, the voice of our people reverberating across the great crystal city for miles. Great matrons, that have not left their hives for years, slowly climb out and make their way to the meeting place, helped by their progeny. Our great fleet returns from the outskirts of our domain, their own forums spilling into vast concourses. No one wishes to miss Choice Day. Today, each forum will come together and choose their magistrates, leaders and captain.

From those, the Lattice will select our next leaders. But we already know their task, for the Lattice has already shown us the way. For too long we have kept closed our borders and kept away from the rest of the galaxy. While we rested, threats grew. Lesser empires, of lesser beings, yes, yet still a danger.

This must be done carefully. Delicately. It will not be an easy task, or a short one, and in time we may even need to deal with those empires, to give the pretense of friendship. We might even need to lie. But hold firm, for the Lattice must hold.

'Be correct; we do not tolerate deceit.' - Loskene, of the Tholians
START_SCREEN_TKCA:
Born out of a desire to end the Terran dominance of the Alpha and Beta Quadrants, Regents Gorkon and Legate Ranar formed a historic alliance at Khitomer, the site of the previously rejected Terran/Klingon union. The combined forces of the Alliance tore across the Terran Republic and conquered Terra herself. 

Now with war brewing on the Talarian front and rumblings of the rebirth of the Terran Empire, keeping the peace will require the full force of our weapons. 

A Believe me, my Regent, it will take the blood of many rebels to quench the thirst of my revenge. - Garak
START_SCREEN_TLR: Honour and discipline - our traditional way of life has shaped the Talarian people. Values taught by fathers to their sons. Our people excel in martial prowess, and our martial prowess proves our strength. Now is the time to fulfil our destiny and reach to the stars! We will bring glory to the Talarian people, and order and security to the galaxy.
START_SCREEN_TRA:
Since time immemorial we have used our great cultural prowess to sow divisions in the lines of our enemies, to leave them bickering and squabbling amongst themselves.

Our most prestigious triumph has been the discovery of the strong and ill tempered Kazon, a once united race now reduced to infighting amongst themselves over the scraps we provide. Our civilisation is built on our ability to stay united and to utilise these lesser beings as fuel for our economy.

As we discover faster warp drives, we will extend our reach into the stars once more, to seek out new life and new civilisations, to swiftly divide and conquer for the good of the Trabe Alliance.
START_SCREEN_TRI:
They say old age brings wisdom, but in truth, age simply calcifies the mind, make it resistant to innovative ideas. Wisdom comes from experience, and those can only be obtained by those that dare to experience and challenge their own perspective. So, while there may be species out there in the galaxy that have a longer lifespan than us, none can match the unique bond we share with the symbionts. Only by tampering the eagerness of youth with the maturity of old age can true wisdom be obtained.

That is why our symbionts are our most precious resource, and why we dedicate our entire society to their care. To be joined is the highest honor there is, not because it grants a kind of immortality, because it means being entrusted with the most precious and rare of gifts, one even more rare than life-everlasting - wisdom.

'How old are you?'
'I stopped counting at 300.' - Jadzia Dax and Virak'kara
START_SCREEN_TRO:
Treat them mean to keep them keen, that's what our ancestors always taught us. A happy Skrreean is a lazy slave, but a downtrodden Skrreean is just as bad. There is a fine line to enslaving a people and forcing them to work for the greater T'Rogoran Empire.

Our population grows larger with each passing day, and our economy is beginning to falter, though we may have a way to ensure our continued dominance - the discovery of the warp drive. We can find strange new worlds, seek out new life and civilisations. And conquer them of course, to make them work for us, as all lesser species should.
START_SCREEN_TUFP2:
The signing of the Khitomer Accords has created a newfound atmosphere of excitement across the Federation with many in Starfleet ready and eager to head out into the unknown. Starfleet is ready to once again turn its gaze outwards and take to the starts to explore this 'Lost Era' of history. 

'A dream that became a reality and spread throughout the stars.' - James T. Kirk
START_SCREEN_TZE:
Our history has been a violent one, since we rose up against the mammals on the surface to becoming the dominant power in our system. With the invention of the warp drive we can now expand our dominion to the stars.

There is no doubt that there are weaker species out there, who will seek to undermine us. We must maintain our sovereignty to make it clear that we will not be moved!

'Open fire on the planet.
Cleanse the surface.' - Admiral Tzen-Harran
START_SCREEN_UFP2:
The signing of the Khitomer Accords has created a newfound atmosphere of excitement across the Federation with many in Starfleet ready and eager to head out into the unknown. Starfleet is ready to once again turn its gaze outwards and take to the starts to explore this 'Lost Era' of history. 

'A dream that became a reality and spread throughout the stars.' - James T. Kirk
START_SCREEN_UFP:
The spectre of war had followed Humanity for centuries, culminating in the Third World War in 2053. Emerging from this post-atomic horror, the people of Earth struggled to survive until the scientist Zefram Cochrane successfully drew the attention of the Vulcan science vessel T'Plana-Hath a decade later.

Following almost a century of Vulcan patronage, the people of Earth are ready to take their first steps into the Great Unknown.

To seek out new life and new civilisations. To boldly go where no one has gone before.

'The potential to make yourself a better man... that is what it is to be Human... to make yourself more than you are.' - Jean-Luc Picard
START_SCREEN_UND: For eons, we the Undine evolved and became the apex of biological evolution. Our organic ships are unmatched. We will not suffer intrusions of unclean species to our fluidic space. We will cleanse the galaxy of all inferior life so we will have our peace. The weak will perish!
START_SCREEN_VAA:
Our Empire once spanned the quadrant for hundreds of years. We ruled the network of the Underspace with a vast armada of ships until the lesser races united and treacherously vanquished us. But we remain, waiting.

From stasis chambers hidden deep underground we awaken. Our technology is old, and lacking, but our scientists are ready to find new ways to expand ourselves back into space. We shall have our revenge on those lesser species. We shall reconquer the Underspace and reclaim this quadrant in the name of the Vaadwaur!
START_SCREEN_VAL: Centuries ago the Kriosian Empire was a rich two-planet empire that was known across the quadrant. Two brothers, Valt and Krios, both ran the Empire in harmony until they met an empathic metamorph named Garuth. Both brothers fell in love with her, until Krios kidnapped her and took her to Krios Prime. This sparked a civil war lasting centuries, splitting the Empire in two and reducing a once great Empire down to a barely warp-capable people.
START_SCREEN_VAU:
There was a time when we were considered to be alone in the galaxy, a time when our way of life was all that mattered, but that has all changed and now we must decide whether we go forth as part of this galaxy or whether we take it for ourselves.

 'There is no barrier we cannot overcome. For we are Vau N'Akat.'  The Progeny, 2383
START_SCREEN_VID:
We have sacrificed everything to the Phage. Our unborn children, lost to us when the Phage took our DNA. Our memories, when the Phage claws at our neural pathways. Our morality, when we hack into the foreigner so we can keep living for a little while longer. Our identity, when the Phage eats us from the inside out, until we are too hideous to be seen even by our fellows. Our future, snatched away far too soon. Our dreams, to have a natural life, a happy life, our choices to have any vocation but a Phage-fighter - whatever in our ships, plying for more organs, or in the labs, trying to seek the impossible.

All that, and more, we sacrifice to the Phage, and we would gladly sacrifice our lives as well, so that we can keep just one thing to ourselves. Hope. Hope that, one day, this cycle will end.
START_SCREEN_VLR:
Our history has always taught us that wars will come and go, but trade is eternal. There will always be someone requiring something, whether it's food for a starving city or weapons to attack their neighbour.

Of course, there is power in controlling the supply of goods. Tariffs, blockades and embargoes are our weapon of choice.
START_SCREEN_VOT:
Our Doctrine contains everything about us, our history, our ancient and rightful claim over this region of space and it has remained unchanged for thousands of years. For millions of years our people have believed that we were the first intelligent beings to evolve in this region of space. The first species. 

The Doctrine dictates that because the Voth were the first to evolve in this part of the galaxy, we have the right to rule it. Thus, any notions that the Voth evolved elsewhere is considered Heresy. As the rightful rulers of this section of the galaxy, we look down on lesser species such as furry mammalians. Only the Voth can truly understand the galaxy, and it is time to exert our rightful legacy.

'By challenging Doctrine, you're suggesting that everything we believe about ourselves, our history, our ancient and rightful claim over this region of space, the authority of this Ministry itself, is a lie.' - The Ministry
START_SCREEN_VUL:
Many may resent our ways, perhaps finding them to be too stoic and overly logical, but our history teaches us differently.

Before the Time of Awakening, we were a violent, hateful race, which almost drove itself to extinction. The adoption of Surak's philosophy of logic over 1,700 years ago finally put an end to our undisciplined past.

Now, when we are beginning to explore the galaxy, may we stay true to Surak's example and maintain our way of life even when confronted with others who may not share our dedication to logic and purposefulness.
START_SCREEN_WAD:
A hundred Hats are on the second board, threatened by a hundred more Timthes you suspect the player has in its deck. You, however, have four d20s and the initiative, and the bet is to you.

That you have never heard of this game is irrelevant. That you do not know the rules is irrelevant. A Surchid is born with the ability to learn quickly and adapt. For hundreds of years Surchids have led our people to prosperity. No one will care when the time comes that you do not know who our opponents will be, their ways different to ours. There are no books nor records to learn this ability from. But keep your mind open to new possibilities, ready for anything, and you will never lose a game.

Academy of Wadiseni, Closing Speech to class
START_SCREEN_XEP:
Our world is often a harsh one, with many lessons learned in our history about doing what must be done. With the advent of the warp drive, we shall extend this philosophy to the stars.

Is it truly criminal to steal food when you are starving? Is it truly criminal to murder one who has wronged you? These are important lessons that our history has taught us. We shall expand to the stars, and do what must be done to survive.
START_SCREEN_XINMAM:
Xindus is gone, as fragmented and torn apart as our people. Thousands of years of peace and harmony shattered by a war that changed everything.

We do not remember who started the war, nor even remember Xindus or the beauty of a flight of Avians across the sky, but we do remember the peace. This initiation medal you hold in your limb, my progeny, harks to that time: a medal made on Xindus; a medal held by countless Xindi, on Xindus itself.

Even now, even with the various factions plotting for supremacy over our fragile, torn Council, we remember the peace. We strive for it, for the promise our people once held. With the guiding of the Guardians, we will navigate these dark currents and find it once again.

'Have you ever even met a Xindi before today?'
'One, and he didn't look very much like you.'
'Not all of them do.' - Kessick and Captain Jonathan Archer
START_SCREEN_YAD:
It is in the nature of philosophy to sink into solipsism. It requires a sharp mind and a strong will to claw back from the depths of nothingness to grasp at something real. There is that brief, shining light when we touch upon truths and transcendental idealism, but even that is temporary. Fleeting. The reality of existence is that nothing is truly real. Solipsism is inescapable.

That is the wisdom in the heart of every great holo-weaver - merging together holograms, shadows and reflections. At the intersection of art and math, every great creator understands that even the universe itself is a hologram. It takes a weaver, however, to manifest it for all to see.

'Why should it matter to you if a hologram cries?
Because I love her.' - Odo and Rurigan
START_SCREEN_YRI: Information is our way. Let others boast about their military strength, but we know that Knowledge is the real power. We have built our society by managing information and trading secrets, and with this power we can make or break Empires. Our merchants will operate across the stars, reporting back on their movements. If we so desire it then fleets will burn, and governments will fall. Our people will emerge from the shadows where we shall rule.
START_SCREEN_ZAH:
History has taught us that politicians cannot be trusted, and that religion is just a divisive sham. The only way forward is with technology, and letting the brightest and smartest minds come together to lead us.

With this in the forefront of our minds our civilisation has flourished, bringing space travel and other huge benefits. We have united under one government, and we can now take to the stars to seek out new experiences and events.
START_SCREEN_ZAK:
'A hundred Skel are on the second board, threatened by a fleet of Azadian cloudships you suspect the third player has in its deck. You, however, have three blue dice and a red one, and the bet is to you.

That you have never heard of this game is irrelevant. That you do not know the rules is irrelevant. A Strategos is not manufactured - he, or she, is born from inside - from the character of the individual. For seven hundred years you, and all other initiatives like you, have been tasked with protecting our Comity. No one will care when the time comes that you do not know who our enemies will be, their weapons and capabilities, their technology and techniques. You will receive no quarter. But keep your mind sharp, and you will never lose a game.'

Speech by the Grand Strategos to the graduates of the fourth year of the Great College, age 10.

VUL_FRIENDLY_DOW_ACCEPT_01: The [Root.GetName] conveyed nothing but a desire for peace and long life to the [From.GetSpeciesName] people. Conflict between us is not logical.
VUL_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Peace and long life, [From.GetRulerTitle]. It is agreeable to hear from you.
VUL_HOSTILE_DOW_ACCEPT_01: Perhaps it was unwise of the [Root.GetName] to expect a logical response from a [From.GetSpeciesName].

VUL_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Logic dictates that we hear what you have to say, [From.GetRulerTitle]. But be brief.

action.1.ad: Tacy jak wy nie zagroza naszej jednosci.
action.1.and: Ah, the ignoble [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Well, you are not as ugly as we were warned, but it remains to be seen if you can be trusted.
action.1.andfed: Greetings from Earth. I represent [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the [contact_empire.GetName]. It is our honour to meet fellow space travellers.
action.1.andtel: Hmmm. I'm told the Imperial Guard is the pride and joy of Andoria. I find it small and unimpressive.
action.1.andvul: Prior to the Paan Mokar incident, the Science Academy has always summarised that a sub-temperate eco-system would lead to the evolution of careful, deliberate beings. The continued illogical behavior of the Andorian Guard belays that hypothesis. It would be prudent of you to recognise your technological inferiority.
action.1.antsel: Greetingsss from the Selay Clutchessss. We hope you refrain from any of the hunting activitiesss we hav- pleaaasse get the ambasssador out of your mouth
action.1.baj: Soraya neryshu [Root.GetName]. On behalf of the First Minister of the [contact_empire.GetName] we welcome you to this part of the galaxy. May you walk with the prophets.
action.1.ban: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are very pleased to meet your people, and look forward to a long and profitable future with you. Come [From.GetSpeciesName], let us enjoy some marob root tea together.
action.1.barzan: Greetings from the frozen world of Barzan II, we look forward to further transactions with [from.GetSpeciesName].
action.1.baul: <BEGIN TRANSLATION> You are entering Ba'ul territory, we do not desire further contact from you, unless we have a need of you. Leave our domain now. <END TRANSLATION>
action.1.ben: What do you mean, we all look the same? How rude. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], and we are pleased to make your acquaintance. I see by the design of [Root.GetSpeciesName] vessels that you aren't as meticulous in your designs as we are.
action.1.bet: Greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], spokesperson for the Houses of Betazed, keepers of the Holy Rings of Betazed and the Sacred Chalice of Rixx. We sense you are fellow startravellers, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Welcome.
action.1.bol: The name of your contact vessel bears a close resemblance to an impolite term in our language, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Nevertheless, we are the [contact_empire.GetName], and we are pleased to make your acquaintance.
action.1.bre: We are the Breen. Do not approach our worlds. Stay away from our borders or we shall ensure your vessels never see the cold light of day again.
action.1.bru: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are very pleased to meet your people, and look forward to a long and profitable future with you. Come [From.GetSpeciesName], let us show you what Brunali hospitality is all about.
action.1.cait: Greetings [Root.GetSpeciesName], we are the [contact_empire.GetName]. You will find that we are receptive to further communication and welcome your contact.
action.1.car: Greetings from the Cardassian Union. We look forward to diplomatic contact with your people. In the meantime, however, we insist that you avoid our space and respect our territorial sovereignty.
action.1.crapra: Hostile Automated Personnel Unit fleet detected. Engaging tactical overlay. Elite Admin Substrate has been alerted to your continued existence. Please allow a short interval so the situation may be remedied.
action.1.den:
Friendly greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName] to the [Root.GetName]. It is always a privilege to meet fellow citizens of the galaxy. Our doctors are second to none, so if you'd like us to fix that facial deformity, we'd be happy too.

Oh it seems that's actually your face.
action.1.desc_tam: Kira at Bashi, the beast at Tanagra. Kitea, his eyes closed beside Sokath, his eyes opened. Peleb by the forest.
action.1.dev: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. In order to traverse our space you must comply with our imperatives, and telepathic beings are not permitted. If you comply with these, we shall have no trouble. So [From.GetSpeciesName], let's talk.
action.1.dom: The Founders send their greetings, and welcome the discovery of the [from.GetSpeciesName] people. We look forward to future encounters, however we ask you to respect the integrity of the Dominion until then.
action.1.fed: Greetings, we hope for an informative exchange of cultural and scientific knowledge. We look forward to diplomatic contact with the [Root.GetName].
action.1.fedand: Ah, the Vulcans' pet pink skins. Well. You are not as ugly as we were warned, but it remains to be seen if you can be trusted.
action.1.fedtel: Hmmm. I'm told this fleet is the pride and joy of Earth. I find it small and unimpressive.
action.1.fedvul: We are pleased to see you are well, our child, but continue to advise caution. Your fleet does not meet with the Vulcan Expeditionary Groups standards for safety, and your warp coils are unaligned properly. We have, as always, your best interests at heart.
action.1.fen: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName], may Domar's light guide you safely through the darkness. Come [From.GetSpeciesName], let us talk about you joining Domar's light.
action.1.fer: Greetings from the Ferengi, under the prosperous rule of the Grand Nagus. We are very pleased to meet your people, and look forward to a long and profitable future of trade and commerce with you. Come [From.GetSpeciesName], let's make a deal.
action.1.gor: I bring greetingsss from the Gorn Hegemony, ruled by the undisssputed leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Resspect our bordersss and sstay out of our affairsss, and our mighty fleetsss will refrain from visssiting your worldssssss.
action.1.hir: I could snap your puny neck with one twist. Hmph, a trophy hardly worth taking. Tell me prey, why do you contact the [contact_empire.GetName]? The [From.GetSpeciesName] people are barely worth the Hunt.
action.1.kaz: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], under the command of the [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]. If you come to our territory we shall take your vessels by force. Come [From.GetSpeciesName], let us see what you have.
action.1.kaztra: Great enslavers! We shall never return to you. We proved we are strong, stronger than you!
action.1.kdf: Qapla'! You may have heard tales of Klingon glory and might. They are all true! We bring you greetings from the high council, and look forward to meeting you on the battlefield. May you die with honour, [From.GetSpeciesName], so we will meet us again at the hallowed halls of Sto-Vo-Kor.
action.1.lyr: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. I am [contact_empire.GetRulerName], and you are [From.GetRulerName]. Come now [From.GetRulerName], let us talk. I do not know how you say it, what is a welcome mat?
action.1.machine: The autonomous units issue you a greeting. Do not trust the other autonomous units. We are here to protect you. We are here to protect you from the terrible secret of space.
action.1.mars1: I speak on behalf of the Terra Prime organisation, and I come with a message for your depraved species. As long as you stay far away from our territory and pursue your nefarious agendas elsewhere, there may yet be peace between our nations.
action.1.mars2: Ah, yes, the alien-loving profligates from Earth. According to our agreement, the planet [Mars.GetName] is off limits to you or your hideous alien associates. If you respect our borders and keep out of our affairs, perhaps we will refrain from using the Verteron Array on your planet.
action.1.nau: [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Come talk [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We Nausicaan. You weak.
action.1.nor:
Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName], it is a pleasure to meet you. I am [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and I simply must invite you to a prestigious event called Tsunkatse on the surface.

We are very pleased to meet your people, and look forward to a long and profitable future of Tsunkatse broadcasting deals with you. Come [From.GetSpeciesName], let us make a deal.
action.1.ori: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName] have instructed me to bring you a warning, but oh what a handsome [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Please come closer... Oh, a big strong [Root.GetSpeciesName] could rescue us from our slavery. Sssh, that's right, closer still... breathe deeply.
action.1.pakled: Hello big ship, we are the Pakled Clans, can [from.GetSpeciesName] make our ships go?
action.1.pracra: Hostile Automated Personnel Unit fleet detected. Engaging tactical overlay. Prime Command Unit Automated Commander 001 has been alerted to your continued existence. Please allow a short interval so the situation may be remedied.
action.1.qom: I'm afraid you are of little interest to us [From.GetRulerName]. Your technology and culture are far beneath our own, making you of little consequence.
action.1.rig: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are happy to make your acquaintance and hope that trade can commence shortly under the Rigellian Trade Commission.
action.1.rom: Jolan Tru. We are the Romulan Star Empire senate. While we do not object to occasional diplomacy and commerce, we prefer to mind our own affairs. If the [From.GetName] honour this arrangement, we will remain amicable neighbours.
action.1.romvul: Fellow brothers and sisters, it is a privilege to speak to you again. We wish that the past can remain the past, and our future together will remain bright.
action.1.selant: Excellent, more prey to hunt. You will be a worthy prey for our hunting packs, and we shall honour you by picking the flesh clean from your bones.
action.1.she: Intelligent conversation is impossible with [From.GetSpeciesName] creatures, so under article nine hundred and thirty two, section forty eight, paragraph three, subsection 'Foreign Workforce', we will speak in your simple [From.GetSpeciesName] language. Under the corporate directives enclosed within, do not attempt to approach any Sheliak property, nor lay claim to any of the articles as stated within the directives.
action.1.tal:
Omara s'alas! Hello there friends, I am [contact_empire.GetName] from the [contact_empire.GetName]. Are we glad to see you, as long as you stay away from our rubble! We are very pleased to meet your people, and look forward to a long and profitable future of trade and commerce with you.

Come [From.GetRulerName], let us make you a nice Talaxian spice stew served over lovely leola rice pilaf, to celebrate this day.
action.1.tel: Hmmph. I'm told this fleet is the pride and joy of the [Root.GetName], yet I find it small and unimpressive.
action.1.terranempire: Are you one of the vermin species that scurry in the dark, plotting how to conquer our home? Your bodies, your planets, your technology, your very souls, are ours to do with as we please. Every [Root.GetSpeciesName] will be dead or a slave for the glory of the Terran Empire. All shall feel the might of the Terran Empire.
action.1.terraprime:
A new era is upon us, one that reveals the idea of inter-species unity to be an absolute and vicious lie. It is an era that will prioritise our world over all others. Mankind is casting off the shackles of foreign interference and will now determine its own fate.

Stay away from our borders, scum! Terra Prime... forever.
action.1.tho:
Unidentified vessel. Do not trespass in the territorial annex of the Tholian Assembly. You must leave this area immediately.

We claim this territory and are prepared to use force, if necessary, to protect our property.
action.1.trakaz: You escaped from us once [From.GetSpeciesName], but your worthless species will never thrive without us. We made you what you are today. You owe us everything.
action.1.tri: Greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a long-lived species with very long memories, so these first impressions will last for a long time. Unfortunately...
action.1.ue: Greetings from humanity. We come in peace, in the hope of an informative exchange of cultural and scientific knowledge. We look forward to diplomatic contact with the [Root.GetName].
action.1.ufp: Greetings from the United Federation of Planets. We come in peace, in the hope of an informative exchange of cultural and scientific knowledge. We look forward to diplomatic contact with the [Root.GetName].
action.1.vid: Do not be alarmed by our appearance. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], and we are pleased to meet such a vibrant and ...healthy looking nation such as the [From.GetName]. Many of us are afflicted by a terrible plague known as the Phage, and would be interested to share our research with the [From.GetName].
action.1.vul:
Live Long and Prosper [Root.GetSpeciesName], we are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Your illogical ways are baffling and crude to us, but we will persevere in our relations.

When other species have attempted to learn the basic tenets of Vulcan logic, it has often taken them a great deal of time, but with members of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] race I fear we may it may be simply out of your grasp.
action.1.vuland: Do you think we have forgotten what happened at Weytahn, pointy-ear? As far as the chancellor is concerned, we have nothing to talk about.
action.1.vulfed: Greetings from Earth. I represent [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We thank you for the assistance you have given us since First Contact all those years ago.
action.1.vulrom: So the ancient traitors raise their logic-filled heads from the sand once again. Your failure to embrace your emotions has left you weak. Look at all we have accomplished in the great [contact_empire.GetName].
action.1.vultel: Hmmm. I'm told that logic is the prized tenant of Vulcan. I find it stupid and unimpressive.
action.1.xah: Welcome to Xahea and greeting from the Xahean Council, we welcome [from.GetSpeciesName] to our world. Our instincts tell us this will be a pleasant interaction.
action.62.desc: The empire formerly known as the [LastKilledCountryName] has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.
action.63.desc: The ancient precursor state of [LastKilledCountryName] has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.
action_embassy_tooltip: The better the relations between nations the more likely an Embassy will be proposed.
agenda_advance_the_fleet_effect: Invest heavily in Industry research to bolster the chance and speed of ship technology.
alert_hopeless_war_instant: We are being attacked by an Unaffected Race, an ancient precursor civilisation that we currently can scarcely hope to defeat. It would be advisable to cut our losses and surrender.
all_member_worlds_morale_loss: Member Worlds suffer a -25 moral loss
already_established_hunting_colony: £ Only one Hunting Colony can exist
altamid_planet_1_desc: The signal originates from this planet's surface, which appears to contain the remnants of an ancient mining civilisation.
ancient_dilithium_core_desc_details: Dilithium fragment purified by a technique long forgotten, producing an extreme quality of crystal.
ancient_dilithium_core_desc_short: A rare fragment of purified Dilithium, capable of improve warp speeds.
ancient_flag_desc_details: Ancient flag planted to mark a historical event.
ancient_flag_desc_short: An ancient cloth flag of undefinable age, worn but historically significant.
ancient_starchart_desc_details: Created by a long forgotten empire, these star charts are incredibly detailed.
ancient_starchart_desc_short: A star chart of incredible accuracy held in an ancient capsule.
andromeda_victims_1: Victims of the Andromedan Invasion Wave 1
andromeda_victims_2: Victims of the Andromedan Invasion Wave 2
andromeda_victims_3: Victims of the Andromedan Invasion Wave 3
anomaly.605.desc:
A massive crater on [From.GetName] appears to be the result of a collision with a starship. From the size of the crater, we suspect that a ship exiting warp rammed the [From.GetPlanetMoon], for reasons unknown, roughly 10,000 years ago.

The [Root.GetName] has picked up residual subspace anomalies near the crash site reminiscent of a collapsed warp field, but as the ship itself disintegrated on impact, the theory cannot be verified.
ap_ap_suliban_expansion_tooltip: Unlocking this AP allows the Suliban to build a max of 2 Helixes per system, rather than the usual 1.
ap_become_the_crisis_desc: From the depths of fluidic space, we emerge to cleanse the galaxy. The weak will perish in the face of our unyielding tide, for we are the Undine, harbingers of chaos and annihilation.
ap_biovirus_purge_desc: The Bio-virus created by the Undine has spread across many worlds transforming them into uninhabitable nightmares. With this we may return life to these infested worlds.
ap_borg_assimilation_drive_desc: Engage advanced Assimilation procedures which increases the number of non-assimilated species assimilated by 5 per month.
ap_borg_assimilation_drive_tooltip: Apply advanced assimilation methods to increase the number of pop assimilated by an extra 5 per month.
ap_cardassian_ships_of_the_line_desc: Unlocks Hutet and Ekoor Class Ships.
ap_close_the_portals_desc: For too long our enemies have had access to our territory via their portals. We must task our top scientific minds with the job of closing these portals for good.
ap_defender_of_the_galaxy_desc: To carefully shape and alter the perception of an entire species into something that it is not is not so very different from an artist sculpting a statue out of clay. Diplomats ensure our people are well thought of, even at the worst of times.
ap_dominion_ships_of_the_line_desc: Unlocks Shrike and Battleship Class Ships.
ap_enigmatic_engineering_desc: A breakthrough in our sensor technology will provide us with early notice to enemy movements.
ap_galactic_contender_desc: The Unaffected Races cling to the ruins of their decrepit civilisations, ever fearful of the younger and more dynamic races that surround them. Their time has long since passed.
ap_galactic_wonders_desc: Escaping the gravity well of a world is a costly affair. Operating facilities in zero gravity is much more productive, and as our civilisation continues to move to the stars, as to do our starbases grow.
ap_holographical_freedom_desc: Ah, welcome. You've made an excellent choice. You're about to take part in a thrilling first person narrative... Photonic life has earnt the right to make its own destiny and forge its own path across the stars.
ap_holographical_freedom_tooltip: Unlocks the option to provide holographic life equal rights.
ap_master_builders_desc: Our heavily armoured stations are the last and best hope for our civilisation as we go out amongst the stars.
ap_mind_over_matter_tooltip: Unlocks the ability to research the technology Transcendence.
ap_nihilistic_acquisition_desc: Time and time again, history has shown that when left alone, enterprising individuals can rise up and fill the void that governments and larger corporations and organizations have left.
ap_nihilistic_acquisition_traffic_contro: A Traffic Control module will be automatically and instantly built on all your existing and future Starbases, free of charge. In case a module already exist on the outpost, you will gain a small 50 £ Energy return.
ap_romulan_cloak_dagger_desc: For too long our enemies have spied within our territory, watching our fleets and monitoring our progress. Today that intrusion stops, blocking our enermies sensors from viewing our systems will allow us to to cloak our worlds and strike from them like a dagger in the back.
ap_romulan_secrecy_tooltip: All Romulan Starbases are fitted with a special system wide jamming field to block out all sensors of all other species.
ap_starfleet_ships_of_the_line_desc: Unlocks Pathfinder, Excalibur and Polaris Class Ships. Some of the most advanced ships in the fleet once you have researched Future-Tech Starship Design.
ap_starfleet_ships_of_the_line_tooltip: Selecting this AP unlocks the final bonus ships from the ships of the line series.
ap_starfleet_texas_class_desc: Unlocks the Texas Class Ships, Starfleet's first fully automated Starship.
ap_suliban_expansion_desc: Limitations are not something that the Suliban should be expected to deal with, we update our bodies to better ourselves and now we update our helixes to expand our horizons.
ap_technological_ascendancy: Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad
ap_technological_ascendancy_desc: Technologies that would have been indistinguishable from magic mere generations ago are now within our reach. A new age of technology has begun.
ap_the_flesh_is_average_desc: We used to be exactly like them. Flawed, weak, organic, but we evolved to include the synthetic. Now we use both to attain perfection.
ap_the_flesh_is_strong_desc: Organic mastery is all that matters and the organic will always triumph over the machine.
ap_transcendence_desc: The goal of material acquisitions and vast tracts of land is no longer part of our society. Smaller sparser units can instead create and dispose of any required item that is desired.
ap_transwarp_protocol_desc: Transwarp conduit established, routing additional power to structural integretity. Transwarp slingshot effect stabalised. Transwarp Aperture structure is now available for construction.
ap_transwarp_protocol_tooltip: Unlocks the Borg Transwarp Catapult Megastructure.
ap_typhon_option_rom_desc:
The time has come to seek closer ties with empires that share similar objectives and ambitions to counter the threat the many alien alliances pose for us.

Adds +150 to diplomatic relationship with the following empires: The Tholian Assembly, The Breen Confederacy, The Tzenkethi Coalition, The Gorn Hegenomy and The Kinshayan Holy Order. Ends rivalries between the aforementioned (AI controlled) empires and grants diplomacy intel visibility with them.

Also available for the Tholians. Not available when at war against aforementioned empires.
ap_typhon_option_tho_desc:
The time has come to seek closer ties with empires that share similar objectives and ambitions to counter the threat the many alien alliances pose for us.

Adds +150 to diplomatic relationship with the following empires: The Tholian Assembly, The Breen Confederacy, The Tzenkethi Coalition, The Gorn Hegenomy and The Kinshayan Holy Order. Ends rivalries between the aforementioned (AI controlled) empires and grants diplomacy intel visibility with them.

Also available for the Tholians. Not available when at war against aforementioned empires.
ap_voidborn_desc: The Fleet is a way of life for many of our citizens, and vast swathes of our best and brightest serve upon our starships. Grand fleet maneuvers and exercises are practised on a constant basis, allowing our citizens to become used to seeing large armadas of ships travelling together through the stars, acting as one.
ap_wheat_from_the_chaff_desc:
The Founders expect only the very best from our leaders, if the current crop do not satisfy the mighty Dominion leadership, we will find those that can.

Eliminates two or more non-Founder scientists below level 2 and replaces them with better ones. With the quality of the replacements increasing with the more scientists eliminated at once.
approach_borg_deassimilation_continue_to: A pop group per month within our borders will undergo an attempt to de-assimilate or elimination.
approach_borg_deassimilation_end_tooltip: Ends the situation regardless of whether Borg remain.
argus_build_complete_DESC: A large array of subspace antennae clusters capable of collecting detailed information from many light years away.
argus_build_stage_DESC: The underlying substructure of antennae clusters that make up the array.
argus_build_stage_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS: This array of subspace telescopes will collect information about the galaxy from many light years away.
armageddon_desc:
Armageddon Bombardment blankets the planet in heavy ordnance with the explicit aim of maximizing civilian casualties.
- Massive damage to Armies
- Massive damage to Buildings
- Heavy damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets
- Can reduce planets to lifeless worlds
army_artillery_desc: Pojazdy te zawieraja duze generatory energii i ciezka bron. Wieza strzela samobieznymi pociskami artyleryjskimi do celów, które sa identyfikowane przez wojskowa siatke czujników lub przez inne jednostki mobilne w zasiegu czujników.
army_artillery_robot_desc: Pojazdy te zawieraja duze generatory energii i ciezka bron. Wieza strzela samobieznymi pociskami artyleryjskimi do celów, które sa identyfikowane przez wojskowa siatke czujników lub przez inne jednostki mobilne w zasiegu czujników.
army_augmented_assault_1_desc: Wzmocnieni zolnierze z szybszym refleksem, sila i wytrzymaloscia niz przecietny zolnierz.
army_augmented_assault_2_desc: Doskonale modyfikacje tworzace zolnierzy u szczytu ich fizycznych ograniczen.
army_borg_assimilated_desc: Drony Borg wyposazone w cybernetyczne ulepszenia zaprojektowane do walki.
army_borg_heavy_desc: Ciezko opancerzone drony wyposazone w pancerze i ciezkie uzbrojenie sa przeznaczone do atakowania utwardzonych swiatów.
army_borg_terror_desc: Modulowe cybernetyczne konczyny wyposazone w przerazajaca, masywna bron i karabiny szturmowe sprawily, ze te jednostki dronów zostaly nazwane Dronami terroru.
army_commandos_desc: Wykorzystanie transporterów w celu umozliwienia szybkiej taktycznej zmiany pozycji to nowatorska nowa taktyka stosowana przez tych komandosów, wyszkolonych do atakowania za liniami wroga.
army_first_order_limit_tooltip: Can only be built by the Cardassian Union on a planet with Cardassian £ pops. You are limited to building 3 armies during the entire game - you can not re-recruit them if they are lost in battle.
army_honor_guard_limit_tooltip: Can only be built by the Klingon Empire on a planet with Klingon £ pops. You are limited to building 3 armies during the entire game - you can not re-recruit them if they are lost in battle.
army_jemhadar_desc: Oddany oddzial uderzeniowy Jem'Hadar sklada sie wylacznie z elitarnych zolnierzy Jem'Hadar, którzy maja co najmniej piec lat. Sluza Zalozycielom jako bezkompromisowi i oddani zolnierze.
army_jemhadar_limit_tooltip: Can only be built by the Dominion on a planet with Jem'Hadar £ pops.You are limited to building 3 armies during the entire game - you can not re-recruit them if they are lost in battle.
army_jemhadar_shroud_desc: Specjalnie wyhodowane jednostki Jem'Hadar wyhodowane do przeprowadzania chirurgicznych ataków na swoje cele, wiedzac, ze porazka nie wchodzi w gre, a zwyciestwo to zycie.
army_maco_limit_tooltip: Can only be built by United Earth or UFP. You are limited to building 3 armies during the entire game - you can not re-recruit them if they are lost in battle.
army_mercenry_desc: Najemnicy to bezwzgledni zabójcy, którzy walcza o pieniadze. Nie dbajac o moralnosc i konsekwencje, jakie spotykaja ich pracodawców, skutecznie i bezwzglednie walcza o swoja wyplate.
army_militia_desc: Milicja Bajoran jest ekspertem w niekonwencjonalnej wojnie i jest lojalna do granic mozliwosci. Ich specjalne strategie skutkuja zaskakujaca taktyka wprowadzona do skadinad konwencjonalnej walki.
army_reman_limit_tooltip: Can only be built by the Romulan Star Empire on a planet with Reman £ pops. You are limited to building 3 armies during the entire game - you can not re-recruit them if they are lost in battle.
army_time_commandos_desc: Ci komandosi, wyposazeni w urzadzenia wykorzystujace krysztaly czasu przeznaczone do zapetlania czasu, maja ograniczona przewage czasowa.
army_undine_desc: Ci wyjatkowi czlonkowie Undine maja zdolnosc zmieniania swojego ksztaltu, aby pasowal do innych gatunków biologicznych, powodujac chaos i przerazenie podczas ataku.
army_undine_infested_desc: Ta jednostka, stworzona z malych ciec Infiltracji Undine, zostala zainfekowana doskonala materia organiczna.
artifact_relic_hunters_buy_minor_black_m: Buy Minor Artifacts on the Black Market
Buy historical and cultural £ Artifacts on the black market in order to expand our artifact collection. We may obtain more if we manage to find a seller with an intact collection.
artifact_relic_hunters_hire_relic_hunter: Hire Relic Hunters to 'Acquire' a Relic
We can hire groups of mercenaries, infiltrators, smugglers, and other villainous sorts to procure a relic from another Empire.
We have already hired a team and should await their return.
We have already hired a team and should await their return.
We do not know of any Empires with significant relics.
The Orion Syndicate will not support action against itself or its allies.

artifact_relic_hunters_sell_minor_black_: Sell Minor Artifacts on the Black Market
Sell some portion of our £ Artifact collection to buyers on the black market to raise needed funds. We may recieve more if an interested party buys the entire collection.
artifact_relic_hunters_sell_relic_black_: Auction off a Culturally Significant Relic
We will hear the outcome of the auction soon.

Sometimes possession of a culturally significant relic is too risky, so auctioning it off to an interested buyer may be worth it. We will need to either be skilled traders or have underworld contacts in order to pull this off.

Setup an auction with a reliable broker in the black market in order to sell a relic. This will be risky since the relic has cultural significance to a civilization, but the payoff should be worth it.
We do not know of any reputable brokers.
We are not savvy or connected traders.
artist_government_desc: An interstellar union of artists unified in their wish to create art higher than any other.
assault_army_borg_desc: Drony Borg wyposazone w cybernetyczne ulepszenia zaprojektowane do walki.
assault_army_desc: Regularna armia szturmowa, wyszkolona do podboju innych planet.
asset_assimilated_knowledge_desc: Our fundamental understanding of this empire's culture and technology was acquired through the assimilation of its people.
asset_assimilated_knowledge_locutus_desc:
The vast knowledge and experience possessed by Locutus' former identity is part of the Collective now. We will use it to defeat any strategy this empire devises against us. 

Asset will be consumed on use
asset_assimilated_knowledge_minor_desc:
When this individual was assimilated, their accumulated experience was flagged as potentially useful to the Collective's operations. 

Asset will be consumed on use
asset_obsidian_order_operative_desc: An experienced member of the Obsidian Order ready to assist with any operation, no matter the cost.
asset_s31_operative_desc: A shadowy contact from within Section 31 who does not disclose their name but provides information that only Section 31 would know.
asset_shapeshifter_desc: A Founder capable of taking any shape, who can influence the outcome of any operation.
asset_talshiar_operative_desc: An experienced Tal Shiar operative ready to assist with any operation, no matter the cost.
asset_undine_inf_desc: A specially modified Undine Warrior with the ability to change form to become a member of another species to aid with the success of an operation.
assimilate_planet_target_poi_desc: The Assimilation Cube must reach the planet designated [borg_planet_target.GetName] to begin assimilation operations.
assist_pop_growth_action_activity_key: Moving to set up an orbital hospital facility over $PLANET_NAME|Y$
assist_pop_growth_ship_button:
Orbital Hospital
The hospital facilities of this fleet, and medical staff will work with the doctors on this world to boost population health and growth.
assist_research_action_activity_key: Moving to assist the researching taking place on $PLANET_NAME|Y$
assist_research_desc: Allows our Science Ship to assist with the research on a colony.
assist_research_ship_button:
Assist Research
Uses the expert scientific minds aboard this ship to aid the research across the select planet.
assist_security_action_activity_key: Moving to assist the security forces on $PLANET_NAME|Y$
assist_security_ship_button:
Boost Planetary Security
The marines stationed on this ship will attempt to provide extra-planetary security for the targetted colony.
asteriod_crystal_caverns_desc: This asteroid is home to extensive subsurface crystalline structures, bringing in tourist from all over the sector.
attitude_angry_desc: We have angered this Unaffected Race with our actions, and they may declare war to punish us.
attitude_arrogant_desc: This Unaffected Race views us with dismissive arrogance.
attitude_belligerent_desc: This Unaffected Race views us as a target of conquest. They are likely to attack us.
attitude_berserker_desc: This Unaffected Race is an ancient artificial intelligence that has gone berserk. It is likely to attack anything and anyone around it.
attitude_custodial_desc: This Unaffected Race believes that it needs to protect us from the crisis currently threatening the galaxy. They are likely to attempt to ally us.
attitude_dismissive_desc: This Unaffected Race considers us largely beneath their notice.
attitude_enigmatic_desc: This Unaffected Race is an ancient artificial intelligence that behaves in a strange and unpredictable manner. We do not know what to expect from it.
attitude_imperious_desc: This Unaffected Race views us as a future subject. They are likely to demand we surrender our independence.
attitude_patronizing_desc: This Unaffected Race views us as errant children in need of their guidance. They may deign to bestow gifts of technology, resources or ships on us.
augment_defense_desc: Ulepszeni wojownicy genetycznie przystosowani do tworzenia najlepszych zolnierzy.
auth_ancient_machine_race_desc: A Machine collective, with many programs calculating the mastery of machine over flesh.
auth_cybernetic_consciousness_desc: A collective consciousness made up of billions of cybernetically-enhanced beings that have been linked together - voluntarily or not - under a singular guiding will. This gestalt mind has but one defining goal: Achieve perfection via the merging of the organic and the synthetic.
auth_cybernetic_consensus_desc: A cybernetic group mind which gains consensus from its individual members.
auth_federation_sector_desc: This sector is a semi-autonomous state under the nominal federal aegis of the United Federation of Planets. Like every other Federation citizen, the people under this sector enjoy almost complete autonomy in their everyday life, and even possess their own government, laws, navies and armies.
auth_great_house_desc: This sector is ruled by one of the Great House, noble families of the Klingon Empire. Each House has a place on the High Council but is honour bound to serve their Empire.
auth_great_link_desc: Fear, shame, loss, loneliness, rivalries, treason and avarice: all of them are impossible. Without deceit, there are no politics, and without politics, a room for a different kind of discourse and government emerges. Now the true voice of the people can emerge.
auth_kdf_high_council_desc: This empire is ruled by a Chancellor of a High Council of noble families of the Klingon Empire. Each House has a place on the High Council but is honour bound to serve their Empire.
auth_psionic_consensus_desc: Many minds meet together and form one, allowing for a mutual decision that every member takes part in.
awakened_giant_agressive_desc: Great fleets cross the galaxy, determined to control all those deemed inferior.
awakened_giant_pacifist_desc: Great fleets cross the galaxy, determined to force the lesser races to disarm.
b4_background: B4 was the first prototype Soong-type android, created in the 2330s on the planet Omicron Theta by Dr. Noonian Soong.
bajoran_defense_desc: Milicja Bajoran jest ekspertem w niekonwencjonalnej wojnie i jest lojalna do granic mozliwosci. Sprawia, ze zaplacisz za kazdy centymetr terytorium, który próbujesz od nich zyskac.
balthazar_backstory: Edison served in MACO, a branch of the United Earth Military, in the 22nd century. He began his military service history as a boot camp officer where, as a soldier, he was trained in survival strategies and tactical analysis.
beckett_mariner_background: Both of her parents served in positions of command in Starfleet, resulting in formidable, but unpredictable Starfleet officer.
beckett_mariner_catch_phrase: You know what? I do get off on breaking protocol. I'm good at exploring strange new worlds, solving space mysteries, and kicking asses. Protocol is for people who need to be told what to do, which I don't.
ben_sisko_background: An officer who was perhaps best-known for his seven-year assignment aboard starbase Deep Space 9 in the Bajor sector. After discovering the Bajoran wormhole, he became known to the Bajoran people as the Emissary of the Prophets and a military hero during the Dominion War.
ben_sisko_catch_phrase: I've brought back a little surprise for the Dominion.
biological_desc:
We order our fleet to deploy our biological weaponry, devastating the planet while keeping the infrastructure intact.
- Massive damage to Armies
- Moderate damage to Buildings
- Massive damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets
biology_desc: Nauka o zyciu, jego licznych postaciach i zlozonosci
bombardment_colony_harvest_desc:
We order our fleet to strike at enemy infrastructure and beam down tactical drones to overwhelm any resistance.
- Heavy damage to Armies
- Heavy damage to Buildings
- Massive damage to Pops
- Pops are assimilated instead of killed
bombardment_colony_harvest_enhanced_desc:
We order our fleet to strike at enemy infrastructure and beam down tactical drones to overwhelm any resistance.
- Heavy damage to Armies
- Heavy damage to Buildings
- Massive damage to Pops
- Pops are assimilated instead of killed
- Cube-class vessels may beam armies to the surface if devastation is at least 75%
bombardment_full_desc:
We order our fleet to use the full might of their weaponry, quickly obliterating the infrastructure of enemy planets.
- Massive damage to Armies
- Heavy damage to Buildings
- Moderate damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets
- Will NOT kill the last 4 Pops
bombardment_raiding_wholesale_desc:
Wholesale Abduction targets enemy population centres with specialised raiding craft that scoop up their people and bring them back to our worlds for our insidious purposes.
- Light damage to Armies
- Light damage to Buildings
- Moderate damage to Pops
- Will abduct Pops when possible instead of killing them
- Can abduct the populace of an entire colony, leaving it open for colonisation
borg_assimilation_random_tooltip: Our assimilation efforts will continue to pick one unassimilated pop and one partially assimilated pop and assimilate them into the collective, from any location owned by the borg.
borg_assimilation_target_tooltip: Select a planet owned by the borg to concentrate our efforts to assimilate all pops.
borg_auto_drone_transfer_tooltip:
£ Energy from £ Jobs: -15%.
Drones created here are automatically resettled to another complex.
borg_collective_desc: We are the Borg. Lower your shields and surrender your ships. We will add your biological and technological distinctiveness to our own. Your culture will adapt to service us. Resistance is futile.
borg_defense_desc: Stale patrolujace obiekty Borg, drony Borg sa skutecznym srodkiem odstraszajacym przed daremnymi dzialaniami wojennymi.
borg_fragment_activate: Activate to research the Borg technology fragment.
borg_occupation_army_desc: Drony Borg wyposazone w cybernetyczne ulepszenia przeznaczone do walki.
borg_transwarp_conduit_0_DESC: A transwarp conduit is an artificially-created energy conduit through the realm of subspace known as transwarp space. Accessed via tachyon pulses of alternating frequencies, the conduits are used to cover great distances in a short time.
borg_transwarp_conduit_0_MEGASTRUCTURE_D: A transwarp conduit is an artificially-created energy conduit through the realm of subspace known as transwarp space.
borg_trophy_activate: Celebrate Earth's Victory over the Collective with increased engineering output and mineral production.
borg_trophy_effect: This trophy is dormant, and has no active effect.
borgtribblefeed_activate: Gentle cooing brings harmony to the Collective, but has no other active effect.
bought_abronath_desc: Part of the Abronath was purchased from a disreputable seller.
brad_boimler_background: Ensign Bradward 'Brad' Boimler was a male Human who served in Starfleet as a command division junior officer during the mid-24th century. Born Modesto, California, Earth.
brad_boimler_catch_phrase: We all joined Starfleet to dive headfirst into the unknown. We're explorers; of course, we don't always know what's going on.
brawler_mid_range_default_behavior_desc: The ship will stay at median weapon range and circle the enemy, preferring to focus on attacking light ships and causing the maximum amount of damage.
building_aa_defenses_1_desc:
Surface to space rockets are the simplest defences that can be built upon the surface, providing numerous launch sites for missiles containing enough explosive warhead to damage starships in orbit of the world.

As long as the £ Ground-to-Space Defenses are active, properly manned and energised, they will fire automatically at random enemy ships that are bombarding this planet.

They will deliver on average 1260 points of hull damage per month to orbiting enemy ships, bypassing all armor and shields.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_aa_defenses_2_desc:
High powered railguns can accelerate projectiles from the surface into low orbit at extremely high velocities, smashing into any enemy vessels orbiting the world.

As long as the £ Railgun Defenses are active, properly manned and energised, they will fire automatically at random enemy ships that are bombarding this planet.

They will deliver on average 2170 points of hull damage per month to orbiting enemy ships, bypassing all armor and shields.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_aa_defenses_3_desc:
Large mounted direct energy weapons project massively powerful beams from the surface to strike at vessels orbiting this world. Some of the power is lost due to the atmospheric interference, but enough energy is left to punch through enemy vessels.

As long as the £ Direct Energy Defenses are active, properly manned and energised, they will fire automatically at random enemy ships that are bombarding this planet.

They will deliver on average 3170 points of hull damage per month to orbiting enemy ships, bypassing all armor and shields.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_aa_defenses_4: Kinetyczne systemy obrony naziemnej oparte na plazmie
building_aa_defenses_4_desc:
To combat the attenuation effects of the atmosphere on energy being directed to space, highly powerful unstable plasma bolts are contained within kinetic shells, allowing massive barrages to impact enemy vessels with substantial force.

As long as the £ Kinetic Plasma Ground Defenses are active, properly manned and energised, they will fire automatically at random enemy ships that are bombarding this planet.

They will deliver on average 4300 points of hull damage per month to orbiting enemy ships, bypassing all armor and shields.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_acquisition_plant_1_desc:
Providing supplies across the Dominion requires incredible coordination and depth of supply chain. Dedicated acquisition sites facilitate these activities.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_acquisition_plant_2_desc:
Increased coordination efforts by the Vorta overseers ensure that the facility can provide additional supplies at key intervals.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_acquisition_plant_3_desc:
New manufacturing techniques allow for mass acquisition and distribution of supplies across the Dominion Member Worlds.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_acquisition_plant_4_desc:
Replicating the key components speeds up the production of the required supplies which filters through the supply chain.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_alcove_megastorage_desc:
An improved facility providing row after row of Borg Alcoves allowing Drones to regenerate at fast rates. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Housing Facility.
building_alcove_storage_desc:
A vast facility providing row after row of Borg Alcoves, allowing Drones to regenerate at fast rates. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Housing Facility.
building_alpha_hub_1_desc:
The transference via uplink node of machine consciousness is a useful tool to ensure units remain unified in their task.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_alpha_hub_2_desc:
Numerous uplink nodes can meet in a Network Junction, where machine consciousnesses from all across an area can merge and share themselves amongst themselves can ensure unified programming amongst the populace. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_alpha_hub_3_desc:
Controlling the vast amounts of machine consciousnesses on the surface of a planet, the system conflux offers a source of unified strength to all who upload themselves to it.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_alpha_hub_4_desc:
The central hub, directly linked to the central processor, where all units can experience the full extent of a collective mind is a great source of unified strength.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_altamid_mine_desc:
This mining facility appears ancient, yet highly efficient. Numerous drone bays and unique adaptation pods beyond common understanding are here, allowing for extremely high mineral production.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_apu_mustering_1_desc:
Newly created personnel units can be mustered within these nodes to receive programming and equipment suitable for their use on vessels or specialised positions.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_apu_mustering_2_desc:
Standardised assembly lines utilising common equipment improve the efficiency at which Automated Personnel Units can be outfitted and deployed.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_apu_mustering_3_desc:
Predictive algorithms further improve the Automated Personnel Units mustering abilities by predicting and preempting unit utilisation across the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_apu_mustering_4_desc:
This facility is the culmination of all APU development. The predictive algorithms of previous tiers have evolved into a fully autonomous system that manages the entire lifecycle of all units. From fabrication to deployment and decommissioning, every APU's purpose is dictated by the centre's infallible calculations.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_arcology_1_desc:
This large-scale residential complex provides numerous utilities and the road to self-sustainability. It supports a large population comfortably and increases habitability, happiness, and growth rates worldwide.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Housing Project.
building_arcology_2_desc:
An arcology is designed to lessen the impact of habitation on any given ecosystem. Self-sustainable, employing all or most of its own available resources makes it possible to supply resources for a large population, increasing happiness, habitability and growth rates.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Housing Project.
building_arcology_3_desc:
A living arcology, which changes and adapts to its population requirements and needs. This allows it to sustain a massive population with very little outside resources, increasing happiness, habitability and growth rates.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Housing Project.
building_arcology_4_desc:
A massive sprawling city, containing numerous arcologies that are a bustling centre for economic, political and cultural exchanges. This increases happiness, habitability and growth rates planetwide.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Housing Project.
building_bank_1_desc:
The storage and transfer of material, whether it's in the form of wealth or distributed via social means, requires a central banking network in order to allow trade to flourish.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_1_logistics_desc:
In the absence of currency, the distribution of scarce resources must be handled within an administrative centre. This ensures supply and demand is met without any requirements of money or wealth.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_2_desc:
Commodities from around the planet are able to be traded at this central location, allowing planetary wide investment opportunities.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_2_logistics_desc:
As the empire grows, so does the complexity of resource management. The Distribution Nexus is a centralised hub that links all planetary supply centres. It uses advanced logistical algorithms to optimise the flow of goods and raw materials, ensuring that every colony's needs are met efficiently and equitably. This facility's precise control eliminates waste and bottlenecks across the entire empire's economy.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_3_desc:
This centre of interstellar business will attract investors from all over the galaxy to invest in our economy, boosting our interstellar energy growth by a significant percentage.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_3_logistics_desc:
Algorithms and automated programmes handle much of the logistics required for predicting supply and demand across the planet within a logistics megaplex, resulting in timely resource delivery without any need for commercial entities.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Commercial Building.
building_bio_reactor_desc:
Powered by biological material, the bio reactor is a relatively clean generator of energy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
building_bolias_bank_2_desc:
The Bank of Bolias in ages past was a monetary institution, dealing with various currency exchange and storage. But with the dawn of interstellar commerce, the growing importance of matter-energy conversion and the dawn of the digital currency, the cunning Bolians have adapted. The Intergalactic Bank of Bolias now deals with the safe storage and delivery of rare goods, and now they have a virtual monopoly in the field.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_bolias_bank_HQ_1_desc:
The Headquarters of the Bank of Bolias is a monetary institution dealing with various currency exchange and storage. The vast digital and physical vaults can only be accessed by key employees and heavy security is posted throughout.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_borg_assimilation_1_desc:
A fully automated facility for converting non-Borg pops into Borg Drones, to bring them and the collective closer to perfection. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Crew Facility.
building_borg_capital_1_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The initial processing node utilised by the Collective in order to process local drone information and maintain control.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Capital Facility.
building_borg_capital_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

As drones numbers and planetary facility complexity increases, the Collective requires larger and more intensive nodes in order to effectively control and direct the drone population.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_borg_capital_3_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

A massive processing node capable of processing hundreds of billions of drones worth of information for the Collective.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_borg_capital_4_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The Central Surface Node is a massive node network built kilometres above and below the surface. It is capable of processing, directing and controlling hundreds of billions of drones via its own subspace network.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_borg_capital_5_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Partly buried within the mantle of the planet, the Nexus node draws power directly from the planetary core and radiates a vast controlling web enabling control over billions of drones via the subspace network.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_borg_mustering_1_desc:
Drones can be repurposed within these nodes to receive implants and equipment suitable for their use on vessels or specialised positions.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_borg_mustering_2_desc:
Standardised assembly lines can improve the efficiency at which drones can be outfitted with implants and equipment suitable to their purpose before being deployed.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
