building_mars_utopia_planitia_desc: Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards, also known as Utopia Planitia Starfleet Yards or Utopia Planitia Shipyards, is a key Starfleet vessel construction and design facility. The facility includes several large drafting rooms for starship design and planetary facilities on the surface of Mars, as well as a number of drydocks and space stations in orbit.
building_memory_alpha_desc:
Memory Alpha was created specifically as an open, undefended centre of knowledge of the Federation and the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_menagerie_capital_5_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

A perfect psionic dreamworld, which is all a masquerade for a menagerie of prisoners, where those within can be harvested for their memories and thoughts.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_metaphstic_collector_desc:
A large powerful collector of metaphasic radiation. This building opens up a powerful unique edict.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_military_academy_1_desc:
Training volunteers from all over the world improves our soldiers' ability to combat enemy threats.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_2_desc:
The volunteers that are brought to the militia academies are often ill equipped for the dangers of combat. Survival techniques and combat prowess is taught to them here, turning them into a working fighting force.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_3_desc:
Training raw recruits from a civilian life up to a professional standard requires specialist training facilities and equipment, which can be provided in an Army Academy. Training on all types of weaponry from fixed weapon emplacements to vehicular combat is also taught here.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_4_desc:
These academies are founded on the experience we have gained since encountering foreign species. Interspecies physical training and armed training have allowed us to not only enhance our soldiers vitality but also reduce training time.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_andoria_1_desc:
This facility serves as a primary local hub for Laikan military operations, handling recruitment, basic training, and essential logistical support for regional defense forces.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_andoria_2_desc:
The Laikan Military Academy is an educational institute located on Andoria. This academy trains cadets for service in the Andorian military and provides extension courses through its Department of Foreign Studies to officers from other empires.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_andoria_3_desc:
Expanding far beyond its educational roots, the Laikan Military Complex now encompasses advanced research divisions, specialised tactical training units, and large-scale strategic planning facilities. It serves as a comprehensive centre for developing cutting-edge military doctrines and honing the skills of elite forces across all branches.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_andoria_4_desc:
The Laikan Military Nexus stands as the undisputed strategic heart of the Laikan military, a formidable hub where all major command, intelligence, and doctrinal development converge. This pinnacle facility orchestrates galactic operations, pioneers revolutionary combat strategies, and serves as the ultimate wellspring for the most formidable officers and specialised forces in the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_hirogen_1_desc:
Rather than teaching new hunters with the dangerous and time consuming nature of seeking out worthy prey, custom battlegrounds made of cargo and netting can satiate the hunters needs and teach valuable lessons.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_hirogen_2_desc:
Simple firing ranges and combat courses are part of the hunter training academy, allowing Hirogen to test their might against each other and learn valuable hunting techniques.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_hirogen_3_desc:
An vast complex filled with trophies of previous hunts, where hunters must learn the weaknesses of a vast array of creatures and sentients in order to improve their effectiveness.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_hirogen_4_desc:
Rather than teaching new hunters with the dangerous and time consuming nature of seeking out worthy prey, holographic representations can satiate the hunters needs and teach valuable lessons.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_1_de:
For nine millennia, the Zakdorn have been regarded by potential foes as having the greatest innately strategic minds in the galaxy. Their academies teach the best and the brightest of the sharpest minds, with only the most elite moving on to the Strategos.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_2_de:
A more advanced academy, the Strategium is where the finest minds are honed into practical instruments of interstellar policy. Curriculum here is less about the fundamentals of war and more about the art of winning without firing a shot, through feints, diplomatic maneuvers, and the relentless application of strategic pressure. It is where future admirals learn to think a dozen steps ahead of their opponents.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_3_de:
An elite institution that serves as the final filter before a Zakdornian strategist is given a true command. The High Strategos is a blend of advanced academy and command centre, where cadets are not just taught to lead, but are tested under the most rigorous simulations to ensure their minds and wills are unbreakable. Only the most elite graduate to become a Strategos.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_4_de:
The Grand Strategos is the apex of Zakdornian military thought. It is the highest council and the ultimate command centre, where the most brilliant military minds gather to devise grand strategies that can span decades and influence the fate of entire quadrants. To be inducted into the Grand Strategos is to be recognized as one of the greatest military minds in the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_desc:
This institution builds upon the foundational theory of the Military College, moving beyond basic strategy to focus on the intricate logistics and psychological warfare of large-scale, interstellar conflict. Here, students don't just learn about battle; they learn to create it on a grand scale, mastering fleet movements and resource denial in complex three-dimensional space.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_1_desc:
Construction of a local garrison provides the infrastructure required to arm and outfit numerous defensive units. Hardened bunkers and defensive positions allow the defence armies to hold out against superior numbers. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_2_desc:
Improvements to the garrison allow for a more permanent defensive force to be stationed in this system at the Division Headquarters, which is able to respond to any assaults rapidly across the planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_3_desc:
The headquarters of our orbital armies is a fortified command and control stronghold, filled with numerous divisions of defensive troops capable of coordinating the defences across the entire planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_4_desc:
A massive hardened and purpose built set of structures with large tunnel complexes under the surface allow for entire armies of units to be stationed in this fortress, able to defend against massed assaults by invading armies.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_borg_1_desc:
Active sensors and force field projectors allow this node to project power across a local section of Borg territory.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_borg_2_desc:
Large shield generators mixed with active sensors and forcefield projectors to allow this node to stand as a heavily armoured position.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_borg_3_desc:
Utilising information assimilated from many species, the armoured facilities throughout the planet are outfitted with fixed weapon emplacements and strong shield generators, allowing this node to stand as a central hub for any planetary defense.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_borg_4_desc:
Massively armoured structures filled with power nodes mixed with heavy tactical plating allow this complex to stand as a heavily armoured position throughout this area of space. Massive command and control nodes coordinate defenses for many worlds.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_capital_3_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

A central command and control complex for all military activity upon the surface of the world, with lines of communication to every base, depot and training site.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_military_capital_4_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Most of the army is now stationed here. The site has been expanded further to accommodate the security needs. Risks and dangers are rising in the universe, as is our military.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_military_capital_5_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The sheer size is enormous and it needs to be this way. This site contains not just troops and equipment for many battalions, but also recruitment and training facilities to meet the increased demand.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_military_contractors_desc:
Private military contractors can undertake security contracts for those with the credits or latinum to purchase their services.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_military_training_2_not_crew_de:
The shrine is a symbol of unification between those that see it, offering a large boost to stability.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_mining_network_1_desc:
After centuries of primitive and dangerous mining methods we have now developed technologically-advanced mining techniques, that will enable us to extract resources from planets by safe and effective means.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_1_lava_desc:
The rich content of the vast lava channels allow for the harvesting of minerals which have been brought from the mantle of the planet to the surface.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_2_desc:
Advances in shielding and harmonic suppressors allow the construction of thermal boreholes that delve deep within the crust allow for further resource extraction.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_2_lava_desc:
Channels below the surface allow for the harvesting of minerals from within the pockets of lava which fill the crust of the planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_3_desc:
Large complex designs allow for large thermal boreholes deep into the crust of the planet, allowing previously inaccessible pockets of rich mineral material to be harvested and mined.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_3_lava_desc:
Large complex designs allow for large thermal boreholes deep into the crust of the planet, allowing previously inaccessible pockets of rich lava and mineral material to be harvested and mined.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_4_desc:
Particle impellers draw the minerals directly from the mantle of the planet, separating and segregating the rich minerals from the useless rock material.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_4_lava_desc:
Particle impellers draw the minerals directly from the lava filled mantle of the planet, separating and segregating the rich minerals from the useless rock material.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Mining Network.
building_ministry_production_1_desc:
The requisition and long term planning for large scale industrial production is achieved via the Ministry of Production.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_monitor_station_desc:
One of Earth's earliest extra planetary installations providing high quality scans of the sol sector and beyond. 

Now used to help coordinate traffic and communications to and from Earth.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_museam_darsay_1_desc:
The Halls of Masaka and Korgano celebrate the lost civilisation of D'Arsay, and were built using painstakingly researched and reconstructed techniques. The museum, which stretches over several kilometres, is nestled in a local river valley. The grounds encompass the two main centres of D'Arsay culture: faith and government. These are the Fortress of the Sun and the Palace of the Moon. A park composed of gently meandering paths and various exhibits representing the everyday life of the D'Arsay populace lies between these two edifices.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_museam_sharien_1_desc:
S'harien was the greatest blacksmith in Vulcan's Forge, creating the best swords on Vulcan. He loved war, hated peace, and therefore despised Surak. At 190 years of age, this unkempt fellow heard that Surak was in the area and pledged to spit on the man. Ten days later, after talking with Surak, he renounced all violence and set about destroying all his swords. However, so beautiful were his wares, that Surak himself begged S'harien to stop his destruction and to retain the weapons.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_museum_1_desc:
Storage and preservation of items important to our cultural heritage has a high priority, and a museum designed for this purpose is the ideal focal point.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_museum_2_desc:
The Hur'Q store the collective knowledge of entire biospecimens in the vast vaults on this planet. There are enclosed enclaves where biological specimens can be studied and harvested at will.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Cultural Building.
building_nanite_factory_1_desc:
The production of nano scale machines known as nanites requires precision material and a stable environment in which to operate, hence the optimal approach is to have it located in zero gravity.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_nanite_factory_2_desc:
Large centrifuges and environmentally pristine bays allow for the replication of nanites in larger volumes than were previously available.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_nanite_factory_3_desc:
Self replicating nanites operate at a submolecular level to create and reproduce themselves over time within these large chambers, ready to be utilised at a moments notice.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_nanite_factory_4_desc:
Vast compressed bays, where nanites are stored so close together they are visible to the naked eye, are outfitted to the foundry with new construction techniques allowing waste materials to be reconstituted into usable material. The high precision results in almost zero waste or discarded nanites due to production failures.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_nano_factory_desc:
This facility cannot be directly built by the Borg. Instead, when assimilating planets, several terrestrial facilities will automatically be adapted to this use.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_naval_HQ_1_borg_desc:
The direct uplink to the harmonisation computers on the Unimatrix allows for the rapid dissemination of key Borg protocols to certain drones.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_breen_desc:
The Confederate Command is responsible for overseeing Breen military and civilian organisations, as well as the Breen's space fleet, diplomatic missions, and scientific research.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_cardassian_desc:
The true heart of the government, Central Command, controls all naval and troop movement within the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_confederacy_desc:
The Corp ensure that humanity takes its rightful place at the centre of the galaxy. Only the most successful and loyal officers are allowed to serve the Confederacy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_desc:
Improvements in communication technology can centralise and better direct a nation's fleets. Essential training of cadets and officers may also be conducted at such a facility.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_hirogen_desc:
An advanced dome filled with ravenous deadly creatures, where hunters must fight in teams just to survive - with only the best leaders able to survive the onslaught.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_klingon_desc:
The Order of the Bat'leth is an exclusive Klingon group, a status awarded to warriors who had distinguished themselves in battle. Drunken celebrations are held for a full day before the induction itself, which is part of the ceremony as an endurance test.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_norcadian_desc:
Vast interspecies facilities exist amongst broadcasters as the requirement for new crews, fighters and new officers increases exponentially. Holographic training allows for simulated scenarios to take place, whilst above, the key broadcasters conduct business.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_pralor_desc:
The progenitors of the Automated Personnel Units instilled programming available only at these nodes that enables certain units to control vessels and explore the stars.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_romulan_desc:
The central headquarters of the Romulan navy serves as the vital strategic brain of the Romulan Star Navy. From this central command nexus, all major fleet movements, tactical deployments, and intelligence-driven operations across the Empire are meticulously orchestrated to ensure Romulan dominance and security.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_sona_desc:
Son'a Command is the operational organisation established by the Son'a followers for their military forces they constructed after being banished from Ba'ku.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_starfleet_desc:
Essential training of new cadets and officers for service on Starfleet's vessels begins here. The command and control of Starfleet is also conducted from the highest offices.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_terran_desc:
Enlistment and loyalty testing of new cadets and officers begins here, with only the most loyal or the most ruthless surviving until graduation for service on the Imperium's vessels. The command and control of the Imperial Starfleet is also conducted from the highest offices.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_undine_desc:
When the Undine feel that their realm and their biological supremacy are under threat, they assemble a group of warriors ready to eliminate the weak.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_vulcan_desc:
The High Command is responsible for overseeing Vulcan military and civilian organisations, as well as Vulcan's space fleet, diplomatic missions, and scientific research.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_2_cardassian_desc:
As the empire expands, so do the requirements of Central Command. Large additional structure have been constructed allowing for further command and control, as well as enhanced training.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_2_desc:
The requirements for new officers and crew to man the starships increases constantly. Subspace communication technology allows for rapid dissemination of orders into the ever expanding galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_2_klingon_desc:
The Order of the Bat'leth is an exclusive Klingon group, a status awarded to warriors who had distinguished themselves in battle. The expanded facility offers even more space for celebrations, trainings and rituals.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_2_romulan_desc:
As the empire expands, so do the requirements of Romulan Navy. Large additional structure have been constructed allowing for further command and control, as well as enhanced training.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_2_starfleet_desc:
As Starfleet expands, so do the requirements for new officers and crew to man the starships. Subspace communication technology allows for rapid dissemination of orders into the ever expanding galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_3_cardassian_desc:
Large subspace arrays have been constructed on the surface, allowing for real time communications with every fleet and order. The complex is as large underground as it is above ground, where vast training facilities for new officers lie.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_3_desc:
The requirement for new crews and new officers increases exponentially. Holographic training allows for simulated scenarios to take place, whilst above, the admirals conduct business.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_3_klingon_desc:
The Order of the Bat'leth is an exclusive Klingon group, a status awarded to warriors who had distinguished themselves in battle. The complex is the place where the highest members of the council hold the most important rituals and celebrations.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_3_romulan_desc:
Large subspace arrays have been constructed on the surface, allowing for real time communications with every fleet and order. The complex is as large underground as it is above ground where vast training facilities for new officers lie.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_3_starfleet_desc:
Vast interspecies facilities exist amongst Starfleet Headquarters as the requirement for new crews and new officers increases exponentially. Holographic training allows for simulated scenarios to take place, whilst above, the admirals conduct business.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_depot_1_desc:
Maintaining a large fleet requires logistics. Stores of goods, distributed throughout the realm, are indispensable to the function of a sovereign navy.

Naval Supply Depots can only be built on Strategic Location deposits.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_neutronium_forge_desc:
The exceedingly high gravimetric conditions present near the heart of a neutron star can be replicated in a neutronium forge, enabling very rare neutronium to be manufactured.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_north_ranch_desc:
The vast steppes of the North Star colony are prime ranching grounds for wildlife.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_north_saloon_desc:
The primary social hub of the North Star colony, the saloon is the centre of town.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_nursery_1_desc:
Outfitting ground based maturation chambers with biological substations allows for genetically modifying young drones so we can ensure the drones are grown the exact requirements of the Collective.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
building_nutrient_replicator_desc:
A vast replication device capable of producing nutrients from a wide range of material.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_offworld_tsunkate_desc:
A local Tsunkatse arena brings together fighters from nearby worlds for spectacular events. Touring groups of the finest Tsunkatse fighters also visit, competing in local games and bringing a personal touch to each audience.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_omega_facility_2_desc:
Upgraded from the Polaric Ion facilities, the Omega facilities utilise omega molecules synthesised using boronite ore which could, if contained successfully, power an entire civilisation. It is however important to note that omega molecules are notoriously unstable and could potentially destroy light years of space around the point of explosion.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Power Plant.
building_omega_reactor_desc:
A powerhouse of technological prowess, harnesses the intricacies of boronite synthesis. Through intricate engineering, this reactor epitomises the fusion of matter and energy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_orbital_capital_1_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Ten budynek jest centralnym budynkiem rzadowym orbity. Obecnie sluzy jako glówna kwatera glówna samego siedliska. Pierwsze budynki bez watpienia beda dobrze prosperowac, jesli beda znajdowac sie blisko administracyjnego centrum siedliska.

Ten budynek odpowiada poziomowi 1 £ Capital Facility.
building_orbital_capital_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Bez rzadu centralnego infrastruktura i przemysl pograza sie w chaosie i dysfunkcjach. Dlatego wszystkie siedliska powinny skupiac sie przede wszystkim na stworzeniu centrum, z którego zapewnione zostanie prawo, porzadek i wydajny przemysl.

Ten budynek odpowiada poziomowi 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_orbital_capital_3_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Ustanawiajac nasza orbitalna administracje, oglaszamy reszcie galaktyki, ze nie bedziemy juz uwazani za placówke na linii frontu. Jestesmy pelnoprawnym siedliskiem, calkowicie zdolnym do wniesienia wkladu w spolecznosc galaktyczna.

Ten budynek odpowiada poziomowi 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_orbital_capital_4_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Ten kompleks orbitalny zawiera sprzet komunikacyjny i sledzacy, a takze najnowoczesniejsze systemy przechowywania pamieci, mocy obliczeniowej i wyswietlania. Struktura jest zdolna do gromadzenia, przechowywania i analizowania danych z calej planety i pobliskich cial orbitalnych, sluzac jako bardzo efektywne centrum rzadowe.

Ten budynek odpowiada poziomowi 4 £ Capital Facility§ G.
building_orbital_capital_5_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Ten kompleks orbitalny to znacznie wiecej niz siedziba rzadu. Jest symbolem naszych dokonan, dokonan, które kiedys istnialy tylko w fikcji pisanej nasza przeszloscia iw oczach naszych marzycieli. To bijace serce naszej cywilizacji, centrum, z którego rozprzestrzenia sie nasza kultura. Ten kompleks i siedlisko, na którym sie opiera, to nasz klejnot w koronie.

Ten budynek odpowiada poziomowi 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_organ_storage_facility_desc:
A storage facility for replacement organ containers, allowing for a healthy and productive population.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_organic_holding_pens_desc:
Bioworlds are inhospitable to non-fluidic life. The Organic holding pens allow captured organic life to survive within the Fluidic Realm.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_palace_1_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Ornate and magnificent, the palace is the cornerstone of righteous rule over its subjects. Entire worlds can be governed from the royal facilities.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Capital Facility.
building_paradise_dome_desc:
A fully enclosed habitation dome with a self-contained ecosystem, a veritable private paradise for those rich or fortunate enough to live there. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Housing Facility.
building_penal_capital_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Heavily armoured and secured buildings make up the headquarters on a penal colony, where prisoners and slaves can be monitored and controlled from relative safety.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_penal_capital_3_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

A fortified and self-contained complex dedicated to the security and management of the colony. The addition of dedicated power conduits and advanced surveillance technology consolidates control and makes the facility increasingly self-sufficient, a fortress within a prison.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_penal_capital_4_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The supreme command centre of the entire penal colony. Beneath a facade of sterile efficiency, the most advanced systems of control and subjugation are implemented. It is a system so complete and inescapable that its inhabitants, even the guards, are all part of the same, flawlessly managed machine.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_penal_capital_rure_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Located on an icy world, the infamous prison of Rura Penthe is widely known as 'the alien's graveyard', due to the fact that the life expectancy for a prisoner there is, at most, one year.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_penal_slave_colony_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The control of all penal facilities and workshops runs through this administration, which contains surveillance and door controls for the facility.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_penal_slave_colony_3_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Forcefield containment and manual prisoner wing lockdowns can be controlled by this large administration building. Prisoners can be processed more efficiently now.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_penal_slave_colony_4_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Individual prisoner biometrics and tracking can be accomplished at this large overseer administration building. Monitoring the health of the prisoners is vitally important to ensure maximum slave productivity.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_penal_slave_colony_5_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

A massive administration complex allows for the planetwide processing, tracking, assignment, and incarceration of vast amounts of political prisoners and undesirables.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_pergium_mine_1_desc:
Pergium is a radioactive element that is used as a source of energy, and requires properly protected mining equipment to safely remove from the surface of a world.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_pergium_power_plant_1_desc:
With the discovery of advanced Pergium refining techniques, we are now able to create power plants that utilise this powerful yet relatively safe radioactive element. Sitting atop existing deposits of Pergium, these resource-hungry stations are capable of generating more power than the more timid and conventional fusion reactors.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
building_pharma_factory_1_desc:
The vast array of medicinal herbs and plants in the area allows for large pharmaceutical facilities to be built which can process the natural medicines into more potent synthetic medicines, such as cordrazine.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_pirate_haven_desc:
Selling the goods procured by piracy is just one of the services offered at this 'freeport'. With no questions asked, and no taxes paid, this is a haven for smugglers and pirates alike.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_planetary_inhibitor_1_desc:
The power requirements to neutralise warp fields within local space are massive, and require the energy resources of an region to operate effectively. The disruptions in warp bubbles allow for enemy fleets to be pulled from warp within range of the planet, giving time for local defence forces to engage their opponents before they can escape.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_inhibitor_1_tholian_d:
The power requirements to neutralise warp fields within local space are massive, and require the energy resources of an region to operate effectively. The disruptions in warp bubbles by the projected web allow for enemy fleets to be pulled from warp within range of the planet, giving time for local defence forces to engage their opponents before they can escape.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_shield_1_desc:
This system of disguised bunkers and safehouses, connected by a network of self-powered transporters, allows for rapid redeployment of troops and advanced guerilla tactics.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_shield_2_desc:
Using a combination of low-orbit military satellites, surface to air missile defenses, superior construction methods and reactive armor plating to existing military installations, this integrated system hardens all planetary infrastructure against space-borne bombardments and attacks.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_shield_3_desc:
Planetary Shields, a technology that was previously impractical due to energy concerns, are now a feasible reality thanks to advances in power production and predictive virtual intelligence (VI). Numerous surface generators act as 'focus points' for the protective web that envelops the planet, while a sophisticated VI allocates power to the generators that require it most quickly, based on incoming fire. In theory, this system can only be overcome by an orbital bombardment involving a fleet of enormous proportions.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_shield_4_desc:
We have now managed to combine our planetary shield with a cloaking device to offer, not only protection, but also camouflage. The protection of the planetary field makes targeting the surface almost impossible.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_polaric_ion_1_desc:
A highly-volatile form of energy based on polaric ion particles. Although polaric ions are capable of generating power on a large scale, polaric ion devices were prone to subspace chain reactions. Due to the dangers associated with this energy source, many do not like to live on planets with these stations.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
building_polaric_ion_2_desc:
Powered by the mycelial network, the tearing apart of the mycelium creates vast swathes of power. Its reactor core, a large central 'energy orb' containing mycelial spores packed together, blocks the flow of the network as to harness exotic energy. The core also gives off a massive energy signature, and its spores create powerful hyper-gravitational and magnetic fields.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Power Plant.
building_police_1_desc:
Some citizens do not share the same ideals as our leaders, and can cause unrest. The construction of a justice and policing system where these undesirables can be rounded up and detained is important.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_2_desc:
Not every criminal has to remain an undesirable forever. With additional funding allocated to training and rehabilitating these citizens we can improve the wellbeing of the entire planet. The additional funding also improves general security around the planet, with surveillance and scanning equipment being installed to prevent crimes.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_3_desc:
Advances in medical research, called psychotectics, allow for procedures that can be used to 'adjust' the psychological profile of damaged, deviant or otherwise irredeemable citizens. The psychotectic rehabilitation centre allows citizens to undergo treatments to further decrease deviant behaviour on this world.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_4_desc:
The ability to predict a crime before it occurs has long been a dream of law enforcement. The installation of psionic scanners that detect deviant behaviour across the planet will allow our police force to intercept most crimes before they even occur. The courts can then determine whether or not the citizens are guilty of a thought crime, even if it did not occur.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_hive_1_desc:
The cohesion of the Collective is important, and equilibrium depots can ensure areas with low cohesion are able to operate at full efficiency.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_hive_2_desc:
Balancing the cohesion of the Collective alongside autonomous processes can sometimes result in errant behaviour. This can be stabilised by regular equilibrium nodes, which correct errant drones quickly.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_hive_3_desc:
Large facilities with a higher volume of drones can occasionally become hives of errant behaviour, which must be corrected for the good of the Collective. These segments allow for errant drone behaviour to be captured and repaired before further damage to the Collective cohesion is done.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_hive_4_desc:
The cohesion of the Collective is important, and large equilibrium complexes are designed to ensure cohesion, and rectify any errant drones.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_power_plant_1_desc:
Fusion generators are a reliable, clean, and efficient energy source that can be found on almost every warp-capable planet in the galaxy. They provide a large amount of energy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
building_power_plant_2_desc:
The power hub is a managing station for local power stations, increasing local efficiency in connected stations and thus increasing their power output.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Power Plant.
building_power_plant_3_desc:
The planetary energy grid now spans the entire world, with transmitters and cabling extending across continents. Power plants are linked in unison allowing shortages in one area to be shored by another.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Power Plant.
building_power_plant_4_desc:
This complex utilises advanced algorithms to manage and control energy generation on all our planets, allowing our power stations to function more efficiently and thereby generate more energy.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Power Plant.
building_private_mining_consortium_desc:
A consortium of smaller mines which has banded together in the search for rare materials. Workers rights and safety issues are of secondary concern compared to profit.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_private_shipyards_desc:
The creation of smaller private vessels for usage by the civilian populace is a lucrative business for those with the knowledge to build them.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_public_relations_office_desc:
Handling public relations and the media is vitally important for marketing concerns, as well as handling any undesirable outcomes that may result from dangerous business practices.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_refitting_chain_1_desc:
Every task has an ideal piece of equipment that can be equipped to a drone in order for that task to be completed with optimal efficiency. Within the drone bays, drones can be outfitted with new body enhancements, technical implants and new programming for their new task.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_refitting_chain_2_desc:
Standardised assembly lines utilising common equipment improve the efficiency at which drones can be outfitted and deployed.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_refitting_chain_3_desc:
Predictive algorithms further improve the drone refitting bays by predicting and preempting drone utilisation across the Collective.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_religious_capital_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The holy sites are those that religions considers to be of special religious significance, and are often visited by pilgrims and by important religious personalities.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_religious_capital_3_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The holy shrines are those that religions consider to be of special religious significance, and are often visited by pilgrims or important religious figures.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_religious_capital_4_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The holy temples are those that religions consider to be of special religious significance, and are often visited by pilgrims or important religious figures.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_religious_capital_hurq_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The Hur'Q store the collective knowledge of entire biospecimens within the massive vaults on this world, with enclosed enclaves where biological specimens can be studied and harvested freely.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_religious_capital_hurq_3_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

As the vaults grow, the Hur'Q expand their collection from simple biological specimens to entire, living ecosystems. Planets are scoured for unique flora and fauna, which are then meticulously cataloged and placed within the Imperial Museum's grand biomes. Entire biospheres are contained here, their life-cycles controlled and their resources meticulously managed for the glory of the Imperium. A testament to Hur'Q dominion, it is a living collection of the galaxy's most valuable treasures.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_religious_capital_hurq_4_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

The heart of the Hur'Q's collection. This immense complex is a monument to their conquests, a vast network of interlinked biovaults, research archives, and specimen chambers. It is here that the Hur'Q keep their most prized possessions - not just specimens, but the cultural and technological artifacts of the civilizations they have plundered. A living library of a thousand dead cultures, it stands as a testament to the Hur'Q's unmatched power and insatiable hunger for the possessions of others.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_religious_capital_klingon_2_des:
Budynek Kapitolu

The Klingon monastery at Boreth is central to the Klingon faith and legend of Kahless the Unforgettable. It is promised that Kahless will return here from Sto-vo-kor.

Then Kahless pointed to a star in the sky and said, 'Look for me there, on that point of light' - the Story of the Promise

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_religious_capital_vulcan_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

A place of great peace and tranquility, where many Vulcans come to meditate and reflect on their path. However, there just might be a listening post below...

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_research_lab_1_desc:
The data node processes and stores information relevant to current events, distributing the information and allowing research to be undertaken by other nearby nodes.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_research_lab_2_desc:
The Long-Term Data Archive processes and stores information relevant to current events via sophisticated multilayered systems. It is also distributing the information and allowing research to be undertaken, in addition to providing a backup server for nearby data nodes.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_research_lab_3_desc:
The Planetary Data Storage system acts as a central database for the whole planet. It coordinates the work of the Long-Term Data Archives and ensures information is distributed smoothly across the entire planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_research_lab_4_desc:
The Interstellar Data Storage Network coordinates the work of individual Planetary Data Storages. It is the pinnacle of the data storage technology using sophisticated quantum stream-computation technology. It is able to provide data distribution to the entire population of inhabited planets, starships and starbases.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_resort_1_desc:
The outstanding natural beauty of this location is a massive draw for visitors from all over the galaxy. A resort where species can enjoy this fine attraction will allow this planet to become extremely prosperous.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_resort_capital_2_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Zapewnienie swobodnego przeplywu kuracjuszy do kurortu i zapewnienie im udanego pobytu to tylko jedna z wielu cech stolicy kurortu. Najlepsze rozrywki mozna znalezc tutaj.
building_resort_capital_3_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Zapewnienie swobodnego przeplywu kuracjuszy do kurortu i zapewnienie im udanego pobytu to tylko jedna z wielu cech stolicy kurortu. Najlepsze rozrywki mozna znalezc tutaj.
building_resort_capital_4_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Zapewnienie swobodnego przeplywu kuracjuszy do kurortu i zapewnienie im udanego pobytu to tylko jedna z wielu cech stolicy kurortu. Najlepsze rozrywki mozna znalezc tutaj.
building_resort_capital_5_desc:
Budynek Kapitolu

Zapewnienie swobodnego przeplywu kuracjuszy do kurortu i zapewnienie im udanego pobytu to tylko jedna z wielu cech stolicy kurortu. Najlepsze rozrywki mozna znalezc tutaj.
building_resort_risa_desc:
The beauty and hospitality of the Risian people is legendary and their resorts are known sector wide as a place of peace, relaxation, fun and games. Whatever they have, is yours.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_resource_karemma_desc:
The Karemma Trading Post represents a location where all empires can trade and generate wealth. Bringing in empires from across the Quadrant to trade in safety.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_resource_silo_1_desc:
A large storage facility with built in transfer pads, filled with automated warehousing robots that allow for the rapid storage and dissemination of the stored material.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_robot_assembly_plant_1_desc:
The creation of new Automated Personnel Units is a challenging and complex affair. Gathering all the resources into one area can assist with the process.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
building_robot_assembly_plant_2_desc:
A dedicated construction platform designed entirely to facilitate the assembly of new Automated Personnel Units.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Population Assembly.
building_robot_assembly_plant_3_desc:
A massive assembly plant where rapid assembly of Automated Personnel Units is underway, the only limitations being the supply of raw materials.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Population Assembly.
building_robot_assembly_plant_4_desc:
Linked raw materials, manufacturing and assembly lines dedicated to the creation of new Automated Personnel Units are all combined within the Main Assembly Complex.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Population Assembly.
building_school_1_andor_desc:
The Andorian Academy is a prestigious Andorian art school, considered by many neighbours to be the best in this section of the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_bajor_desc:
The University of Bajor is situated in Jalanda City, overlooking the site of the Jalanda Forum. Whilst other facilities exist around the planet, the foremost campus attracts Bajorans from across the globe to study scientific and religious programmes.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_banea_desc:
Combining theoretical knowledge with practical engineering works allows the Banean Engineering Institute to be renown across the quadrant for its hands-on teaching approach.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_betazed_desc:
The University of Betazed is a university on the planet Betazed that has extremely high quality programmes, especially in psychology due to the empathic nature of Betazoids, but also archaeological studies. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_cardassia_desc:
The University of Culat is located on Cardassia, in the city of Culat. The high student population attracts dissidents, but is also a training ground for Obsidian Order trainees and recruiters.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_denobulan_desc:
The Denobulan Science Academy is a university on Denobula. Its staff are responsible for coordinating Denobulan scientists wherever they might be in the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_desc:
Schooling for an entire world is now possible with curriculums designed to bring the youth up to date with the latest technologies, and to allow graduates to work on programmes to improve their fields. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_earth_desc:
The University of Cambridge is an ancient and prestigious university located in England. Throughout its history, Cambridge had been the teaching home of some of Human history's greatest scientists, including Sir Isaac Newton and Stephen Hawking.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_orion_desc:
The Orion Institute of Cosmology is a prestigious cosmology academy located on Orion, studying the structure, origins, and space-time relationships of the universe. It has exceedingly difficult entry requirements, such as students must already have one year of field experience making it a very vocation oriented school.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_rom_desc:
The Romulan Astrophysical Academy is a division of the Romulan science community under the Ministry of Science. It is the highest ranking Romulan institution of academic and scholarly pursuits within the Star Empire. The academy was formed a thousand years ago as the Imperial College of Sciences and served as the state's research as well as development facility which trained future generations of scientists.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_1_vulcan_desc:
The universe functions and exists on scientific principles. Logically, therefore, the better we wish to understand our existence, the more we should devote ourselves to the sciences. At this institute Vulcans will apply their significant mental prowess to the field of physics, engineering and social sciences.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_andor_desc:
The Academy's influence has grown, requiring a significant expansion of its campus. This larger facility allows for the study of more specialised and avant-garde art forms, attracting students from across the Andorian sector.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_bajor_desc:
The University of Bajor's reputation has grown, drawing in more of the planet's brightest minds. Expanded facilities now house a larger student body, allowing for the creation of new programs dedicated to the advanced study of Bajoran history and the practical applications of emerging scientific fields.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_banea_desc:
The Institute has expanded, allowing it to house more students and laboratories. The curriculum now includes advanced studies in memory engram technology and sub-spacial mechanics, ensuring a steady stream of highly-skilled engineers to maintain Banean society and its defense grid.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_betazed_desc:
With its reputation growing, the University has expanded its campus and faculty. New programs focus on the advanced study of interspecies communication and diplomatic theory, building on the natural Betazoid empathic ability to better understand and mediate with new species.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_cardassia_desc:
The University has expanded, and with it, the number of its students and, by extension, the level of scrutiny from the state. New programs are dedicated to the history of the Cardassian Union and advanced tactical analysis, ensuring graduates are not only intelligent but also utterly loyal to the state.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_denobulan_desc:
With its reputation growing, the Academy has expanded its operations to better coordinate the work of Denobulan scientists across the quadrant. Its curriculum now emphasises collaborative research projects and fosters a unique, interdisciplinary approach to problem-solving.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_desc:
With the advent of advanced pedagogic systems and theories, a new generation of public schools are born. A higher level of education amongst our citizens will improve our ability to make new discoveries and advance our scientific understanding.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_earth_desc:
With its reputation for excellence enduring for centuries, the University of Cambridge has expanded its campus to accommodate a larger student body. Its curriculum honors its past by offering deep dives into ancient Earth history and philosophy, while also pioneering research in exobiology and interstellar archaeology.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_orion_desc:
With its reputation now established, the Institute has become a magnet for the most ambitious minds from across Orion space. Its expanded curriculum pushes students to master the practical applications of theoretical cosmology, from plotting intricate trade routes through gravitational anomalies to predicting the movement of distant star systems.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_rom_desc:
The Academy's campus has expanded into a complex of advanced research facilities. While its public-facing curriculum focuses on cosmology and stellar cartography, its most important work happens in secure sub-levels, where promising minds are secretly tasked with developing strategic applications for new discoveries.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_2_vulcan_desc:
With its reputation growing, the Academy has expanded its operations to better coordinate the work of Vulcan scientists across the quadrant. Its curriculum now emphasises collaborative research projects and fosters a unique, interdisciplinary approach to problem-solving, all while upholding the Vulcan commitment to a shared, communal approach to discovery.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_andor_desc:
Now a fully-fledged university of the arts, the Academy's fame has spread far beyond Andorian space. It attracts promising students and established masters from several neighboring species, solidifying its reputation as a galactic hub for artistic expression.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_bajor_desc:
Now recognised as the central academic institution for the entire Bajoran people, the University has become a beacon of learning. Its research programs are internationally respected, covering a wide range of disciplines from the deep history of the Bajoran faith to cutting-edge particle physics and engineering.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_banea_desc:
Now a hub of scientific and engineering thought, the Institute's reach extends throughout Banean space. It is renowned for its intensive, demanding programs, producing a new generation of Banean engineers whose work shapes every aspect of Banean civilization.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_betazed_desc:
The University of Betazed is a world-class institution. Its sprawling campuses house departments dedicated to every field of humanistic and scientific endeavor, but with a special emphasis on fostering a new generation of empathetic leaders and compassionate scholars.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_cardassia_desc:
Now a central academic institution for the Cardassian Union, the University of Culat is a place of profound contradictions. While its scholars produce groundbreaking work in fields like xenology and engineering, the true purpose of the institution is to filter the population for those most suitable for service to the state.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_denobulan_desc:
Now a premier scientific institution, the Academy's influence is felt throughout the quadrant. Its research and development divisions are responsible for a continuous stream of new innovations and discoveries, making it a source of immense pride for the Denobulan people.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_desc:
The top minds of the planet attend this academic facility where key members of the faculty teach students and undertake research. A higher level of education amongst our citizens will improve our ability to make new discoveries and advance our scientific understanding.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_earth_desc:
The University has achieved a galaxy-wide reputation, becoming a premier institution for the training of Human and foreign scholars alike. Its sprawling campus and extensive archives are a testament to the enduring power of knowledge, and its graduates are at the forefront of scientific and cultural life.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_orion_desc:
The Institute is now the leading source of cosmological knowledge in the Orion Trade Union. Its graduates are considered invaluable assets due to their skills in navigation, strategic planning and more. Private fleets and clandestine organisations seek them out for their unparalleled ability to see through the veil of space and time.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_rom_desc:
The Academy is now a preeminent scientific institution within the Star Empire. Its graduates - not just scholars, but master tacticians and military strategists - are considered vital assets. They are sought after by the military and intelligence services for their unparalleled ability to translate theoretical knowledge into strategic advantage.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_vulcan_desc:
Now a premier scientific institution, the Academy's influence is felt throughout the quadrant. Its research and development divisions are responsible for a continuous stream of new innovations and discoveries, making it a source of immense pride for the Vulcan people.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_andor_desc:
This is less a building and more of a cultural cornerstone. The Academy's campus now spans an entire region, with a staff of renowned masters and a curriculum that covers every known art form. It is the premier artistic institution in the galaxy, a testament to the Andorian mind.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_bajor_desc:
This is no longer just a universityit is the intellectual heart of the Bajoran system. Its faculty includes the greatest minds in both theology and science, and its graduates are at the forefront of every major advancement and cultural development. It is a true testament to the strength and wisdom of the Bajoran people.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_banea_desc:
The Banean Engineering Institute is now an interstellar monument to technical excellence. Its faculty includes the greatest Banean minds, and its students pioneer advancements in fields previously thought impossible, such as advanced sensor jamming and warp field theory.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_betazed_desc:
The University of Betazed is the premier institution of its kind in the quadrant. Its faculty includes the greatest Betazoid scholars, and its advanced programs attract students from many allied species. It is a beacon of intellectual curiosity, compassionate understanding, and deep respect for history and culture.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_cardassia_desc:
This is less a university and more of an arm of the Cardassian state. Its graduates are the elite of Cardassian society, and its faculty are the architects of the Union's ideology. The institution is the ultimate tool for both fostering intellectualism and ensuring absolute loyalty.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_denobulan_desc:
The Denobulan Science Academy is a wonder of the galaxy, its reputation and influence unmatched. Its alumni are considered the greatest scientific minds in their fields, and its research has led to countless breakthroughs in medicine, technology, and pure science.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_desc:
Students from nearby worlds attend this facility, with academic leaders in every branch, teaching seminars every day. A higher level of education amongst our citizens will improve our ability to make new discoveries and advance our scientific understanding.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_earth_desc:
The University of Cambridge is now a monumental institution, its reputation for academic excellence unmatched throughout humanity. Its alumni are considered the greatest scientific minds in their fields, and its research has led to countless breakthroughs that benefit all species.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_orion_desc:
This is a monument to the Orion mind and its uncompromising ambition. The Institute's research on cosmology and spacetime anomalies is a closely guarded asset, and its curriculum produces the elite, results-oriented professionals who are indispensable to Orion commerce and clandestine operations.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_rom_desc:
This is a monument to the Romulan mind and its uncompromising ambition. The Academy's research is a closely guarded asset, and its curriculum produces the elite, results-oriented professionals who are indispensable to the continued power of the Star Empire and the Tal Shiar.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_vulcan_desc:
This is less a building and more of a galactic scientific monument. The Academy's influence is woven into the very fabric of scientific progress, and its graduates are at the forefront of every major discovery. It is the definitive voice of scientific authority in the quadrant.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_secret_1_cardassian_desc:
The Obsidian Order is the primary intelligence agency of the Cardassian Union. Almost all Cardassians live in fear of the Obsidian Order, whose constant surveillance had led to the sudden eliminations of numerous 'traitors'. It is said that The Order is so efficient, a Cardassian citizen couldn't sit down to a meal without each dish being duly noted and recorded by the Order, down to its preparation and the exact measurement of each ingredient. 'Everyone has reason to fear the Order.'

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_confederacy_desc:
The Confederacy Intelligence agency or CIA are responsible for the internal security of the Confederation with the jurisdiction to employ any means to accomplish the task.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_dominion_desc:
The Dominion Security Division are responsible for maintaining the security and protection of the Dominion and to ensure the Founders are never without the knowledge to keep the Dominion above its enemies.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_generic_desc:
It takes exceptional people to do what we do - To share glorious news of our greatness with our beloved citizens. Our reporters, newsreaders, editors and publicists ensure our citizens are given the correct information about our activities, rather than any dissident propaganda.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_romulan_desc:
The Tal Shiar is the elite intelligence agency of the Romulan Star Empire. It is a highly-respected and feared force in the Alpha and Beta Quadrants. Its purpose is guarding the security of the Empire, both from the Romulans' interstellar enemies - as well as from traitors within the Romulan population itself. The covert, often invisible presence of the Tal Shiar keeps the general populace in a constant state of paranoia. Dissent and dissatisfaction with the status quo is met with severe punishment and dissidents are often known to 'disappear'.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_starfleet: Siedziba Glównej Sluzby Wywiadowczej Gwiezdnej Floty
building_secret_1_starfleet_desc:
Starfleet Intelligence is a law enforcement and intelligence agency within Starfleet responsible for state security and citizen safety.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_terran_desc:
Imperial Intelligence, also referred to as Starfleet Intelligence or Imperial Security, is a law-enforcement and intelligence agency of the Terran Empire that is charged with matters of state security and ensuring the loyalty of citizens to the Empire. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_cardassian_desc:
With a renovated headquarters, the Obsidian Order has expanded its reach far beyond the Cardassian Union. Its agents now operate in a new capacity, monitoring and manipulating events in neighboring systems. Advanced data analysis engines allow the Order to predict and neutralize threats to Cardassian interests before they even materialize. The new HQ serves not only as a centre of intelligence but as the nerve centre for pre-emptive operations, ensuring the Order's grip on both domestic and interstellar affairs.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_generic_desc:
The Ministry of Psionic Enlightenment is the state's central organ for securing the loyalty of its populace. Within its halls, a specialized group of individuals work to identify and cultivate psionic talent, ensuring all abilities serve the greater good of the empire. Though their methods are rarely seen, their influence is undeniable, and their work ensures the collective will of the people remains in perfect harmony with the state.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_romulan_desc:
With this renovated facility, the Tal Shiar has perfected its network of spies and informants. State-of-the-art surveillance and interrogation facilities ensure that no secret, no matter how deeply buried, remains hidden from the Empire's gaze. The new headquarters is more than a building; it is a symbol of the Tal Shiar's total authority, a constant reminder that its unseen agents are everywhere, watching and listening for the slightest hint of disloyalty.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_starfleet: Zaawansowana Sztabowa Siedziba Wywiadu Gwiezdnej Floty
building_secret_2_starfleet_desc:
Starfleet Intelligence now represents a new generation of information management. This facility is dedicated to the proactive protection of Federation space and its ideals. It houses a state-of-the-art data analysis hub, where intelligence gathered from countless sources is meticulously cross-referenced to anticipate threats. Rather than merely reacting to crises, the Advanced HQ works to identify and neutralise them at their earliest stages, ensuring the continued safety and prosperity of all Federation citizens.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_terran_desc:
Time takes a toll on everything, being in the shadows doesnt exclude that from happening. While renovated it was also enhanced on several aspects, which i cant tell, otherwise it wouldnt be a secret.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_cardassian_desc:
This headquarters has been upgraded to house the Order's most effective and ruthless 'eliminators.' With a sprawling network of informants, state-of-the-art surveillance technologies, and a direct line to every major military asset, the Order is now able to act with total impunity. From this location, every move of every citizen, every military order, and every political machination is known and recorded. This new facility ensures no whisper of dissent or treason goes unpunished.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_romulan_desc:
This facility represents the pinnacle of Romulan intelligence. It is a fortress of both information and lethality, where advanced cognitive analysis and psi-scanners are used to predict the strategic moves of rivals and identify traitors before they can act. The 'Enhanced' HQ is less about gathering secrets and more about controlling the flow of information on a galactic scale, ensuring the Tal Shiar always holds the crucial advantage. Dissent is not merely punished here; it is erased from existence.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_terran_desc:
Further enhanced and bigger, its so big you can not see. Realy, its hiding in plain sight and no one knows about it. Maybe we should remove the 'Intelligence HQ' sign at the entrance.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_s31_starfleet_desc:
On the outside this building looks like any other on the planet, but within the secretive Section 31 coordinate their efforts to protect the citizens of Earth and its allies from within this building.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_slave_agony_1_desc:
Built for interrogations of slaves, these chambers are large scale agony booths - capable of stimulating the pain centre of virtually any humanoid with a synaptic scan calibrating it for each species. The booth's sensors continually shifts the stimulation from one nerve cluster to another, keeping the subject in a constant state of agony.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_slave_bazaar_desc:
Highly illegal on some worlds, the lucrative slave bazaar is large auctioneering area which allows the procurement of individuals who have been sold into indentured slavery.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_slave_camp_1_desc:
The buying and selling of slaves for usage for labour, research or pleasure has been a staple of business for centuries. With the introduction of new species and new markets, demand has spiked, allowing this facility to operate on a planetary wide scale. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_slave_processing_1_desc:
In order to ensure effective and efficient slave labour, we need to keep track of our slaves. As with any commodity, maintenance and stock control is essential, so also with this commodity. These centres will improve the output of our slave labour force.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_smuggling_rings_desc:
Laws, taxes and tariffs can be avoided by the more wily merchants who traverse the stars. If there is a demand for a product, the smugglers can fill it.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_spawning_pool_1_desc:
Grown in thick viscous goo filled with all the nutrients a growing body could need, the spawning pools are where many clones are born.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_2_desc:
Tubes filled with the growing clones are kept here, suspended in a thick viscous gloop that contains all the nutrients and minerals a growing clone needs. Attached biomonitors can be closely monitored to ensure optimum growth.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_3_desc:
The process of growing clones within vast rows of tubes has been automated somewhat, with the automatic release of nutrients, growth hormones or poison dependent on the central monitoring stations situated within the complex. 

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_4_desc:
This vast cloning facility has rows upon rows of specimens growing within large cylindrical tubes filled with a whitish grey gloop. The process is fully automated with monitoring software responsible for the growth, birthing and recycling of subjects.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Population Assembly.
building_starport_1_desc:
Not much more than a clearing and some basic facilities for civilian freighters and trading ships, the basic trading centre is meant to make way to a range of specialised commercial buildings.

Trading Centres allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_2_desc:
A nexus for intra-system and interstellar civilian freighters, starports are a major hub of commerce. Most financial institutions and commodity exchanges keep at least a nominal presence in this giant facility, if not their main planetary headquarters.

Starports allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_3_desc:
An enormous trading hub for interstellar civilian freighters and traders. Most interstellar financial institutions and commodity exchanges have a large presence here, if not their main planetary headquarters.

Commercial Hubs allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported good. The imported goods on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_4_desc:
The headquarters of many interstellar commerce organisations, this starport is an immense trading port designed as a hub to service nearby worlds.

Commercial Nexus allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_stone_of_memory_desc:
Recordings of memories from deep within the rock are stored here, etched deep within the stonework.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_supercomputer_1_desc:
The sophisticated master computer on the planet Bynaus is with which virtually all Bynar are interconnected. It is an integral part of Bynar society, influencing their language and even their thought patterns.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_tholian_hub_1_desc:
The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. Being in proximity to a lattice node brings a sense of calm and unity to the population.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_2_desc:
The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. Being in proximity to where numerous lattice nodes converge brings a sense of calm and unity to the population.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_3_desc:
The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. The confluence of large sections of the lattice here exude massive amounts of calm and unity across the surface of the world.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_4_desc:
The central nexus of the lattice, where all points meet in a large hub, is a powerful area where Tholians meet to experience the calm and unity that the lattice brings.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
