required_tactical_rom_marines_DESC: A unit of Reman Infiltrators ready to board another ship and disrupt its operation.
required_tactical_sagan_DESC: Years of studying engagements and debris left over from attacks by the Borg have allowed us to create a number of enhancements that improve our ships abilities.
required_tactical_science_DESC:
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is scientific in nature and will provide our ships with increased evasion, tracking and targeting. 

This console, allows this fleet to complete the Assist Planetary Research fleet action.
required_tactical_scimitar_shield_3_DESC: The dual shield generators of the Scimitar provide powerful overlapping defensive fields.
required_tactical_scout_sensors_DESC: Scout Class Vessels can be equipped with focused long range sensors that can track ship movements and combined with the Scouts speed allow for reconnaissance missions.
required_tactical_shangri_la_DESC: Specifically designed impulse-boosting thrusters that provide an additional thrust when maneuvering at high impulse speeds.
required_tactical_snakehead_DESC: A holographic cloaking projectorwhich could be reversed to project a false decoy image of the ship.
required_tactical_space_station_1_DESC: Specially installed modules designed to focus the starbase on a tactical output.
required_tactical_space_station_2_DESC: Specially installed modules designed to focus the starbase on a engineering output.
required_tactical_space_station_3_DESC: Specially installed modules designed to focus the starbase on a science output.
required_tactical_spitfire_DESC: The Temporal Spitfire uses closed temporal loop technology to shunt weapons energy into temporal phase, resulting in a large increase to the rate of fire.
required_tactical_structural_DESC: The integration of a central structural integrity field supplements the supports and bulkheads of a spaceship's shape.
required_tactical_tactical_DESC:
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is tactical in nature and will allow our crew to safely divert energy to increase the maximum damage of our weapons systems. 

This console, allows this fleet to complete the Assist Planetary Governance fleet action.
required_tactical_tracking_DESC: An exographic targeting sensor is a sensor capable of visually penetrating almost any surface allowing its users to literally see through hulls, walls or barriers. Its range can be adjusted to allow the user to see up to only a certain point.
required_tactical_typhon_DESC: Once the Typhon deploys its array of fighters, it is able to deploy additional ablative armour and retract core systems to provide better protection at the cost of maneuverability.
required_tactical_walker_DESC: Armoured panels break away from the hull of the vessel in the event of escape pod launch.

utility_aux_backup_1_DESC: Supplementary air, water and power. Without these, death in space is easily achieved.
utility_aux_backup_2_DESC: A redundant life support system can be built into the vessel in order to increase survivability when heavily damaged.
utility_aux_backup_3_DESC: Triple redundant life support systems offer increased survivability to the crew of a stricken vessel.
utility_aux_backup_4_DESC: In the event of total crew loss or incapacitation, the emergency command system can activate and take over the running of the vessel, ensuring optimum chance of survival or retrieval.
utility_aux_borg_alcove_1_DESC: Cortical processing subunits produce too much information for a drone to assimilate while active, so it must be uploaded while the drone regenerates. These alcoves have been enhanced with uplinks to the local cortical processing subunit to facilitate this, improving each drones operational efficiency.
utility_aux_borg_alcove_2_DESC: Alcoves concentrated into high capacity clusters, instead of distributed around the vessel. Better access, and higher energy power connections combine to reduce the time that drones spend away from performing useful tasks.
utility_aux_borg_alcove_3_DESC: These alcoves work together with an induction charging system. Nanoprobes form a thin mobile charging pad which follows individual drones around the vessel. These pads supply the drones with a small amounts supply of power, decreasing the frequency with which they must regenerate.
utility_aux_borg_alcove_4_DESC: While minor improvements have been made to the armour of each drone, most of the improvements have been applied to these alcoves. Force field emitters protect drones while regenerating, preventing further injury and delay in returning to performing useful functions.
utility_aux_bulkhead_1_DESC: Additional bulkheads situated throughout the vessel will provide a boost to structural integrity and hull points.
utility_aux_cargo_1_DESC: Standardised cargo container for space operations, modeled on planetside freight containerisation.
utility_aux_cargo_2_DESC:
The cargo bay allows for the free loading and storage of numerous goods, and can be secured against intrusion. 

Cargo Bays: Allows the ship to partake in the deliver supplies fleet action.
utility_aux_cargo_3_DESC: Temperature controlled environments and force fields can secure volatile and fragile cargos together without disrupting the workflow of the bay.
utility_aux_command_1_DESC: A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is related to command and control in nature and will allow our crew to safely optimise control of the vessel from this point.
utility_aux_command_2_DESC: Additional command stations on the bridge offer improved command support to the vessel.
utility_aux_command_3_DESC: When the bridge is knocked out, the secondary bridge can take over. It can be manned during normal operation too, to relieve the pressure on the main bridge.
utility_aux_command_4_DESC: The holographic command station can be accessed across the vessel providing full command and control over the local area.
utility_aux_crew_1_DESC: Simple stacked crew pods, with limited shared facilities.
utility_aux_crew_2_DESC: Common crew bunks, usually stacked four to a room. Facilities are shared by each bunkroom.
utility_aux_crew_3_DESC: Small private rooms with senior staff having access to their own sonic shower and eating facilities.
utility_aux_crew_4_DESC: Larger rooms for crew members, with their own lounge, bed and eating facilities. Married quarters are available for families.
utility_aux_emitter_1_DESC: We have come up with a utility device, that generates large field of gravitons for sustained periods of time. These new emitters will increase the regeneration process of our shields.
utility_aux_emitter_2_DESC: Through recent advances in graviton emitters our effectiveness of regenerating our shields via our shield emitters have increased.
utility_aux_emitter_3_DESC: By reducing the discharge rate of our shield capacitors we believe we can make our shield emitters re-energise faster, thus increasing the rate in which our shields will regenerate.
utility_aux_emitter_4_DESC: Recent capacitor advances have enabled the installation of nano-shield capacitors which can discharge and rapidly restore our shields.
utility_aux_operation_1_DESC: With the continued use of combat oriented workstations we have studied what our operations officers find useful and what they find distracting. As a result our computer scientists have come up with a more streamlined interface to this workstation, that better suits the needs onboard ship.
utility_aux_operation_2_DESC: An updated dual officer work station with enhanced sensors that can be installed on a ship's bridge which will let us better track the movements of enemy vessels.
utility_aux_operation_3_DESC: The installation of a Master Situation Monitor to the workstation allows more coordination over enemy vessel movements.
utility_aux_operation_4_DESC: We are able to create a new supplement to our operations station, that allows us to add information directly into the line of sight of the operations team officer, enabling full 360 degree view of the ship. This drastically increases the officer's ability to track ship status at the station.
utility_aux_repair_1_DESC: A manned centralised station where damage control teams can be organised and dispatched from, routing them to the most severely damaged and important systems and improving the repair rate of the vessel.
utility_aux_repair_2_DESC: Prioritisation, via the Master Situation Monitor, allows for repair teams to be automatically dispatched to the nearest damaged high priority sectors, improving the efficiency of vessel repairs.
utility_aux_repair_3_DESC: A full holographic display detailing the damaged sections of the vessel and automatically dispatching repair teams, whilst replicating damaged components that require repair, further improving the efficiency of vessel repairs.
utility_aux_tellarite_1_DESC: Strong forcefield technology ensures the integrity of Tellarite vessels when arguments break out.
utility_aux_vulcan_1_DESC: Gravimetric logic banks cross check and discard illogical data sets allowing for improved sensor output.
utility_large_afterburner_1_DESC: An archaic engine design, retooled to act as a supplement to the main engine. A high energy density, solid-state fuel source is burnt at a high temperature, producing a hot gas. Under pressure, the gas is vented out of a nozzle facing the rear of the ship. The expansion of the gas as it leaves the ship provides us with some forward thrust.
utility_large_afterburner_2_DESC: A modernised chemical fuel afterburner which uses a powerful new liquid fuel, Gronerium. The Gronerium's storage tanks are subjected to a gravitational gradient, ensuring that the fuel is always at the intake end of the tank. In the event that the graviton field is shut down, a solid fuel pod located above the tank can be ignited, pushing a plate down onto the Gronerium, forcing it into the intake valve.
utility_large_afterburner_3_DESC: An off-shot of inertial dampener technology, impulse afterburners store the inertial forces of accelerating and decelerating, instead of dissipating them. The stored force can be converted into a form of thrust, giving the ship a speed boost.
utility_large_afterburner_4_DESC: The third version of the Fusion Intermix Booster afterburner, first version that doesn't explode after a short time. Uses a fusion reactor to produce high energy plasma, similar to an old impulse engine. Shortly before the plasma is expelled, it's infused with a small amount of antimatter. The antimatter annihilation raises the temperature to 47keV, providing significant supplementary thrust.
utility_large_borg_tracking_1_DESC: The central plexus links each Borg vessel to every other Borg vessel. This facilitates the fast and efficient transfer of the Collective's knowledge, and real time tactical data. It also allows each vessel's computer to offload processing tasks to other vessels during times of high demand.
utility_large_borg_tracking_2_DESC: Updated computer cores which are able to interface with all nanoprobes present on the vessel. The nanoprobes take over performing simple calculations, allowing the computer core's advanced processing units to handle difficult computations.
utility_large_borg_tracking_3_DESC: More advanced calculations are now performed by the interlink node, which interfaces with all nanites and nanoprobes on the vessel.
utility_large_borg_tracking_4_DESC: A central interlink node is similar to a central processing node on the Unimatrix. It is capable of vast amounts of processing and calculations, as well as handling more complex subroutines.
utility_large_casino_1_DESC:
High rollers from many worlds enjoy visits to these luxurious mobile casinos that traverse the stars, away from any prying eyes.

Mobile Casinos produce a small amount of £ latinum; and remember: the House always wins.
utility_large_damper_1_DESC: Basic anti-gravity technology used to counteract the effects of high-velocity spaceflight.
utility_large_damper_2_DESC: Distributed anti-gravity and ballast systems, that enable the free movement and support of crew and materials.
utility_large_damper_3_DESC: Powered by the Higgs Field itself, this inertial damper ensures the ship is protected by the effects of super luminal spaceflight.
utility_large_damper_4_DESC: Trans-luminal space flight affecting the space-time continuum can now be adjusted via chroniton based temporal adjustment dampers.
utility_large_deflector_1_DESC: A secondary navigational deflector is added to the main hull, allowing additional protection from navigational hazards and debris.
utility_large_deflector_2_DESC: The power of the secondary navigational deflector is enhanced by faster than light tachyons which allows more power to flow through.
utility_large_deflector_3_DESC: The subspace barriers can be pushed to one side by an interplexing navigational deflector, allowing smooth transit at high speeds.
utility_large_lab_engineering_1_DESC:
This specialised laboratory is equipped with advanced sensor arrays and adaptable processing cores, which allow for immediate, on-site analysis of anomalies and rapid prototyping of technological breakthroughs.

Technology Lab modules produce £ $concept_engineering_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_lab_engineering_2_DESC:
This upgraded laboratory features hyper-tuned optical arrays and adaptive quantum processors. It's designed to not just analyse, but to synthesise new insights from raw data, boosting research efficiency.

Technology Lab modules produce £ $concept_engineering_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_lab_engineering_3_DESC:
This technology lab integrates bleeding-edge multi-spectral arrays and sentient analytical processors, capable of not just observing, but actively interacting with and manipulating reality on a sub-quantum level.

Technology Lab modules produce £ $concept_engineering_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_lab_physics_1_DESC:
An additional onboard physics laboratory, outfitted with detectors for charged particles, phase discriminators, pulse height analysers, and spectral analysis.

Physics Lab modules produce £ $concept_physics_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_lab_physics_2_DESC:
An onboard physics scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse space-time on a galactic scale.

Physics Lab modules produce £ $concept_physics_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_lab_physics_3_DESC:
An onboard physics scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse space-time on a galactic scale.

Physics Lab modules produce £ $concept_physics_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_lab_society_1_DESC:
An additional onboard biology laboratory, outfitted with detectors for DNA, lifeforms, pulse height analysers, and biogenic analysis.

Biology Lab modules produce £ $concept_society_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_lab_society_2_DESC:
An onboard biological scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse real-time retroviral DNA on a large scale.

Biology Lab modules produce £ $concept_society_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_lab_society_3_DESC:
An onboard biological scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse real-time retroviral DNA on a large scale.

Biology Lab modules produce £ $concept_society_research$ for your empire.
utility_large_labs_1_DESC:
An additional basic mobile science lab, designed to deal with a variety of spatial phenomena encountered in deep space.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
utility_large_labs_2_DESC:
Scientific facility with added nuclear research capabilities, including detectors for charged particles, phase discriminators, pulse height analysers and spectral analysis.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
utility_large_labs_3_DESC:
Scientific facility with a focus on charting stars and planets. Real time sensor arrays provide detail on nearby stars, planets, nebulae, and other stellar bodies, allowing ships to investigate anomalies with increased success.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
utility_large_labs_4_DESC:
Scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse space-time on a galactic scale. Large holographic displays can render entire sectors in real time.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
utility_large_science_station_1_DESC: Our advancements in sensor technology have given us the ability to create a new workstation for our science officers. This will provide us with the data to better evade enemy ships, but also help track an enemy ship's movement and, most importantly, improve the sensor locking for our weapons on enemy ships.
utility_large_science_station_2_DESC: A state-of-the-art science centre with holographic technology allows a 360 degree field of view, and the passing of important information to bridge stations almost instantaneously.
utility_large_stealth_hull_1_DESC: By introducing darker materials within the external layers of a ship's hull we can make our ship's harder to track by enemy sensors.
utility_large_stealth_hull_2_DESC: While this material is more refractive than most it has been engineered to refract active sensor beams, thus reducing the amount it returns to sensors. While this will lead to further increase in our evasion it comes at a further cost of our molecular structure of the ship's hull.
utility_large_stealth_hull_3_DESC: By masking adaptive circuitry into our ship's hull it will increase our evasion of enemy sensors at a level we haven't seen before, however, due the sophisticated nature of the technology used in this material it will come at an even greater cost of our ship's molecular structure.
utility_large_tracking_1_DESC: By utilising the intrinsic spin of the electron, this solid state computer core can be dedicated to targeting solutions, increasing its accuracy.
utility_large_tracking_2_DESC: By erecting a system of ODN relays across the ship, it is possible to connect this remote secondary computer core to the main mainframe with almost zero loss due to lag and with a significantly increased computational power. This greatly benefits the ship during combat, increasing its accuracy.
utility_large_tracking_3_DESC: By linking numerous multitronic cores together in the computer core, this core can take over tasks that would otherwise be too demanding on the mainframe. This greatly benefits the ship during high load events, such as combat.
utility_large_tracking_4_DESC: With advances in positronics, attaching this secondary core to the mainframe gives a hint of self awareness and consciousness to the core. Prioritisation of tasks can be done automatically, vastly increasing the effectiveness of the ship during crisis events such as combat.
utility_large_tracking_5_DESC: Cetacean Ops was a facility aboard Starfleet starships in the late 24th century. They generally contained an aquarium, so as to simulate the natural habitat of cetaceans allowing them to work on navigation and sensor operations.
utility_large_undine_tracking_1_DESC: The Telepathic Tracing Node tracks psionic echoes across fluidic space. Engineered by the Undine to monitor intrusions and rogue minds, it amplifies collective telepathic awareness, reinforcing unity while enforcing purity against mental corruption or alien influence.
utility_large_undine_tracking_2_DESC: Enhanced by quantum-biopsionic arrays, this upgraded Undine device extends psi-range across dimensions. It isolates corrupted consciousness, decodes alien thought signatures, and deepens unity within the collective mind—ensuring absolute psychic vigilance across fluidic and infiltrated galactic zones.
utility_large_undine_tracking_3_DESC: Forged with tri-phase neurogenic cores, this node penetrates multi-temporal consciousness. It safeguards fluidic space by predicting telepathic incursions, enforcing Undine mental cohesion, and erasing foreign influences before they destabilize the Collective’s psychic harmony across dimensional frontiers.
utility_medium_borg_eps_1_DESC: High energy plasma is safely routed from the warp reactor to the drive engines.
utility_medium_borg_eps_2_DESC: Warp reactor plasma is additionally distributed throughout the ship as a direct energy supply.
utility_medium_borg_eps_3_DESC: The warp reactor and impulse drive systems are looped together. This provides an additional source of plasma energy for systems use.
utility_medium_borg_eps_4_DESC: With the EPS matrix linked to every system tying them directly in to warp power, systems around the ship gain additional power.
utility_medium_borg_eps_5_DESC: With the EPS relay infused with warp plasma, systems around the ship gain additional power.
utility_medium_disruptor_1_DESC: The sonic disruptor field vibrates the molecules within an enemy vessels armour, allowing for improved damage.
utility_medium_disruptor_2_DESC: The molecular disruption field can further destabilize the armoured layers around a starship, further increasing damage.
utility_medium_disruptor_3_DESC: Breaking the atomic bonds within a starships armour allows for increased damage.
utility_medium_disruptor_4_DESC: Tearing apart a starship at the subatomic level drastically reduces the effectiveness of enemy armour.
utility_medium_eps_1_DESC: High energy plasma is safely routed from the warp reactor to the drive engines.
utility_medium_eps_2_DESC: Warp reactor plasma is additionally distributed throughout the ship as a direct energy supply.
utility_medium_eps_3_DESC: The warp reactor and impulse drive systems are looped together. This provides an additional source of plasma energy for systems use.
utility_medium_eps_4_DESC: With the EPS matrix linked to every system tying them directly in to warp power, systems around the ship gain additional power.
utility_medium_eps_5_DESC: With the EPS relay infused with warp plasma, systems around the ship gain additional power.
utility_medium_plasmadyne_1_DESC: A secondary plasmadyne relay disperses the plasma of the blast across a large area, draining enemy shields.
utility_medium_plasmadyne_2_DESC: By amping up the plasmadyne relay we can ensure that the blasts spread across enemy shielding, draining them substantially.
utility_medium_plasmadyne_3_DESC: Utilising quantum tunneling, our weapons can penetrate and spread across the numerous layers of shielding of an enemy vessel.
utility_medium_plasmadyne_4_DESC: By spreading the damage over numerous polarities we can amplify the blast damage to enemy shields.
utility_medium_scatter_1_DESC: Spreading the damage over a large area of hull can cause massive hull breaches on enemy vessels.
utility_medium_scatter_2_DESC: Spreading the damage over a large area of hull can cause massive hull breaches on enemy vessels.
utility_medium_scatter_3_DESC: Spreading the damage over a large area of hull can cause massive hull breaches on enemy vessels.
utility_medium_scatter_4_DESC: Spreading the damage over a large area of hull can cause massive hull breaches on enemy vessels.
utility_medium_tactical_station_1_DESC: With the continued use of combat oriented workstations we have studied what our tactical officers find useful and what they find distracting. As a result our computer scientists have come up with a more streamlined interface to this workstation, that better suits a tactical officers need in the heat of combat.
utility_medium_tactical_station_2_DESC: A secondary tactical node allows for secondary tasks such as command and control, or tactical system scanning to be achieved without reducing the effectiveness of the primary consoles.
utility_medium_tactical_station_3_DESC: Laying out the bridge to ensure a rapid free flow of information on all tactical stations improves combat effectiveness of a vessel drastically.
utility_reactor_1_DESC: Basic nuclear power. Control rods moderate a Uranium pile to generate nuclear energy.
utility_reactor_2_DESC: Experimentation with magnetic coils and lasers has yielded the ability to reproduce the energy process found within stars.
utility_reactor_3_DESC: Helium-4 nuclear fusion reactor with a carbon-oxygen byproduct.
utility_reactor_4_DESC: Improvements in magnetic containment and laser ignition have resulted in better fusion reactions.
utility_reactor_5_DESC: Miniaturised fusion reactors are assembled together to provide maximum fuel economy, part redundancy and increased power output.
utility_reactor_6_DESC: Carefully shielded device that harnesses thermionic radiation.
utility_reactor_7_DESC: A miniature space-time rift is used to create a radiation source. Hardware adapted from thermionic and fission control systems is used to absorb this radiation for generating power.
utility_reactor_8_DESC: Utilising the rare but powerful refined Decalithium crystal residue to generate high levels of power.
utility_reactor_9_DESC: A temporal core, which kept the vessel out of phase with normal spacetime, thereby protecting it from the changes to the timeline which it initiated.
utility_reactor_pergium_DESC: Pergium is blended with other radioactive compounds to create an enhanced fission reactor. It's not as clean as fusion, but it increases the availability of radioactive fuel sources in general.
utility_reactor_solar_DESC: A unique design created by the Kessok, absorbing the energy from nearby stars and converting it into a huge amount of energy.
utility_reactor_thalaron_DESC: A thalaron reactor is a device designed to harness thalaron radiation safely in order to produce large amounts of power. If not kept stable, it can emit a cascading biogenic pulse with which to destroy all organic matter.
utility_reactor_undine_1_DESC: Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production.
utility_reactor_undine_2_DESC: Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production. This energy is then amplified using the psychic power of the Undine mind.
utility_reactor_undine_3_DESC: Specially mixed concentrations of fluidic matter and bio-matter generates powerful waves of energy that can be used to power Undine Technology.
utility_reactor_undine_fluidic_DESC: Mass detonation of biomass is harnest by the powerful minds of Undine engineers and directed towards powering their most powerful vessels.
utility_reactor_undine_pk_DESC: Mass detonation of biomass is harnest by the powerful minds of Undine engineers and directed towards powering their most powerful vessels.
utility_reactor_xindi_kemocite_DESC: The Arboreals produce the finest variaty of Kemocite in the Delphic Expanse and this Kemocite fuels the Weapon and the craft that houses it.
utility_small_armor_1_DESC: Adding external layers of support to the hull greatly reinforces its durability.
utility_small_armor_2_DESC: Standardised armour designs allow rapid modifications to the armour level of a vessel.
utility_small_armor_3_DESC: Trellium plating is used to line the hull, providing increased protection from the dangers of space.
utility_small_armor_4_DESC: Heavier trellium plating secures the hull, providing substantial protection from the dangers of deep space.
utility_small_armor_5_DESC: An armor designed to disintegrate at a controlled rate under directed energy blasts, providing an additional layer of defense for a spaceship's hull.
utility_small_armor_6_DESC: By having a type of material that's reflective, we gain the ability to absorb energy. We can put this type of material to use within our armour plating design branches, offering even more protection against weapon fire at a spaceship's hull.
utility_small_auto_facility_1_DESC: Advances in AI and automation processes combined with the advanced operations of a starship allow for increased efficiency across the ship.
utility_small_borg_armor_1_DESC: Additional layers of living metal hull plating positioned under the primary hull. While these layers are no more durable than the primary layer, they prevent weapons from penetrating as far into the vessel as they otherwise would.
utility_small_borg_armor_2_DESC: Living armour which has been upgraded with the ability to change its composition during combat. This allows it to dynamically adapt to the weapons that it's protecting against.
utility_small_borg_armor_3_DESC: Several layers of parametallic plating form a durable barrier to protect the vessel's hull. Autonomous regeneration nodes repair the armour during battle.
utility_small_borg_armor_4_DESC: Advanced regenerative armour generated by a network of self replicating, autonomous regeneration units.
utility_small_borg_armor_5_DESC: Superior regenerative armour generated by a network of self replicating, autonomous regeneration units. Capable of regenerating after being completely destroyed, it provides massive protection against most forms of weaponry.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_1_DESC: Force fields that adapt to the damage onboard a Borg vessel, sealing off damaged areas.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_2_DESC: The integrity field that can snap into place and ensure that the vessel can hold together under massive stress even when it's materials are failing.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_3_DESC: Updated structural integrity field subsystem. New adaptation algorithms control a modular and highly reconfigurable field generator network. This network reinforces damaged sections, holding the vessel together longer.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_4_DESC: An adaptive structural integrity field subsystem which utilises a layered field network. This configuration provides stronger reinforcement to damage sections, further increasing the vessels operational parameters.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_5_DESC: An adaptive structural integrity field subsystem which utilises a layered field network. This configuration provides stronger reinforcement to damage sections, further increasing the vessels operational parameters.
utility_small_borg_starbase_generator_1_: A simple subspace field envelops the station, providing a measure of protection from weaponry.
utility_small_chapel_1_DESC:
The floating chapels allow for religious ceremonies to be carried out amongst the crew, improving the overall feeling of unity amongst the stars.

Vessels that have this module equipped will occasionally generate a small amount of £ unity as they traverse the galaxy.
utility_small_engineering_station_1_DESC: Although most engineering functions are controlled from the engine room, engineering stations on the bridge of starships enable monitoring and control by the chief engineer
utility_small_engineering_station_2_DESC: Engineering station that provides real time performance and metrics of all ships systems and the touch of a button.
utility_small_engineering_station_3_DESC: A perfected engineering station that allows engineers complete control of a ships functions whilst being in the thick of the action without needing to be in engineering.
utility_small_engineering_station_4_DESC: A large holographic display allows for 360 degree control over all items at this workstation.
utility_small_forcefield_1_DESC: In the event of an outer hull breach, emergency force fields are automatically deployed to protect the damaged area from the influences of space. The force fields work in conjunction with existing, physical bulkheads, greatly increasing the resilience of the spaceship. Force fields especially benefit larger ships - the bigger the hull, the larger the effect.
utility_small_forcefield_2_DESC: Improved force fields that can snap into place around any breach or person to secure them briefly against the vast darkness of empty space.
utility_small_forcefield_3_DESC: Our engineers were able to improve upon our force field technology so that it supports the bulkheads of a spaceship's shape. By doing this, our spaceship's will be even more capable of enduring the harsh elements and forces of interstellar travel.
utility_small_forcefield_4_DESC: Our engineers were able to use a structural integrity force field, that supplements the supports and bulkheads of a spaceship's shape. By doing this, our spaceship's will be even more capable of enduring the harsh elements and forces of interstellar travel.
utility_small_forcefield_5_DESC: Advanced force field generators and dispersion arrays added to our structural integrity field make spaceships even more capable of enduring the extreme elements and forces of interstellar travel.
utility_small_forcefield_6_DESC: An ever shifting structural integrity field that can be adjusted to provide additional reinforcement to sections under undue stress.
utility_small_forcefield_7_DESC: A shielding forcefield that is fluxating in time creating a powerful field against conventional weapons.
utility_small_generator_1_DESC: Besides shield emitters we can also find another use for the process of storing a large field of gravitons. This gives us the ability to create a utility device that increases the strength of our shields.
utility_small_generator_2_DESC: By surrounding a ship in multiple graviton layers we can upgrade our current field generators to be modulated against specific frequency ranges of particle beams and radiation.
utility_small_generator_3_DESC: By carefully modulating the phase of the gravitons emitted, the multiple layers of older field generators have been compressed into a single layer providing an immediate boost to our shields.
utility_small_generator_4_DESC: By modulating the hyper phasic fields nearby, the layers of shielding around our ship can be increased providing a boost to the strength of our shields.
utility_small_generator_5_DESC: Chromodynamic shields use gravitons which can be modulated to be more effective against a greater spectrum of radiation.
utility_small_hard_1_DESC: By creating a force field inside our ship we are able to seal hull breaches and absorb structural stress from incoming fire and in doing so it increases the durability of our ship's hull.
utility_small_hard_2_DESC: Introducing new changes to our shield emitters has caused our force fields to have reduced response times in reinforcing a ship's hull.
utility_small_hard_3_DESC: By introducing multiple configurations to our force fields we are able to better adapt to the incoming damage that the ship's hull would be taking on.
utility_small_hard_4_DESC: By studying the effects of how our shield emitters convert minor feedback into the matrix we were able to observe how this mechanical energy was absorbed into a ship's hull. In doing, we believe we have come up with improvements to our force field technology that further reinforce the armor of a ship's hull.
utility_small_hard_5_DESC: By utilising spatial shield refractors we are able to observe how energy and impacts affect the hull, which further reinforces hull integrity.
utility_small_prison_1_DESC:
An orbital prison acts as a floating brig, where punishments can be meted out and the crew returned to service, once the sentence is complete.

Vessels that have this module equipped will occasionally generate a small amount of £ crew as they traverse the galaxy.
utility_small_prospecting_1_DESC:
A prospecting bay allows for the processing of any small rare asteroids that the construction vessel may come across, refining it into minerals.

Construction ships that have this module equipped will occasionally generate a small amount of £ minerals as they traverse the galaxy.
utility_small_starbase_generator_1_DESC: A large shield generator designed to cover the large large surface area of a starbase.
utility_small_starbase_generator_2_DESC: An improved shield generator designed for starbases, which a constantly rotating frequency which increases energy requirements but also substantially increases protection.
utility_small_undine_armor_1_DESC: This plating is a form of biomechanical armor, cultivated in specialised Undine maturation facilities. It actively adapts to incoming threats in real time and seamlessly integrates with the ship's systems. This plating resists diverse attack vectors and deploys countermeasures, significantly boosting the vessel's resilience.
utility_small_undine_armor_2_DESC: This hull is designed to constantly recalibrate its molecular structure in order to counter energy and kinetic threats. Drawing on the Undine Hivemind, it develops resistances during combat, integrates seamlessly with the ship's control systems and maintains the vessel's operational effectiveness in fluctuating tactical and environmental conditions.
utility_small_undine_armor_3_DESC: We have developed a sophisticated form of bio-adaptive hull plating that stores and recalls defensive configurations. Every time the armour is exposed to a new attack, it analyses the threat, records its properties and instantly adapts its molecular structure to counter it. This learned resistance is then integrated into the Undine Hivemind, enabling other vessels to instantly access and utilise optimal defensive patterns.
utility_small_undine_armor_4_DESC: A learning armour is an advanced, evolving hull system. It processes tactical data in real time, observing and analysing every incoming threat. It doesn't just adapt, it proactively learns the unique properties and vectors of attacks. This knowledge is applied immediately, recalibrating the armour's composition and energy absorption properties in real time.
utility_small_undine_armor_5_DESC: This highly responsive hull system operates with a heightened sense of its environment. It doesn't just react to impacts; it anticipates them. By constantly processing subtle shifts in energy signatures, localised gravimetric distortions and even minute changes in the immediate tactical field, the armour pre-emptively adjusts its defensive properties. This enables it to recalibrate its molecular structure and energy dampening fields almost instantly before a direct hit.
utility_small_undine_regen_1_DESC: Equipping our ships with adaptive regeneration technology, which innates the restorative power of our unique physiology, we enable them to rapidly repair and reinforce their defences.
utility_small_undine_regen_2_DESC: By harnessing our innate regenerative abilities, ships can rapidly restore damaged systems and crew efficiency, minimising downtime during intense battles or extended missions.
utility_small_undine_regen_3_DESC: Through superior biomatter manipulation, we achieve accelerated healing of critical wounds to our ships, enhancing the overall effectiveness and longevity of our fleet, even in the face of overwhelming adversity.
utility_temporal_lab_DESC: Temporal research lab that helps us identify anomalies in the timeline.
utility_undine_tactical_1_DESC: Our ships are impervious to the unclean.
utility_undine_tactical_2_DESC: Our ships are impervious to the unclean.
utility_undine_tactical_3_DESC: Our ships are impervious to the unclean.

TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BATTLESHIP_BIO_SHIELD_D:
Psychic Enhancement 
Our minds are strong, uniting our minds creates a reinforced defensive shield around our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_1_DESC:
Adaptive Subspace Field 
The subspace field surrounding the Collective's vessels can be changed to improve performance.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_2_DESC:
Self-Adapting Subspace Force Field 
Self-adapting algorithms automatically adjust the subspace force field around our vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Self-Adapting Subspace Force Field
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_3_DESC:
Adaptive Structural Integrity Field 
Adjusting the structural integrity field allows increased performance in highly stressed areas of the vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Adaptive Structural Integrity Field
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_4_DESC:

TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Self-Adapting Lower Subspace Field
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_CRUISER_BIO_DAMAGE_DESC:
Mind Merge Field 
The merging of Undine warrior minds creates a damaging aura harming the crews of any ships opposing the Undine.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_1_DESC:
Breen Energy Dissipator 
A new component that is solely available to the Breen. They discovered, by calculating a new set of modulated beam frequencies when their battleships fire their weapon, it can actually decrease the rate of fire it takes for an enemy ship to fire back at them.

Breen unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_2_DESC:
Enhanced Energy Dissipator II 
Enhancements to the energy dissipator enable more weapon energy to be drained from the enemy, thus further reducing their rate of fire.

Breen-unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Enhanced Energy Dissipator II
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_3_DESC:
Enhanced Energy Dissipator III 
Enhancements to the energy dissipator enable more weapon energy to be drained from the enemy, thus reducing their rate of fire even further.

Breen unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Enhanced Energy Dissipator III
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_4_DESC:

Psionic
